# What's new

What changed in OgreBot, release by release, newest first. Every release listed here was published to the patcher.

A release is named by the day it was published and its number that day: **2026.10.16.005** is the fifth release on October 16, 2026. Releases with nothing you would notice are not listed, so the numbers can skip.

Dates and times are US Eastern time (EST in winter, EDT in summer).

## 2026.11.20.003 {#r2026-11-20-003}

*Friday, November 20, 2026 at 5:04 PM EST*

- **New** · Bot: **Cast Stack entries can be limited to solo, group or raid.** Each cast stack entry has three new "Use when" boxes: Solo / Duo (1-2 players), Group (3+) and Raid. Tick one or more to use that entry only there, and leave them all empty to use it everywhere as before. A mercenary does not count as a player, and in a raid only the Raid box applies.
- **New** · Bot: **Cast Stack has a "Named Or Epic NPC" option.** Cast stack entries have a new Named Or Epic NPC box under Named NPCs Only. With it ticked, the entry is used only when your target is a named NPC or an epic NPC.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Overseer never starts a quest with only equipment.** The Overseer could put a piece of Overseer equipment into a quest as its only "agent", and the game refused the start with "An agent is required to use this Overseer Equipment." The bot now asks the game which entries are equipment, and always places a real agent before any equipment. It also remembers new equipment it finds, so the list keeps up with new items.
- **Fixed** · Other: **Writing Ogre's logs can no longer slow the game.** Ogre wrote its log files on the game's own thread, so a program working on those files at the same time could cost frames. That could be a folder sync tool such as Syncthing or OneDrive, or a virus scanner. Ogre now writes its logs in the background, so the game never waits for the disk.

## 2026.11.20.002 {#r2026-11-20-002}

*Friday, November 20, 2026 at 2:39 AM EST*

- **New** · Bot: **Cast Stack has a Savagery "less than" condition.** A Beastlord's cast stack entries now have a Savagery < box beside Savagery ≥, to cast an ability only while your Savagery is below a level. For example, Savagery < 6 skips an ability once your Savagery is full.

## 2026.11.20.001 {#r2026-11-20-001}

*Friday, November 20, 2026 at 1:16 AM EST*

- **New** · Windows: **A new MCP starts with basic buttons.** A new install's MCP now has Let's Go, Hold Up, Camp Spot, Follow Me, Pause and Resume on every page, and a Basics page with Use Flag, Repair, Zone Reset, Special, Rescue and Intercept Me. If you migrate your OgreBot Classic MCP before changing them, your Classic buttons replace them without asking.
- **New** · Windows: **Save Position can make a window open minimized.** Save Position now also remembers whether the window is minimized. Minimize a window, then right-click its title bar and choose Save Position, and it opens minimized every time from then on. Save it again while it is open and it goes back to opening normally.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Effect tracker recordings are kept in OgreSave.** The effect tracker now saves its recordings in OgreSave\EQ2\EffectTracker instead of OgreBot Classic's EQ2OgreCommon folders, and its ignore list comes with the bot. The Migration Assistant copies your existing recordings over once.
- **Changed** · Bot: **The bot reads OgreBot Classic's folders only to migrate.** Loot caps, key binds, uplinks, Ogre Craft settings and MCP buttons are taken from your Classic files once, by migration, and from then on only from the new bot's own files. Tradeskill exports are now saved in OgreSave\EQ2\Craft\TSExports. A loot file that cannot be read now says so instead of quietly using old Classic data.
- **Changed** · Windows: **Auto-Login's Start can run changes you have not saved.** In the Auto-Login window, Start now runs the profile as it is in the window, so you can change a profile, click Start, and close the window without saving. The saved profile stays exactly as it was, and a profile you have not saved yet can be started too. With no changes, Start runs the saved profile as before.
- **Changed** · Setup: **Your OgreBot Classic login is copied once only.** The bot copies your login from OgreBot Classic the first time it starts, and after that only uses its own saved login. If you clear your login in the bot, it asks you for it again instead of bringing back the old Classic one.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Buying Overseer missions works on a new install.** `ogre bom` stopped with "could not load the mission database" on a PC that never ran OgreBot Classic, because the mission list came from Classic's folders. The list now comes with the bot.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Dragoon's Reflexes and Superior Guard are no longer broken by the bot's own combat arts.** While a warrior's Dragoon's Reflexes (on TLE servers) or a monk's Superior Guard is up, the cast stack now holds its offensive abilities, as the old bot did, so the bot no longer cancels the buff by casting a combat art right after it. A guardian's Block holds them the same way. An ability you fire yourself from a button still goes through.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Melee and Ranged Attack wait for the "% to attack" health again.** With Melee Attack or Ranged Attack ticked, the bot turned auto-attack on as soon as the target was in reach, even at 100% health, ignoring the "% to attack" setting. It now waits until the target is at or below that health, as the old bot did, unless the health check is set to be ignored.
- **Fixed** · Setup: **All your Classic AutoTarget lists come over.** The Migration Assistant now copies every saved AutoTarget list from OgreBot Classic, including zones that only had a list in the SavedTargets folder. The bot then reads your lists from OgreSave only.

## 2026.11.19.004 {#r2026-11-19-004}

*Thursday, November 19, 2026 at 10:07 PM EST*

- **Fixed** · Bot: **OgreBot offers a one-click fix when a profile rule names a missing file.** If one of your profile rules names a profile file that has been renamed or deleted, OgreBot used to not open at all, with only a line in the console. A Profile not found window now says which rule and file it is and offers Fix it and open OgreBot, or the Persona window. The Persona window also marks such a rule as missing.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Zone range extenders come with the bot.** The list of zones where an effect changes your ability range now comes with the bot. Before, only a few test PCs had it, so on every other PC those effects were ignored and the console said it could not read RangeExtenders.json.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **Old Instance Controller run files are cleaned up.** Every zone the Instance Controller started left a small file in OgreSave/EQ2/IC/runs, and none was ever deleted, so the folder kept growing. Each zone start now deletes the ones more than 7 days old. Only the Instance Controller's own run files are touched; anything else in that folder is left alone.
- **Fixed** · Navigation: **Flying works in three more zones.** Three zones in Freeport and Qeynos were missing the file flying needs, so the bot said flight was unavailable there. They now come with it.
- **Fixed** · Navigation: **Travel remembers what your characters can use on a new install.** On a new install the bot could not save what it learned about your account's travel features and guild hall amenities, and said "travel: could not save" each time. It now creates the folder it saves into.

## 2026.11.19.003 {#r2026-11-19-003}

*Thursday, November 19, 2026 at 8:46 PM EST*

- **Fixed** · Bot: **A slower PC no longer stays at a low frame rate after entering the world.** On a slower PC, the bot's one-time learning of the game's windows could keep the game at about 12 frames a second and start over every minute. It now does far less work, and if it ever runs too long it stops and tries again at the next zone instead of starting over.

## 2026.11.19.002 {#r2026-11-19-002}

*Thursday, November 19, 2026 at 7:41 PM EST*

- **Fixed** · Bot: **No stutter the first time you enter the world.** The first time a character enters the world on a PC, and once after each game update, the bot learns where the game keeps its windows. It now spreads that work thinly over the frames. Before, it could drop a slower PC to about 5 frames a second for half a minute.

## 2026.11.19.001 {#r2026-11-19-001}

*Thursday, November 19, 2026 at 6:09 PM EST*

- **New** · Bot: **Cancel a cast to cure - group, single target and curse cures.** "X abilities to group cure" now works, with two new boxes beside it: "Cancel cast to single target cure" and "Cancel cast to curse cure". With one ticked, a cast that is not a cure is cancelled when a cure of that kind on your Cast Stack would cast right now, and the cure goes next (a cast with a quarter of a second or less left finishes first). All three are off unless you tick them; with "Disable CS_CureCurse" ticked, only a requested cure curse cancels.
- **New** · Crafting: **The craft queue in its own window, with the resources it needs before you start.** **Queue window** (on the craft window's Recipes and Queues tabs) opens the setup queue in its own window, updated as you add recipes, and shows the active queue while a run goes. Both the window and the Queues tab now list what the setup queue needs and what you have before you press Start, with short rows in red. **Have** is read when you add a recipe or change its quantity, and it needs **Allow recipe-info server call** on.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Overseer no longer scrolls through its quest and agent lists.** Overseer now reads every quest and every agent, and picks the right ones, without scrolling either list - the agent list alone took about 15 seconds and lowered the frame rate while the window was on screen. When no quest on the list can be started, for example with none left for the day and no charged quest, it skips the agent list entirely.
- **Changed** · Crafting: **Recipe books above your level wait until you are one level into their 10-level range.** On the first level of a 10-level range, such as 80, the craft bot now buys only the recipe books at or below your level. It buys the rest of that range once you reach the next level. On a server capped at 80, it no longer buys books 82 to 88, which you could never scribe there.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **-Repair works in combat - it stops attacking before it opens the mender.** -Repair (and the auto-repair at a repair bot) clicked the mender while you were still attacking, and the game refused with "You are too busy to do a merchant transaction". It now stops attacking first and holds off the fight until the repair is done. If the game still says too busy, it starts a /camp, cancels it at once with a jump, and tries once more - that clears the stuck state some players get after a crash.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **The clipboard can no longer freeze the game.** With the Master Control Panel open, a copy could freeze every game client for a few seconds when a clipboard-sharing program (Multiplicity and the like) was running, because Ogre waited for that program to hand the copied text over. Ogre now reads and writes the clipboard in the background, so the game never waits for it, and it reads the clipboard only while a window that needs it is open.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **You are told when OgreUltralight.exe cannot start.** When you draw Ogre's windows in OgreUltralight.exe and it stops as it starts, for example because a file it needs is missing, the game now says so in its console and opens the "no Ogre windows" box with the way out. Before, the windows just never appeared and nothing said why.
- **Fixed** · Navigation: **Travel stops with a reason when its zone choice is not in the zone window.** A druid ring, bell or spire travel whose zone choice was not in the zone window (for example 'FALSE' against "Jarsath Wastes" / "Jarsath Wastes 2") said it worked and left the character standing at the window. Now the travel fails, and the message lists what the window offers. A destination with a space sent without quotes, such as Jarsath Wastes FALSE, now gets a warning that it needs quotes.
- **Fixed** · Crafting: **CraftGM uses every Scroll Depot within reach, the Large one too.** CraftGM said "no 'Scroll Depot' found nearby" next to a Scroll Depot (Large), and only ever used the nearest depot. It now pulls from every Scroll Depot within reach, either size, nearest first, and passes over one that has nothing for you or does not open. Ability Upgrades reads the Large ones too.
- **Fixed** · Crafting: **Double-clicking a craft recipe adds it, and the Queue window button toggles.** Double-clicking a recipe in the craft window's list now adds it to the setup queue with the Quantity you typed. Before, the first click redrew the list and the double-click was lost. The **Queue window** button now opens the queue window, or closes it when it is already open.
- **Fixed** · Crafting: **The craft panel's recipe list keeps its place when you pick a recipe.** Clicking a recipe in the craft panel's list, or adding one to the queue, jumped the list back to the top. The list now stays where you scrolled it.
- **Fixed** · Crafting: **The craft Recipes tab reads an unread recipe book, and its list fills the window.** With **Do NOT load recipes on startup** ticked, the Recipes tab stayed empty whatever you clicked. Changing any filter or the search now reads your recipe book, as the classic bot did, and the empty list says how to load it. The recipe list now fills the rest of the window and grows when you make the window taller, and the Min, Max and Quantity labels sit beside their boxes.
- **Fixed** · Setup: **Ogre's windows start without installing the Visual C++ runtime.** The bot now brings the Microsoft Visual C++ runtime files its windows need, so they start on a PC that has none or an old one. Before, such a PC got no Ogre windows: an "error 126" box, or Windows boxes saying MSVCP140_ATOMIC_WAIT.dll or MSVCP140_2.dll was not found.
- **Fixed** · Setup: **The login window answers Enter and Esc.** In the OgreX - Login window, pressing Enter now logs you in once both the username and the password are filled in, and with only the username filled in it moves you to the password box. Esc closes the window, the same as Cancel. Before, both keys did nothing.

## 2026.11.18.001 {#r2026-11-18-001}

*Wednesday, November 18, 2026 at 3:14 PM EST*

- **New** · Bot: **Cast Stack items can use conditions.** An item in the Cast Stack can now use the same conditions as an ability: My HP, My MP, NPC HP, Aggro and Fervor (and Savagery or Dissonance on those classes). The item is used only when they hold.
- **New** · Bot: **Pass LORE items can now work in a raid.** A new box under Pass LORE items I already have to the group, Allow in a raid, lets the hand-out work in a raid too: the bot asks the whole raid, and copies go to raid members in raid order. It is off by default, so raid loot stays yours to hand out.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Cast Stack tells "line of sight blocked" from "out of range"; Dry-Run shows distance.** An ability whose target was close enough, but out of sight, was skipped as "out of range". It now says "line of sight blocked", for your target, your pet and a body to res. The Cast-Stack Dry-Run on the Debug tab now shows each target's distance and the ability's reach, and marks a blocked line of sight.
- **Changed** · Bot: **MCP buttons sent over IRC put the For Who (-cfw) at the end of the line.** A button sent over IRC put `-cfw <who>` before its first command, while the same button sent on this PC showed it at the end. It now goes at the end on both, so a line reads the same either way.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **A mercenary no longer counts as @Healer1, @Tank or another role.** A mercenary in your group could be picked as @Healer1 (or @Tank, @DPS1 and the others), and a buff aimed at that role was then sent to the merc over and over without ever landing. Roles are filled only by players again, in the Cast Stack and in For Who.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **For Who window - picking two or more raid groups reaches every picked group.** With Multi on, picking G2 and G3 in the For Who window reached nobody: it asked for characters in raid group 2 and raid group 3 at once. The picked groups now go out together as one choice, so each character in any picked group runs the command.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Group-only buffs no longer try raid members in other groups.** A single-target buff the game lets you cast only on your own group (like the Inquisitor's Tenacity), aimed at a character by name, was tried on that character when they were in another group of your raid. Now it is cast only when they are in your group; buffs and heals that can reach the whole raid still do.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Heals and cures on your mercenary land; buffs no longer target mercenaries.** A heal, cure or buff the Cast Stack aimed at a mercenary was sent the way it is sent to a player, which the game ignores, so it never landed and was sent again and again. Heals and cures on your own mercenary now use the game's mercenary command and land. Single-target buffs no longer target mercenaries, and another player's mercenary is not a target.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **IRC - a line with several -auth (or other IRC link commands) runs every one.** A line such as `!c all -auth A_IRC -auth B_IRC` only authorized the first name, and when your own name came first your own PC authorized nobody. Every `-auth`, `-unauth` and other IRC link command on the line now runs, each with the name after it. A line with no IRC name before the command, such as an MCP button's `!c -cfw <who> -auth A_IRC`, now reaches every PC's link.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **IRC - a second PC can send through another PC's IRC link (Uplink name).** The Uplink name on the OgreConsole tab was saved but never used, so a second PC with no IRC connection of its own could not send IRC commands. Set it to the other PC's InnerSpace uplink name and this PC's IRC lines, MCP IRC buttons and Auth raid go out through that PC's link. Leave it blank to use this PC's own link.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Several copies of a LORE item in one chest no longer all go to you.** When a chest held several copies of a LORE item you did not have yet, the bot tried to loot every copy to you; the game refused the extras, and some chests closed with other loot still inside. Now you take one copy and the rest are passed to the group when Pass LORE items I already have to the group is ticked. This also works with Loot Distribution ticked.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **The Travel Helper lists destinations when you are away from the bell.** The bell, druid ring and wizard spire buttons in the Travel Helper no longer need the character who clicks them to stand at the bell, ring or spire. Away from one, the window lists every destination Ogre knows for it, and your group travels there as usual. Press Enter in the filter box to pick the one destination left.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **After a wipe, the Instance Controller starts the interrupted step over.** After a wipe, the restart could pick up the step it was on as if no time had passed: a named fight waited for a named nobody was fighting until someone pulled it by hand, and a trash clear or hunt could fail or time out at once. Now a wipe starts that step over (the walk, the buff-up and the pull), and a named that died before the wipe still counts as dead. Stopping a run during a hunt also turns the hunt's AutoTarget changes back.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **Skip shinies in the Instance Controller now leaves the trash's shinies too.** With Skip shinies ticked, the shinies steps took nothing, but the setup list unticked each character's Do NOT loot shinies box at every zone start, so the bot still looted every shiny the trash dropped. Now Skip shinies ticks that box for the group, after the setup list and at once when you tick it during a run. The profile reload at the end of the run puts each character's own setting back.
- **Fixed** · Navigation: **Navigation - a flight stuck in the air is noticed sooner.** A mount that stopped moving in the air but kept bobbing up and down a few units counted the bobbing as progress, so the bot took about 20 seconds longer to notice it was stuck and start climbing out. Height now counts only when the flight reaches a height it has not already been at, so real climbs and landings still count and bobbing in place does not.
- **Fixed** · Navigation: **Navigation - two failure messages now say what really happened.** When a flight stayed stuck in the air after its last climb, the log printed one more "climbing over it" line for a climb that never happened. It now says the climbs did not clear it. When a trip found no route after a failed step, the message counted unrelated requirements; it now also counts the ways this trip already tried and failed, which is usually the real reason.

## 2026.11.17.003 {#r2026-11-17-003}

*Tuesday, November 17, 2026 at 11:57 PM EST*

- **Changed** · Windows: **Window logs now live in Scripts\OgreLogs\ui.** The logs of OgreBot's windows (ISXOgreUIHost.log, OgreUltralight.log) moved out of x64\Extensions\ISXDK35\OgreUIRuntime into Scripts\OgreLogs\ui. They move the next time you restart the game.
- **Changed** · Setup: **Log files now live in Scripts\OgreLogs.** OgreBot's log files moved out of x64\Extensions\ISXDK35 into Scripts\OgreLogs: each session's in a folder named after the session, the uplink's in Scripts\OgreLogs\uplink, and OgreCrash.log at the top. The old copies in the extensions folder are removed the first time each part loads.

## 2026.11.17.002 {#r2026-11-17-002}

*Tuesday, November 17, 2026 at 10:14 PM EST*

- **New** · Bot: **Scripts can add, change, move and remove Cast Stack rows.** OgreBotAPI.CastStack has five new methods: AddEntry, SetEntryOption, ClearEntryOption, RemoveEntry and MoveEntry. A script can add a row anywhere, set or clear any option the Cast Stack window has, and move or remove a row by its number or name. Changes show in the window at once and are kept when you Save.
- **Changed** · Console: **ApplyVerb takes an actor id; ApplyVerbID is gone.** -ApplyVerb and -ApplyVerbQueued, and OgreBotAPI.Actors:ApplyVerb and :ApplyVerbQueued, now take the actor's id as well as its name or a type word, so -ApplyVerbID and -ApplyVerbIDQueued (and their Actors methods) are removed. Saved MCP buttons are switched over for you, and the script converter turns old calls into the new ones.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **A worn clicky is no longer used again while its buff is up.** A worn item on a Cast Stack row (a charm or a shield, by its name) was used every time its reuse came up, even with its buff still running, because the bot could not read what the item does. It now reads the worn item, and an item's buff counts as up only by what it applies when activated, so a shield's always-on protection no longer counts as its buff.

## 2026.11.17.001 {#r2026-11-17-001}

*Tuesday, November 17, 2026 at 2:57 PM EST*

- **New** · Bot: **Scripts can ask whether anyone in the group is in combat.** The new `${OgreBotAPI.Roster.InCombat}` is TRUE when anyone in your group is in combat, you included, so a script can wait for the whole group to be out of combat before it moves on. It checks your group only, not the rest of a raid. Classic scripts that used `Obj_OgreUtilities.GroupInCombat` can use it instead.
- **New** · Bot: **The bot now handles mobs that are immune to area attacks cast through an assist.** Some mobs, such as training dummies, only take area attacks from someone targeting them directly, and the game says "Your target is immune to your indirect AOE attacks." The bot now stops that attack at once and ticks the new Dynamic Direct Assist Targeting box, which is never saved, then waits 1 second for that to take effect. If Direct Assist Targeting is already on, or you tick the new "Do not automatically turn on DAT" box, it holds all area attacks for 10 seconds instead.
- **New** · Instance Controller: **Check a zone file or a fight file from the console.** `ogre ic validate` and `ogre encounter validate` check a file by the rules the game loads it with and print each problem. The game now also warns about a rule option nothing reads. Ogre ships a schema of every step, condition and option (`ic.schema.json`, `fight.schema.json`) for outside editors.
- **New** · Instance Controller: **Content Builder: build zone files and fight files as boxes.** `ogre contentbuilder` opens a new window that draws a file as boxes: an Instance Controller zone file, or a fight file. Add steps from a list and fill in their options and conditions in forms; the game checks the file after every change. Save to your own folder and run it from the window.
- **New** · Instance Controller: **Instance Controller's Ogre IM can now run on every character in the group.** The IC window has a new box under Ogre IM: All characters in the group. With it ticked, every character in the group runs the same Ogre IM as you, which suits a group that shares loot round robin, and the list waits until all of them are done. It is off by default, so only your own character runs Ogre IM, as before.
- **New** · Other: **The API reference is on the site.** The Developers section now has an API reference, covering every member, method, command and event of `OgreBotAPI`, `ISXOgreEQ2` and `ISXOgreX` that a script can use. Each one shows what it is for, its arguments and an example. The pages are rebuilt from the code, so they stay current as the bot changes.
- **Changed** · Bot: **After a res, a priest waits 10 seconds before sending another res at the same body.** Once a res is sent at a body, that priest sends no other res at it for 10 seconds, from any of its res abilities, so a res the person has not accepted yet is not cast over it. Before, a res the game refused, such as "You cannot see your target!", was sent again about twice a second, switching between res abilities.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Auto-Hunt's Delay After Combat works, and the tab is no longer struck through.** With Campspot or CS-JO-JI, ticking **Delay After Combat** makes the group wait 3 seconds with no mob in reach before it is let go to follow you again, instead of 1.5. The **Use IRC** box is gone: Auto-Hunt sends its group commands on this PC only. Every option on the Auto-Hunt tab now works, so its name in the tab list is no longer struck through.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Loading a profile or closing OgreBot no longer warns about unsaved changes afterwards.** Loading a profile or closing OgreBot over changes that were not saved printed a warning in the console, but only afterwards, when nothing could be done about it. The load warning also appeared after almost every second load, because a profile's own load-tab commands change settings. Both now go to the log file only, and the marker beside the X still shows unsaved changes before you close.
- **Changed** · Instance Controller: **The Chimeric Chain Heroic - a Lord Shomp flight with no cloud in sight is now reported.** If Lord Shomp stays in flight for 20 seconds with no stormcloud in sight, the fight cannot go on, because nobody has a cloud to dispel. The group leader now plays the chat ding, and every box prints what it can see to its own console, every 30 seconds until the flight ends. If you see this, please send the lines from each session's log.
- **Changed** · Other: **The API reference is easier to use.** The Developers section has a new page, Your first script, that walks through a whole small script and explains each piece. The Commands reference is split into smaller pages, and each `ogre` command now lists the words it takes with an example. The API pages also say what a for-who does in a script and how `oc !c` makes your group act.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **A cure request no longer says it gave up when a cure landed.** A curse or cure request could end with a "gave up, never cured" warning in the Errors tab even though the cures landed: on a character with two curses or one that came back, or one that asked again while still out of range. Those requests now end quietly in the log file, and the Errors tab warning is kept for a request where nothing came off.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Call of the Veteran works on the first try.** Call of the Veteran often failed the first time with "popup up still not met", because the bot clicked the porter the moment the cast ended, before it could be clicked. It now waits up to 5 seconds for the porter, so Teleport and Summon go through on the first try.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Currency lookups no longer stall the game.** Looking up a currency amount stalled the game for most of a second while the bot read the Persona window's currency list. The list is now read a little each frame, with far fewer reads, so the lookup is no longer noticeable.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Instant abilities whose cooldown starts after their effect are now seen as cast.** Some instant abilities, such as Unyielding Retribution, run their effect first and only start their cooldown when it ends. The bot waited for that cooldown, held the cast bar for about 3 seconds and then logged the cast as failed, which also stopped any Post-Cast after it. The bot now also watches the ability's ready state and moves on as soon as it has gone off.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Looting no longer skips items whose icon shows up late.** When a loot window was slow to draw its item icons, the bot could skip items as "not in chest" and leave them in the chest. It now waits up to a second for an item's icon while the item is still in the window, and only skips an item that has really gone.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Mission timers no longer freeze the game.** Asking for mission timers froze the game for 7 to 8 seconds while the bot read the Mission Timers table. The table is now read in one pass, a little each frame, so the same answer comes back in well under a second without a freeze.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **ogre perf no longer blames the game's own frame on OgreBot.** `ogre perf` used to say "OgreBot is RESPONSIBLE for" 10 ms or more of each frame. That number came from an OgreBot address found anywhere on the game's stack, and those addresses were leftovers from calls that had already finished while the game drew its own frame. The report now shows OgreBot's pulse and its own DLLs' time outside it, both measured directly.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **OgreBot opens on a first run with no OldBot profiles.** With no OldBot profiles to bring across, opening OgreBot stopped at "Routing.json not found". It now makes the file and gives your character a profile of its own.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **OSA and the HUD no longer read every placed item in a house or guild hall.** A house or guild hall can hold more than a thousand placed items, and the OSA and the HUD's nearest NPC/PC lines read every one of them several times a second. They now pass over anything that is not an NPC or a player - placed items, chests, harvest nodes, doors, pets and mercenaries - without reading it.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **OSA and the HUD read the zone's actors once between them.** With both the OSA and the HUD's nearest NPC/PC lines open, each read every actor in the zone on its own, several times a second. In a zone full of actors, such as a busy guild hall, that cost a few milliseconds a frame. The HUD now uses the OSA's read, so the bot does that work once.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Overseer no longer reports a false error after adding a mission.** After auto-add scribed a mission such as Heritage Hunt [Daily], the Overseer could report "the quest list did not grow" as an error even though the mission was then started. It now looks for each added mission by name once the list is read again, and only warns when one is missing, since a missing mission will not be started.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Post-Casts now wait for the ability they follow to finish.** A Post-Cast waited only 2 seconds for the cast bar, so it could be skipped while the ability it follows was still going, for example an instant whose cooldown only starts after its effect. A Post-Cast now waits for that ability's cast to finish, however long it takes, and is skipped only if a different spell takes the cast bar first or the ability never went off. The log also no longer reports a skipped Post-Cast for abilities that have none.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Pulse Budget settings changed on one box are no longer undone by another.** All boxes on a PC share one Pulse Budget settings file, and a box used to write the whole file from its own copy. A change made on one box (a slice, the frame ceiling, on or off) was put back the next time any other box saved. Each box now changes only what it changed, on the file as it is at that moment.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **A revived character's walk back waits until it is in the world again.** After a revive, the Instance Controller sent the walk back to the group while the character was still loading in, so the character's own session put "nav: not in world" warnings in the Errors tab. The walk now goes once the character is in the world again, or after 15 seconds if that is never seen.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **Dominion of Pain Heroic - Sir Rendal's light puzzle now runs every time.** The Instance Controller now clears the trash on both sides first, then lets the fight file take Sir Rendal Cauldthorn. The fight starts a Heroic Opportunity on him so the lights come up, clicks the lights on the north side and then the south, and kills the Knights of Truth with the whole group. Before, the lights often never came, and the group fought him while he healed.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **Dominion of Pain Heroic - The Soulbleeder's pool runners stay with the group once cured.** When a pool runner's curse was cured, the fight sometimes sent that character straight back to its pool, and the curse was put back on it a few seconds later. A character that has asked for its cure now stays with the group for the rest of the fight.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **Resuming a zone no longer puts a warning in the Errors tab.** Starting a zone part-way, with Resume or a named number, added a warning like "startAt 20: skipping the first 20 of 34 step(s)" to the Errors tab, although you asked for it. It is now an ordinary console line. It stays a warning only when the start point is past the last step, because then nothing runs.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **Stopping the Instance Controller during a zone-in now stops the whole group's travel.** Ending or failing the Instance Controller while the group was travelling to a zone stopped only the leader. The rest of the group kept going, and a character still waiting for its staggered start set off afterwards. The stop now reaches every character in the group.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **The Instance Controller no longer warns when something out of range keeps the group hated.** After some fights the group stays hated with no mob anywhere near, usually one that ran off, and the Instance Controller moves on after 15 seconds. That "nothing in range, moving on" line went to the Errors tab every time and is now an ordinary console line. A mob in range that will not die is still a warning.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **The Instance Controller now turns on Auto Assist for the rest of the group.** The setup list told the group to assist you at each zone start, but a member only acts on that with Auto Assist ticked, so a profile with it off stood on its own target through the trash. A new default row ticks Auto Assist for everyone in the group but you, and it is added to your saved list once. The profile reload at the end of a run puts each character's own setting back.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **The Instance Controller reads the lockout again before skipping a locked zone.** A zone could be skipped as locked and not resettable on a lockout reading up to 15 minutes old, even after its reset had become available. Before skipping a zone now, the Instance Controller reads the lockout again and skips only on that new reading.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **The Instance Controller's loot walk stops once the target is in reach.** When a corpse or shiny came within reach while the group was still walking to it, the loot was taken but the walk carried on toward the target's exact spot. A corpse left floating above the ground, which nav cannot reach, then caused several nav warnings in the Errors tab. The walk now stops where it is as soon as the target is in reach.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **The Instance Controller's res run ends when the dead member is ressed during a fight.** When a group member died and was ressed while the group was still in combat, the res run kept waiting for the fight to end before it finished, even though nobody was dead any more. With a mob far off that kept the group in combat, the walk could sit for minutes. The res run now finishes as soon as nobody is dead.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **The Instance Controller's wait for a group member who falls behind is no longer a warning.** When someone fell more than 40 m behind on a walk, the "waiting for (name)" line went to the Errors tab, although waiting for them is the normal thing to do. It is now an ordinary console line. A member still behind after 60 s, when the walk goes on without them, is still a warning.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **The res run takes the group to the body itself, not where the group window last showed it.** When a member died while running, the group window could still show them up to 15 m back, and the res run walked the group to that spot. From there the priests often could not see the body, every res failed, and the member was revived after two minutes instead. The res run now goes to where the body actually lies.
- **Fixed** · Navigation: **Getting stuck once and finding a way round is no longer a warning.** When nav ran into something the navmesh does not know about, it marked that spot as blocked, went round it, and put "the game will not let us through there" in the Errors tab, even though the walk then went on. The first time at a spot is now an ordinary console line. Getting stuck at the same spot again on one trip, or at a spot stuck on before, is still a warning.
- **Fixed** · Navigation: **ogre nav -set on its own lists the settings.** Typing `ogre nav -set` with no key now lists the nav settings you can change, as its help always said. It used to stop with "-set needs a value" instead.
- **Fixed** · Navigation: **Stepping off the edge of a route once is no longer a warning.** When a character took a bend wide and dropped a little below its route, nav plans again from where it landed, and that line went to the Errors tab every time. The first drop at a spot is now an ordinary console line. Dropping off the same spot again on one trip is still a warning, because it points at a navmesh problem.
- **Fixed** · Navigation: **Travel no longer gives up on a zone door whose destination window is empty.** Clicking a door or a guild hall portal could find its destination window open but with nothing listed, and travel then gave up with "its 0 destination(s) are: (none)" even though the click went on to zone the character. A destination window that lists nothing is now treated as no window, so travel waits for the zone or for the list to fill.
- **Fixed** · Crafting: **A rush order no longer freezes the writ run at "scanning recipes".** Taking a rush order from the agent could leave the craft bot stuck at "scanning recipes" until you ended it. It now finishes talking to the agent first, then reads your recipe book and carries on.
- **Fixed** · Crafting: **The craft bot walks close enough to start the recipe.** The craft bot could stop just outside the distance where the game lets a recipe start. The game then said "You must be located near a Forge" and every craft was skipped. It now stops a little closer to the station.

## 2026.11.16.001 {#r2026-11-16-001}

*Monday, November 16, 2026 at 12:52 AM EST*

- **New** · Bot: **New -UpgradeItem moves your adornments onto an upgrade.** Put the old item in bag 1 slot 1 and the new one in bag 1 slot 2, then run **-UpgradeItem** or the new **Upgrade Item** ready-made MCP button. The old item's adornments go onto the new one, the old item moves to the end of bag 1 and the new one is equipped (the game asks you first if it must be attuned). Both items must be for the same slot and the new one must have no adornments yet; an adornment with no free slot of its colour goes back on the old item.
- **New** · Instance Controller: **IC treats a near-wipe as a wipe.** When only a few of the group are still standing and all of them are in combat (2 or fewer of 5 or 6, or one of 3 or 4, never a group of 2), IC pauses their OgreBot so the wipe recovery can start instead of the fight dragging on. They get OgreBot back when the recovery starts, when the fight around them ends, after 60 seconds, or when the run ends.
- **Changed** · Bot: **The bot fights a Special your group is fighting, with no option to tick.** When your target, or your target's target, is a Special actor, such as the adds some fights spawn, the bot now attacks it. The Allow Specials to be Targets option is gone, because only something you can fight can be targeted.
- **Changed** · Crafting: **Refine now waits its turn.** `ogre refine` now queues its Refine ability and each item it refines behind anything already waiting to be cast or used, instead of cutting in between them. The item is no longer refused when it comes straight after the ability. If the cast bar stays busy, the bot tries that item again.
- **Changed** · Crafting: **Scribing and adding Overseer missions now wait their turn.** Scribing recipe books and scrolls, and using Overseer mission scrolls, now waits in line behind abilities and items already waiting to be used, instead of cutting in between them. Each one is used only once the one before it has finished, so a busy cast bar no longer makes the bot skip a book or a mission. This covers the craft bot, the Scribe command, merchant crafting, buying Overseer missions and adding them automatically.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Buffs that replace each other no longer flip-flop on Buff rows.** Two buffs that replace each other, like the Armored Ogler and Iceclad Tundra Fox pets, no longer keep recasting over each other when your cast stack lists them as Buff. After a buff lands, the next buff waits until it shows up, at most one second, so the one higher in your cast stack stays.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Ogre IM no longer stalls on transmutes it cannot do.** Each time Ogre IM runs, it now checks whether the character has the Transmute and Salvage abilities, says so once, and skips the items that need a missing one instead of waiting about 7 seconds on each. A stack that fails to transmute twice in a row is given up, and when none of it went, it is skipped for the rest of the session instead of getting a try for every item in it. This kept an IM run inside Instance Controller busy for up to 15 minutes on a character with too little Transmuting skill.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Pre-Cast and Post-Cast skip an ability you do not have.** A Pre-Cast or Post-Cast row whose ability is not in your ability export is now skipped quietly, instead of being tried as an item and logging an error. Items you pick on those tabs are saved as items, so only they are looked for in your bags.
- **Fixed** · Navigation: **Flying keeps clear of hills the game cannot see.** In zones whose ground is a streaming landscape (The Unknown, Aether Wroughtlands, Sandstone Delta and over 120 others), the game's own collision check cannot see the hills, and a flight could be planned straight into them. Flying now knows that ground in every one of those zones: the route stays above the hills and keeps its usual 10 m of room over and beside them.
- **Fixed** · Crafting: **Scribing several recipe books at once scribes all of them again.** With two or more recipe books in your bags, for example after gaining two levels at once, the craft bot scribed only the first one, so writs that needed the rest failed or tried the wrong recipe. It now waits between books so each one is scribed. The same fix applies to the Scribe command and to scribing Overseer missions.
- **Fixed** · Crafting: **Writs no longer craft a look-alike recipe when the real one is missing.** When a writ asked for a recipe you did not have, the craft bot could drop the item's name and craft a similar recipe instead, such as Imbued Boiled Leather Pants for a Boiled Leather Pouch. It now only shortens a step at words like "on", "for" or "with", so it reports the recipe as not in your book.

## 2026.11.15.001 {#r2026-11-15-001}

*Sunday, November 15, 2026 at 9:03 PM EST*

- **New** · Instance Controller: **IC brings a revived member back past the zone's teleporters.** A member who was revived after the group had gone through a teleporter woke on the near side with no way to walk back, and the zone failed. If it carries Call of the Tinkerer and it is ready, it now uses it to reach the group; otherwise it is sent back through every teleporter the group used, in order. A member knocked back past more than one teleporter is brought back the same way.
- **New** · Instance Controller: **IC brings back a member stranded past a teleporter.** When a member ended up back on the near side of a teleporter the group had already gone through (knocked off a ledge, with no way to walk to the group), the steps after it waited for that member and the next teleporter failed the zone. IC now sends that member back to where the group clicked the teleporter and through it again, and the group waits for it. It tries twice, then goes on as before.
- **Changed** · Windows: **The radar keeps its zoom and height.** The radar's zoom (how far it reaches) and height filter now save themselves when you let go of the slider, the same way the types already did, so they are still set the next time the radar opens. Dim and the gear settings still need Save.
- **Changed** · Instance Controller: **Loot left on purpose is no longer a warning.** When the Instance Controller's loot step deliberately leaves something, such as a corpse lying in lava or a no-trade item you chose not to take, its end line still says so, but it is no longer reported as a warning. Loot the step tried to take and could not is still a warning.
- **Changed** · Instance Controller: **Lord Shomp's stormclouds are dispelled from the ground.** In The Chimeric Chain [Heroic], the group no longer runs under Lord Shomp's stormclouds, where it could get stuck on the house walls. While Shomp is in flight, each toon with a dispel, except the first healer, takes its own cloud. It dispels the cloud from a set spot on the ground, then returns.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **"Fighters cast Bulwark of Order on the Arch Lich's barrage".** In The Fabled Ssraeshza Temple: Inner Sanctum, the Arch Lich Rhag'Zadune warns that it "breaks from the portal to tear apart everyone with a barrage of attacks!" before hitting the whole group. Fighters now cast Bulwark of Order on that warning. Before, the bot did not recognise the line, so the tank had to cast it by hand.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **A chest is looted even when the game shuts its window on an item you cannot take.** When the game closed a loot window on an item you are not allowed to loot, the rest of the box was left behind and IC walked on. Now the bot says which item shut it, opens the chest again, leaves that item, and takes the rest, and IC waits for it.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **A revive waits for the Revive button to light up.** The Revive button is greyed out for a few seconds after you die, and a revive pressed in that time did nothing, leaving the toon dead. A revive now waits up to 8 seconds for the button before pressing it.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **A setting written with the value it already has is not an unsaved change.** A profile's own load commands, such as a Load tab script that sets options by class, left a freshly loaded profile marked as unsaved. The next profile load then warned about losing changes that were never made. Writing a setting with the value it already has no longer counts as a change.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Auto Follow no longer fights the bot's own movement.** With Auto Follow Mode ticked, a toon being moved by the bot (an Instance Controller walk, a camp spot, a nav trip) kept starting and stopping /follow. Each new leg of the move broke the follow, and Auto Follow turned it back on at the end of the leg. Auto Follow now waits while anything else is moving the toon, as OgreFollow already does, and for 10 seconds after the bot's own movement ends, so it stays out of the pauses between the legs of a walk.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **No more "gave up" warnings for a detriment that was cured.** A toon that was busy casting when a cure request ran out could warn that it gave up on someone whose detriment had already been cured. Now a cured or gone detriment is cleared before the time limit is checked, and the warning names the right command for a curse, `-AutoCurse`.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Ogre IM skips an item the game will not transmute.** When the game answered "cannot be transmuted", Ogre IM waited, warned that the item "did not go" and said it was retrying when it was not. Now it skips the item at once with a quiet line, and remembers it so later runs this session do not try it again.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Ogre IM waits for a free cast bar before transmuting.** If OgreBot was casting a buff when Ogre IM wanted to transmute, the Transmute cast never went out. Ogre IM then clicked the item anyway and reported that it did not go. Now it waits for the cast bar and clicks only once its own Transmute cast has finished.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **The solo HO puts every box's HO settings back when it ends.** When a solo HO (DoHO) ended, a box whose profile had never saved its HO settings kept the ones the solo HO set: the other boxes were left with HO start and starter off, and the box that ran it with them on. Every box now goes back to what it had before.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **The padlock on a window's title bar shows whether it is locked.** The title-bar padlock always showed a closed lock and only changed colour, so an unlocked window looked locked. It now shows an open padlock while the window is unlocked, including after Reset.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **An IC walk waits while OgreBot loots a stuck mob.** When OgreBot walked over to loot a mob stuck at low health, it stopped IC's walk and the zone failed. The walk now waits until OgreBot is done, then carries on to the same spot.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **Closing the Instance Controller stops all of it.** `ogre end ic`, `ogre ic end` and closing the window did nothing while a list waited between zones, for example a loop list waiting in the guild hall for a lockout. The group then went to the next zone when its timer ran out. Now they stop the list there too, the End button works while the list waits, and closing the window also cancels a call to the guild hall or a camp that the end of the list started.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **Four Rage of Cthurath heroics walk their trash sweeps by nav.** Ver'Bohten Atoll, Coral Roost, Realm of Conquest and Zruul's Dominion walked their trash sweeps in straight lines, so a group member could get stuck on a wall and the zone failed. Those walks now use the navmesh, like the rest of the Rage of Cthurath zones.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **IC finishes the trash before buffing up for a named.** When the group was still fighting trash as a named's step began, IC skipped the buff-up, walked to the kill spot with the trash in tow and pulled the named straight out of that fight. It now holds until the fight is over, then buffs up, walks to the kill spot and pulls.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **IC never sends the group into lava to loot or to res.** After a named, IC went to loot the corpses around it, including corpses lying in lava, and the group died there. Then it kept sending people back to the bodies in the lava to res them. Now a corpse or a shiny lying in lava is left where it is (unless it can be looted from where the group stands), and a member who died in lava revives instead of waiting there for a res.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **IC no longer walks the group into lava to fight a named.** When a named stood in lava, IC walked the group up to it and fought it there, and the group died in the lava. Now the group stops on the dry ground nearest the named, or pulls it from where it stands if there is none close.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **IC waits for a member far away before clicking a teleporter.** When two members were stranded below a teleporter, IC brought one back and then clicked the next teleporter before it got to the second one, and the zone failed. Now, before clicking a teleporter, IC waits up to 20 seconds while a member is 30 m or more away, so that member is brought back first.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **IC walks close enough to open a chest.** Sometimes IC stopped right at the edge of looting range, OgreBot thought the chest was too far to open, and after three tries the chest was left behind. IC now walks well inside the range, goes right up to the chest if it still has not opened, and judges the range the same way OgreBot does. Corpses and shinies are the same.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **Nobody moves while the group goes through a teleporter.** After a teleporter, members could follow the leader before the leader had come through, and run off the landing. Now nobody's follow or camp spot moves them while the click is out. Once everyone has landed, follow is released and each one gets a camp spot where it stands.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **Pause for no-trade shinies works for the whole IC run.** With Pause for no-trade shinies ticked, a shiny the bot picked up outside a shinies step was looted, no-trade item and all. Now, for the whole run, a no-trade item from any shiny is left in its open window and IC pauses for you, while corpses and chests loot as your settings say.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **The chest wait no longer gives up while corpses are being looted.** After a named with a lot of adds, the loot driver can spend half a minute looting corpses before it gets to the chest. The Instance Controller counted that as "nothing happened" and gave up on the chest. Now it waits while the driver keeps looting, and gives up only after 10 seconds with nothing looted.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **Zone loot waits keep waiting while corpses are still being looted.** A zone file's wait for loot could move the group on part-way through a big pile of corpses, because its time limit counted from the start of the wait. The limit now counts from the last corpse or chest OgreBot opened, so the wait lasts as long as the looting goes on.
- **Fixed** · Navigation: **A group member no longer waits at a door for a leader who went another way.** At a door that takes the whole group through on the leader's click, a member coming from somewhere else waited for the leader even after the leader had reached a later zone by another way, and the zone-in gave up. The member now goes through by itself when the leader is already further along the route.
- **Fixed** · Navigation: **Navigation steps down off things it cannot walk on.** A toon knocked up onto machinery or clutter that navigation cannot walk on was stranded there: every walk from it said the destination was unreachable, and an Instance Controller run could fail on it. Now navigation starts the walk on the floor below, up to 35 m down, and the toon steps off the edge and carries on.
- **Fixed** · Navigation: **One failed take-off no longer stops a toon flying in a zone.** A take-off that gained no height, for example right after a fight, marked the whole zone as no-fly for that toon for 12 hours, so every trip there walked. A zone the toon has already flown in now stays a flying zone, and only that one trip walks.
- **Fixed** · Navigation: **The bot never picks a spot to stand next to lava.** A named standing in lava sent the group to dry ground only 0.1 m from the lava, so the group stopped on the lava and burned. Spots to stand within range of something now stay at least 4 m from lava. With no such spot, the group pulls from where it is.
- **Fixed** · Navigation: **Travel goes round a slope it keeps sliding off.** Some slopes look walkable on the map but are too steep to climb. A character walking up one kept sliding off, tried the same way again, and finally gave up. Now, the second time it slides off the same spot, it goes another way if there is one.

- **Fixed** · Windows: **The mouse wheel no longer skips rows in a small list.** In a list only a few rows high, such as the zone list in a small IC window, one turn of the mouse wheel jumped about five rows, so some were never seen. One turn now moves at most the list's height less one row, so every row comes into view. Taller lists scroll as before, in every Ogre window.

Anywhere within 30 m of that spot now counts, as long as you are within 5 m of its height, so the level past the first teleporter still does not.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **IC waits for a chest that appears late.** After a named died, IC looked for its chest once and walked on when none was there yet, so a chest that appeared a few seconds later was left behind. It now waits up to 8 seconds after the kill for a chest to appear before moving on.
- **Fixed** · Navigation: **Navigation walks over walkways and steps made of objects again.** Navigation no longer treats a walkway, ramp or step built from placed objects as a wall to go round. In Ver'Bohten Atoll this stopped every Instance Controller run at the walk to the teleporter. Crates, depots and other objects you cannot walk over are still walked round.

## 2026.11.12.001 {#r2026-11-12-001}

*Thursday, November 12, 2026 at 2:13 AM EST*

- **New** · Bot: **A class change moves adornments onto bare gear.** After a class change, before your gear goes on, each bare piece of gear gets the adornments from this character's other piece for that slot; one that will not fit goes back. Recheck adornments on the Persona tab does the same for what you wear now, taking each piece off and putting it back on. Each move is written to the log, and Move adornments onto bare gear on the Persona tab turns it off.
- **New** · Bot: **Each class of a character keeps its own gear.** The bot remembers what each class of a character wears, and after a class change it puts that gear back on from your bags. A piece the game refuses is listed once and kept for later. The Persona tab shows what is saved, has Restore and Save buttons, and can keep persona gear in the bags you choose.
- **New** · Bot: **Log in as a chosen class, or change class with ogre persona.** `ogre <toon>`, `ogre bot`, `ogre login` and -LogToonIn take a class (-c ranger), and an auto-login row can name a server and a class. `ogre persona <class>` changes the class of the character you are on. No class logs in whatever it was, and a class the character does not have stops with a message.
- **New** · Bot: **Persona gear follows your upgrades and never leaves a slot empty.** New gear you put on one class also replaces the old piece on every other class that wore it, with the old piece kept as a fallback. After a class change, a slot whose saved piece will not go on gets the piece it replaced or another class's piece for that slot. A slot still empty is an OgreConsole error with a ding.
- **New** · Bot: **Persona gear never forgets a slot you emptied.** A piece you bank or delete stays in that class's saved gear, so the next restore puts it back, wears a fallback, or warns you with a ding. To leave a slot empty on purpose, press Clear saved gear on the Persona tab: after you confirm, only what the class is wearing now is kept.
- **New** · Bot: **The Persona window and tab say which profile each class uses.** `ogre persona` opens a window where you can say which profile file each class uses on this PC, for example all rangers use `master_ranger.json`, for every server or one. OgreBot's new Persona tab shows the file this character uses in each class and why, and lets you give it its own. A change applies the next time that class loads.
- **New** · Windows: **HUDs:SetOption takes the update lock.** HUDs:SetOption takes a fifth argument, minUpdateSecs, so a raid message line ignores further writes for that long. A call without a slot and text now prints a usage line instead of doing nothing.
- **New** · Crafting: **Stop crafting on other boxes.** OgreBotAPI.Craft:Stop and the -OgreCraft_Stop console command stop crafting on the boxes you name, to match the start commands.
- **New** · Console: **-AutoCurse, -AutoCure and -AutoGroupCure take options, and -AutoCureRemove cancels them.** -AutoCurse, -AutoCure and -AutoGroupCure now take -AutoRemove (seconds the request lasts) and -tag, and -AutoGroupCure takes kinds (arcane, elemental, noxious, trauma, or a e n t) and -count: it casts only when at least that many of the group carry one kind. -AutoCureRemove cancels the requests for a toon or tag. A word these rows do not know now refuses the request with one console line, not silently ignored.
- **New** · Other: **ogretimer has MinutesLeft and DeciLeft.** A converted script that read MinutesLeft or DeciLeft from the old timer object now works after changing only its variable line. MinutesLeft is whole minutes left; DeciLeft is the seconds left with one decimal.
- **Changed** · Bot: **"The accept-quest command accepts even with Do not auto accept quests ticked".** The Do not auto accept quests box now stops only the automatic accept of a quest offer. When you or a script run the accept-quest command, it accepts the offered quest whether or not the box is ticked. Before, the box stopped the command too, and it did nothing without a word.
- **Changed** · Bot: **A camp spot formation needs its centre.** CampSpot:SetFormation with no centre made each character the centre of its own ring, so no ring formed. The x, y and z are now required: a script that leaves them out gets one line and nothing moves. The console formation commands still send your position as the centre.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Assist.IsAssisting reads FALSE with Auto Assist off.** With the Auto Assist box off nobody drives your target, so Assist.IsAssisting now reads FALSE and Assist.InControl reads TRUE, whatever the assist list or anchor says.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Boxes no longer replay a backlog of messages when they reach the world.** A box at the login screen, character select or a loading screen used to keep every message other boxes sent and play the whole pile back when it reached the world. It now reads its messages all the time. Notices, tag changes and group updates are handled at once, a cast or script event that arrives out of the world is thrown away, and a changed MCP file is read once on arrival.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Cast-on-the-move announcements need their seconds.** Abilities:AnnounceCasted and Abilities:AnnounceCasting with no seconds, 0 seconds or a word sent an announcement that did nothing on any box. They now print one line and send nothing; AnnounceCasted also says so when no caster is given.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Class:ChangeValue takes auto and says what it refused.** ISXOgreEQ2.Class:ChangeValue and Roster:SetClassValue now take auto, which removes an override so the class check reads what the game says again. A name that is not an archetype, class or subclass, or a value that is not TRUE, FALSE or auto, prints one line and changes nothing, the same line from both.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Comms:Query no longer asks the bot's own loot and quest questions.** A script could send Comms:Query with lootBid or questSteps, the questions the loot sharing and quest compare use for themselves, and every box answered with the script's values. Those two are now refused for scripts, as an unknown question is.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Cures.GroupCurses no longer counts a dead member.** Cures.GroupCurses, and RaidCurses outside a raid, counted a dead group member with a curse. They now skip the dead, as RaidCurses always did in a raid, so an encounter that waits on the number of cursed members is not held up by a corpse.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Evac says why it did not evacuate.** -Evac without totem did nothing, silently, on a character with no class evac or with it not ready. Each such character now prints one line saying which.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Flags are numbered 1 to 24.** Roster:Flag and Roster:Unflag took any number, so 0, a negative or a word set a flag nobody could use. A number outside 1 to 24 is now refused with one line; 24 is still the mark.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Removing a mob from the no-offensive list is on Combat now.** OgreBotAPI.Combat:RemoveNoOffensive takes a mob off the no-offensive list, beside Combat:AddNoOffensive and Combat:ClearNoOffensive. The root OgreBotAPI:AddNoOffensiveOn and RemoveNoOffensiveOn were second names and are retired; the -AddNoOffensiveOn and -RemoveNoOffensiveOn commands work as before.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Roster counts and picks match by class when no mode is given.** The Roster group and raid counts, picks and sorts matched everyone when the mode was left out or mistyped. No mode now means Class, as in OldBot, a mode word the bot does not know matches nobody, and All still matches everyone.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Roster name picks skip a dead member, like the id picks.** With a dead member in the group, the Roster name picks counted the corpse while the id picks and the counts skipped it, so the same rank could name two different people. Every group pick now skips a corpse, so a name and an id at the same rank are the same member.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Targeting.SavedList counts from 1.** ISXOgreEQ2.Targeting.SavedList[1] is now the first saved auto-target list, the same as AutoTarget.SavedName. 0 or a word reads empty instead of the first list.
- **Changed** · Bot: **The queue no longer takes ClickInstant or Loot.** ISXOgreEQ2.Queue:Add and Queue.Enqueue took the kinds ClickInstant and Loot, handed back an id, and then dropped the entry without running it. They are no kinds now, so the queue refuses them as unknown, like any other word.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Turning cures on or off leaves the stunned option alone.** Cures:SetEnabled also ticked or unticked Use these while stunned, stifled or rooted. It now changes only cures, and that option stays as you set it.
- **Changed** · Windows: **Ogre windows are drawn inside each game; ogre ui exe saves memory.** Ogre's windows are now drawn inside each game, not by OgreUltralight.exe, which could max out a CPU core with many games running and which Windows sometimes would not start. To save about 150 MB per game, tick Draw Ogre windows in OgreUltralight.exe in ogre config, or type ogre ui exe on, then restart the game. If the windows cannot start, the console says why and a window offers the help page or the other way of drawing them.
- **Changed** · Windows: **ShowConsole closes the console only for a no.** Windows:ShowConsole closed the console for any word that was not a yes, so show or a typo closed it. Now only FALSE, 0, no or off closes it; anything else opens it.
- **Changed** · Windows: **The ISXOgre Account login locks once saved.** The Account tab in Ogre Options is now called ISXOgre Account, and a saved username and password come up locked so they are not changed by accident. Edit unlocks them and Save saves what you typed. Saving a new login, from Ogre Options or a script, never logs out a session that is logged in: the new login is used the next time it loads.
- **Changed** · Navigation: **A script's travel route moves with OgreBot closed.** A route a script starts with ISXOgreEQ2.TravelMesh:Go now moves while OgreBot is closed, as a tool's route already did; TravelMesh:Stop ends it. Before, it planned and then stood still until OgreBot opened or Movement:UseWithoutOgreBot was set. OgreBot's own travel commands still need OgreBot open.
- **Changed** · Navigation: **Nav.NavWaypoint and NavWaypoints replace NavLeg and NavHop.** The route progress reads are now ISXOgreEQ2.Nav.NavWaypoint (the waypoint being walked to) and ISXOgreEQ2.Nav.NavWaypoints (how many there are). NavLeg, NavLegs, NavHop and NavHops, two names for the same pair, are gone.
- **Changed** · Navigation: **The travel route preview is a command that prints.** ISXOgreEQ2.TravelMesh:Preview[destination] plans a route and prints it to the console, one hop per line, without moving. It was the TMPreview member, which a script read as text. TMFeatures and TMParty now answer from what the travel engine read in the last second, so reading them can never touch the game.
- **Changed** · Crafting: **AddRecipeListFromFile adds to your queue.** ISXOgreEQ2.Craft:AddRecipeListFromFile now adds the saved queue's recipes to the setup queue, as its name and the classic verb say, instead of replacing it. The Load Queue button on the craft window still replaces the queue.
- **Changed** · Crafting: **Crafting mats list warnings come from the commands.** A problem in a crafting mats list file is printed every time ogre craftingmats runs a list, plans, or reloads. Reading ISXOgreEQ2.CraftingMats from a script no longer prints it; the Warnings member still holds it.
- **Changed** · Console: **-AutoCure and -AutoCurse need a toon name.** With no toon named they did nothing and said nothing. They now print one line saying a toon is needed.
- **Changed** · Console: **-LogToonIn takes the box's name, not the For Who window.** -LogToonIn's first word names one box, by its session or character, so the For Who window no longer fills it. Left blank, it now says what it needs instead of doing nothing.
- **Changed** · Console: **CheckMountTraining no longer takes a force argument.** The force argument of -CheckMountTraining and Consumables:CheckMountTraining was never read: every press runs the check. It is gone, and a converted script that passes it has it dropped.
- **Changed** · Console: **CompareQuest is asked by the box that sends it.** -CompareQuest naming one box made that box the asker and then asked only that same box, which compared nothing. Now the box that sends the line asks, and the for-who names who is asked, with all or blank asking the rest of your group. A missing quest name prints a line instead of comparing a quest called No_such_quest.
- **Changed** · Console: **F2PWindow_SetOptions no longer takes a number of minutes.** The minutes number did nothing, and the console command passed 15 every time, so every use printed a line saying it was ignored. The number is gone: the command just turns on the upsell window watcher.
- **Changed** · Console: **IRC commands that are not run here go to the Commands tab.** An IRC command that this PC does not run - one for another connection, or one from a sender who is not authorized here - now shows in the Commands tab instead of Chat, with the reason after it ("not run: for another connection", or "not run: Name is not authorized here (-auth Name to allow it)"). Chat now holds only chat.
- **Changed** · Console: **IRC-only console commands say they are IRC only.** The auth, session and auto-login commands run only over IRC. Typed with the For Who picker on OgreConsole they now say they are IRC only, and other commands with nothing to run no longer suggest IRC.
- **Changed** · Console: **ogre end irc says it asked the hub to disconnect.** Comms:IrcDisconnect, and so ogre end irc, used to print that IRC was disconnected even when the hub was not connected. It now says it asked the hub to disconnect, and the hub reports what happened on the uplink.
- **Changed** · Setup: **ISXOgreX.Login:Submit says when the user or password is missing.** Login:Submit with a missing username or password did nothing and said nothing. It now prints one warning.
- **Changed** · Other: **ISXOgreX.UI methods say when an argument is missing.** UI:Set, UI:Open, UI:Close, UI:Load, UI:Eval and UI:EvalFile did nothing and said nothing when an argument was missing. Each now prints one warning naming what it needs.
- **Changed** · Other: **Queue.Entry and EntryJSON count from 1.** ISXOgreEQ2.Queue.Entry[1] and EntryJSON[1] are now the first entry and Entry[Count] the last, so a loop from 1 to Count reads the whole queue. 0 reads empty.
- **Changed** · Other: **The ogretimer extra-argument warning is said once per script.** An ogretimer set with a name or event after the time warns that only a countdown is kept. It used to warn once per session, so a second converted script never heard; now each script is told once.
- **Changed** · Other: **Util.RoundToNearest rounds a half up and keeps 0.** Util.RoundToNearest rounded an exact half down, so 45 to the nearest 10 gave 40, and it turned 0 and any negative into 1 first. It now rounds a half up, so 45 gives 50, and rounds 0 and negative values as they are.
- **Changed** · Other: **Util.SecondsToHMS shows days and seconds.** Util.SecondsToHMS dropped days and seconds, started with a space under an hour, and was empty under a minute. It now gives timer text such as 1d 2h 5m 30s, leaves out a part that is 0, and gives 0s for nothing.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Auto Hunt pulls only with an ability that reaches the mob.** Auto Hunt now skips a pull ability that cannot reach the mob and tries the next one in your list. With Scan Radius left blank, it looks only as far as your longest pull reaches, instead of 35.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **AutoTarget Active reads FALSE when nothing will be picked.** OgreBotAPI.AutoTarget.Active read TRUE out of combat with out-of-combat scanning off, when auto-target would pick nothing. It now also needs scanning to be allowed: out-of-combat scanning on, something hating you, or combat.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **AutoTarget AddActor keeps the default for a mistyped yes or no.** AutoTarget:AddActor read a mistyped yes or no as FALSE, so a typo turned Aggro On Group Only off. A word that is not a yes or no now keeps that setting's default.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **AutoTarget list name follows the list.** OgreBotAPI.AutoTarget.ListName was blank after LoadPreset and kept a saved list's name after you added or removed entries. It now names the built-in list after LoadPreset, and goes blank as soon as the list is edited, since it then matches no saved list.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **AutoTarget saved-list verbs say why they did nothing.** AutoTarget:LoadSaved, AutoTarget:Save and AutoTarget:DeleteSaved did nothing without a word for a blank name, a list the zone does not have, or a save that could not be written. Each now prints one line saying why.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Camp spot option checks see a change made during a pause.** CampSpot.ValidOptions and ValidOptionsCommon kept the Allow Camp Spot and Dynamic Camp Spot values from before a pause, a movement block or a death. They now read the two options when asked.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **CastHOIcon with no icon says so.** Abilities:CastHOIcon with no icon id did nothing without a word. It now prints one line; -2 and an icon no ready ability matches still do nothing quietly.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Changing an alias that does not exist says so.** ForWho:ChangeAlias announced a change even when no alias had that name. It now changes nothing and prints one line saying there is no such alias.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **CollectShiny collects only shinies.** -CollectShiny picked the nearest actor with a question mark anywhere in its name, which could be an NPC. It now uses the same shiny test as the Loot tab.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Come2Me with a name that finds nobody says so.** Movement:Come2Me with a name that matches nobody here did nothing, and said so only with a debug option on. It now prints one line on the console and does not move.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Countdown keeps its seconds between 1 and 30.** -countdown with a number below 1, such as -5, sent it to the game as it was. A number below 1 now counts down from 1 and one over 30 from 30, with a line saying so.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Cure potions only answer to the four cure types.** Cures.PotionAvailable took any word as a cure type and matched it as part of an item name, so a short or mistyped type could find the wrong potion. It now answers only for arcane, elemental, noxious or trauma, and anything else reads FALSE.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Cures.RaidCursedIDs lists every cursed group member outside a raid.** Outside a raid, Cures.RaidCursedIDs listed only the group members whose curse cannot be cured. It now lists every cursed group member, curable or not, the same question it answers in a raid.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Cures.RaidUncurable counts your group outside a raid.** Outside a raid, Cures.RaidUncurable always read 0, while RaidUncurableIDs and RaidCurses answered for your group. It now counts the group members with an uncurable curse, so the count and the list agree.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **DoVDebuff knows the debuff range from the first call.** DoVDebuff read the debuff range from the game server, which reads nothing until the game has sent it, and nothing counted as in range. It now uses the ability export, so a mob out of range is walked to (or skipped) every time.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **DrinkAlcohol says when there is nothing to drink.** Consumables:DrinkAlcohol with no drink named, or a drink not in your bags, did nothing and said nothing. Both now print one line.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **FaceActor says when there is nobody to face.** Movement:FaceActor and -FaceActor did nothing, silently, when the actor was not here or none was given. Each now prints one line.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **ForceAliasUpdate refreshes aliases again.** ForWho:ForceUpdate (the -ForceAliasUpdate console command) did nothing. It now drops the cached alias answers, so the next alias is worked out against the group as it is right now.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Hail with a name that finds nobody hails nobody.** Actors:Hail with a mistyped name hailed the nearest NPC you can hail instead. It now prints one line and hails nobody, and a blank still hails the nearest.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **HO icon verbs refuse a word.** HOs:AllowIcon, ClearAllowIcon, DisableIcon and ClearDisableIcon read a word as icon 0 and changed that icon. A word that is not a number is now refused with one line and changes nothing.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **ItemCure any drinks whatever is needed.** Cures:ItemCure with the type any printed that any is not a cure type and did nothing, while RequestItem took any as whatever is needed. ItemCure now reads any the same way as a blank type.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Mercenary training leaves your mercenary out.** CheckMercenaryTraining sent your mercenary away at the end even when you had it out before the check. It now suspends the mercenary only when the check was the one that summoned it.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **MountDown does nothing on foot.** Consumables:MountDown toggled summon_mount whatever you were doing, so on foot it could call up a mount. It now prints one line and stops when you are not mounted.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **No "cannot write pulse-budget.json" error when boxes load together.** Boxes that loaded at the same time could show a red "pulsebudget: cannot write pulse-budget.json" line. The bot now writes that file at load only when it has a new section to add. If a write still fails, the line now gives the Windows error number.
