- **Fixed** · Bot: **No false comms warning at login.** A box that sent a message at the login screen could print "comms egress is BLIND" the moment it reached the world, although its messages were coming back fine. A box now reads the messages sent to it all the time, at the login screen and character select too, so it hears its own messages come back. The warning appears only when they really never do.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **On-screen timers outside slots 1 to 10 use the nearest slot.** Util:OnScreenTimer and OnScreenTimerReset with a slot below 1 or above 10 did nothing, without a word. A slot below 1 now uses slot 1 and one above 10 uses slot 10.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **One Overseer run completes, adds and starts your missions.** Mission scrolls that arrive from this run's rewards, like Heritage Hunt, are now added and started in the same run, instead of needing a second and third run. After adding a mission, the bot also waits for it to show in the quest list before reading the list again.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Quest helper counts start from 0 each run.** The quest helper hail, click and reply counts ran from when the extension loaded while the status said this run. They now start from 0 each time the helper starts.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Quest helper reload says when no file was read.** ogre quest reload claimed the rules were loaded even when no reply file could be read. It now says no file was read and that the rules from before are kept.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Quest.ActorHas needs an actor id.** Quest.ActorHas with no id asked about actor 0 and answered FALSE, which read as that NPC has no quest. It now prints a line saying an actor id is needed, and still answers FALSE.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Research waits for level 20.** Below level 20 the bot no longer tries to open research, which the game refuses with "Access to research is not available until level 20".
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Reset Camera no longer fights a camera pitch.** Client:ResetCamera, and the -ResetCameraAngle command, used to set the pitch straight away even while a Client:SetCameraPitch was still moving the camera, so the two could fight over the view. In third person it now goes the same way SetCameraPitch does and says so instead of starting while one is running.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Revive leaves a living character alone.** -Revive with no revive point clicked the death window's Revive button even on a character that was alive. A living character now clicks nothing.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **SpewResearchWindow leaves your open research window open.** SpewResearchWindow closed the Knowledge window at the end even when you had it open already. It now closes only a window it opened.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **The AutoHunt setters say when they set nothing.** AutoHunt:SetScanRadius, SetCheckHP and SetCheckMana did nothing and said nothing with no value or no profile loaded, and stored any text. Both now print one line, and an odd value is stored made safe (a health or power percent between 0 and 100, a radius of 0 or more) with a line saying what is set.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **The invite auto-accept says whose invites it takes.** ogre afk invites on said it accepts invites from characters on your accounts only. It accepts any name on your characters list, auth-only names included, and the line and the help now say so.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **The queue names its real kinds when it does not know one.** ISXOgreEQ2.Queue:Add with a kind it does not know printed a hand-typed list of kinds. The line now lists exactly the kinds the queue accepts, spelled as they are written: CastAbility, CastItem, ClickInstant, ClickCastBar, RawCommand, Loot, Movement and Flow.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **The zone-in mount summon waits for the cast bar.** The mount summon after a zone-in or an OgreBot load now waits its turn for the cast bar, like the familiar summon, so it no longer cuts into another cast or into a persona gear change. If the mount is already up by its turn, nothing is sent.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **Choice window picks only choice 1 or 2.** Windows:Choice with a number other than 1 or 2 asked the game for a choice that does not exist. A number below 1 now picks 1 and one above 2 picks 2, with a line saying which.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **Dungeon Maker and Proving Grounds buttons click only when the window is open.** Windows:DungeonMakerCancel, Windows:ProvingGroundsExit and Windows:ProvingGroundsScoreboardClose clicked their button whether or not the window was open, which put an error in the Inner Space console. They now click only when the button is on screen.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **HUDs:Test shows the demo at once.** HUDs:Test with TRUE did nothing while the HUD overlay was closed. It now opens the overlay and shows the five demo lines at once, and FALSE clears them at once.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **OSA:Target says when it has no id.** ISXOgreEQ2.OSA:Target with no actor id did nothing and said nothing. It now prints one line.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **Potency window interval keeps its setting on a typo.** PotCb:Interval with a word set the fastest, most expensive 50 ms interval, and a negative number set the slowest. A word now keeps the interval in force and says so, and a negative number is 50 ms.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **Reading SelectOption no longer prints a line.** Every read of OgreBotAPI.Windows.SelectOption printed a line to the console, so a script checking it in a loop flooded the console. Reading it now prints nothing; the Select verb still says what it picked.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **The MCP window says why it did not open.** When the in-game UI host was not running or a window file could not be read, the MCP window opened nothing and said so only in the log file. It now prints one console line naming what is missing, and a missing command catalog says the builder opens empty.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **IC RunList refuses a row the queue does not have.** IC:RunList with a word, 0, or a row past the end started the whole list from the top without a word. It now prints that there is no such row and how many the queue has, and starts nothing.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **IC.Value tells an empty value from a missing one.** ISXOgreEQ2.IC.Value read NULL for a value that is there but empty, such as blank IC File Args, the same as for a key that does not exist. An empty value now reads empty, and ogre ic value prints it as empty.
- **Fixed** · Navigation: **A move to a coordinate that is not a number is refused.** ISXOgreEQ2.Nav:To, Movement:ToLoc and Movement:NavTo read a coordinate that was a word as 0, sending the character toward the middle of the zone. Each coordinate now has to be a number; otherwise the move prints an error and does not start.
- **Fixed** · Navigation: **A travel bias that is not a number no longer bans that kind of hop.** ISXOgreEQ2.TravelMesh:SetBias with a word, such as low, read as 0, which forbids that kind of hop for the session. A value that is not a number now sets the normal bias of 1 and says so. Only a typed 0 or less forbids.
- **Fixed** · Navigation: **Nav distance is measured to where you asked to go.** On foot, Nav.NavDistance measured to the end of the planned route, which stops short of the destination when the route is partial. It now measures to the destination, as it already did when flying.
- **Fixed** · Navigation: **Nav readouts clear when a trip ends.** After a trip arrived or stopped, Nav.NavOnMesh stayed TRUE and NavLeg and NavLegs kept the finished route, and ogre nav status said it was driving the trip. They now read FALSE, 0 and 0 once the trip is over.
- **Fixed** · Navigation: **Setting a travel account feature checks its name.** TravelMesh:SetFeature and -TravelMeshFeatures saved any feature name, so a typo was stored and did nothing. A name the travel data does not use is now refused with a line naming the ones it does, and any capitalisation of a real name works.
- **Fixed** · Navigation: **Setting a travel account feature needs its yes or no.** -TravelMeshFeatures and TravelMesh:SetFeature with a feature name and no TRUE or FALSE saved the feature as no, and it was never scanned again. They now print an error and change nothing.
- **Fixed** · Navigation: **The last waypoint of a trip reads N of N.** ogre nav status and Nav.NavLeg never reached the waypoint count: the last leg read one less, because the count held the start point too. NavLegs now counts the waypoints after the start, so the last leg reads N of N.
- **Fixed** · Crafting: **Clearing the craft queue tells scripts.** Clearing the setup queue, loading a queue over it, or a run clearing your rows dropped them without the queue-updated event, so a script following it never saw them go. Each dropped row now fires it, as a remove does.
- **Fixed** · Crafting: **Craft reload keeps a change you just made.** A craft setting changed less than a second before ogre craft reload was lost. Reload now saves it first.
- **Fixed** · Crafting: **Craft shop errands wait for the world and a quiet crafter.** ogre craft shop started an errand at character select or while a crafting run was going, beside the run's own errands. It now prints one line and starts nothing in both cases.
- **Fixed** · Crafting: **Craft stop with nothing running says so.** ogre craft stop and the Stop button printed nothing when no run was going, and a pause made while idle stayed on and held a shop errand. Stop now drops the pause and prints one line.
- **Fixed** · Crafting: **Craft:Set refuses a key that is not a setting.** ogre craft set saved a mistyped key and said it was set, though nothing ever read it. A key that is not a craft setting now prints one line and saves nothing, and any capitalisation of a real key works.
- **Fixed** · Crafting: **Quiver.Status shows the depot pull.** Quiver.Status read idle while ammo was being pulled from the depot. It now reads pulling ammo from the depot until that half is done.
- **Fixed** · Crafting: **Saved craft queues stay in their folder.** A craft queue name with a folder or drive in it was saved or loaded outside your queues folder. Only the last part of the name is used now.
- **Fixed** · Crafting: **ScribeRecipe takes a scroll name with a comma.** Craft:ScribeRecipe from a script cut an unquoted scroll name at its first comma and found nothing to scribe. It now reads the whole name.
- **Fixed** · Console: **-Tell sends from the For Who window by default.** A bare -Tell used a placeholder word as the sender and matched nobody, so nothing happened. The sender is now a for-who that uses the For Who window, and a missing target or message says so.
- **Fixed** · Console: **-unauth and -KillSession take the word after them.** The nick after -unauth and the session after -KillSession were left over and reported as unknown commands. They now belong to the command, and the -auth argument is named nick.
- **Fixed** · Console: **ChangeZoneTo says when the name is not in your group.** -ChangeZoneTo with a name that is not in your group did nothing without a word. It now prints one line saying so.
- **Fixed** · Console: **Loot mode commands wait for the world.** -SetAutoLootMode and -ChangeLootOptions sent their game commands at character select or while zoning too. They now send nothing until your character is in the world.
- **Fixed** · Console: **ogre dets help names the flag that skips server reads.** The ogre dets usage line and its row showed -info, as if Name and Description were extra. They are read by default, a server read each, and the help now shows -noinfo, the flag that skips them.
- **Fixed** · Console: **Saved MCP buttons that used a changed or retired console command work again.** A saved MCP button using a console command changed or retired today printed "Unknown command entered" or named nobody. On the next load each is updated once to the command as it is now: a merged one becomes the one it joined, a value a command no longer takes is dropped (-Invite with TRUE becomes -RaidInvite), and -LogToonIn auto or -LoginAtCharacterSelect logs the character in on its own box. One with no replacement (-Pull, -OSExecute) keeps only its name, and one console line lists those.
- **Fixed** · Console: **Select_Zone_Version says when the window is not open.** -Select_Zone_Version with the select zone version window closed looked the same as a press that worked. It now prints one line saying the window is not open.
- **Fixed** · Console: **SetAutoLootMode checks the mode it sends.** -SetAutoLootMode with no mode turned auto-loot off, and any text was sent to the game as typed. A missing mode now prints a line and changes nothing. A mode that is not 0, 1, 2, AN, AG or AD sets 0 (none) with a line saying so.
- **Fixed** · Setup: **Tour:Done and Tour:Skip do nothing when the tour is closed.** A Tour:Done or Tour:Skip call after the tour had finished started the migration run again each time. It now does nothing unless the tour is open.
- **Fixed** · Other: **"Coming from Classic: the converter fixes console lines that lost an argument".** -AutoCurse, -AutoGroupCure, -CheckMountTraining, -F2PWindow_SetOptions, -Invite, -RaidInvite and -LogToonIn read fewer arguments now, or read their first word differently. The converter rewrites such a line, and its sweep flags one left as it was: `-Invite all Bob TRUE` becomes `-RaidInvite all Bob`, and `-LogToonIn auto MyToon` becomes `-LogToonIn MyToon MyToon`. The coming-from-classic console page says the same.
- **Fixed** · Other: **A mistyped export flag stops the export.** Export:Abilities with a mistyped flag such as -pasive looked it up as an ability name on the server and blamed the knowledge book. A word that starts with a dash and is not a flag is now refused with one line and no export starts.
- **Fixed** · Other: **Actors.MobID answers only for an actor that is here.** Actors.MobID handed a number back as typed, even when no such actor was near. It now reads 0 for an id that is not here.
- **Fixed** · Other: **DetrimentalInfo_JSON reads its switches anywhere.** Det.DetrimentalInfo_JSON read -actorID, -maxEffects and -ExtraFields only after both icon numbers, so a call with only -actorID asked about the wrong effect on you. The switches now work in any position, and the first two other arguments are the icon pair.
- **Fixed** · Other: **ISXOgreX.UI:Load closes the windows it replaces.** Loading a different page left its windows listed as open and could run waiting desktop actions on a page that was going. Load now closes every window with reason reload, as UI:Reload does.
- **Fixed** · Other: **The spawn re-fire delay and cap stay in range.** Spawn:SetOnSpawnDelay holds the delay at 60000 ms at most, so Spawn.OnSpawnDelay reads what is really in force. Spawn:SetOnSpawnCap holds the cap between 1 and 5000: a negative number no longer sets an enormous cap, and a word keeps the cap and says so.
- **Fixed** · Other: **Util.FileExists is TRUE only for a file.** Util.FileExists was TRUE for a folder of that name, and for a blank path. It now answers TRUE only for a file, as given or with .iss added, and FALSE for a blank path.
- **Fixed** · Other: **Vars work before your character is in the world.** The Vars methods (Set, Clear and the rest) did nothing at the login screen or character select, though the values read fine. A script can now set its variables before the character is in.
- **Removed** · Bot: **Bot:Initialize is gone.** OgreBotAPI.Bot:Initialize built tables that build themselves the first time they are read. It is retired; delete the call.
- **Removed** · Bot: **CampSpot:NudgeRelativeBy is gone, SetRelativeBy stays.** OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:NudgeRelativeBy did exactly what CampSpot:SetRelativeBy does: add to the relative offset. It is retired; use SetRelativeBy. The -CS_Set_ChangeRelativeCampSpotBy command works as before.
- **Removed** · Bot: **CastStack Enable, Disable, EnableTag and DisableTag are gone.** These four did what CastStack:SetEntry and CastStack:SetEntryByTag do, without their toggle, silent and partial options. They are retired; use SetEntry and SetEntryByTag.
- **Removed** · Bot: **CastStack Run, Pause and Running are gone.** OgreBotAPI.CastStack:Run, :Pause and .Running were the bot pause under second names. They are retired; use Bot:Resume, Bot:Pause and Bot.Paused. The mini toolbar pause button already uses them and works as before.
- **Removed** · Bot: **CastStack:CancelCurrentCast is gone.** OgreBotAPI.CastStack:CancelCurrentCast did what Abilities:SetCancelCurrentCast with TRUE does. It is retired; use Abilities:SetCancelCurrentCast.
- **Removed** · Bot: **CastStack:LoadDemo is gone.** OgreBotAPI.CastStack:LoadDemo replaced the cast stack with one test entry. It was a developer tool and is retired.
- **Removed** · Bot: **CheckToShare is gone, ShareQuestsForZone does its job.** Quest:CheckToShare was a second name for Zone:ShareQuestsForZone and broke on a quote in the zone name. It is retired, and a converted Classic CheckToShareQuest call now goes to Zone:ShareQuestsForZone.
- **Removed** · Bot: **Combat.MaybeAnotherTime is gone.** OgreBotAPI.Combat.MaybeAnotherTime was a copy of Combat.NoOffensive that nothing called. It is retired; use Combat.NoOffensive.
- **Removed** · Bot: **Debug.Version is gone, ISXOgreEQ2.Version is the version.** OgreBotAPI.Debug.Version returned the same text as ISXOgreEQ2.Version under a second name, so it is retired. Read ISXOgreEQ2.Version instead; Debug.CheckVersion still compares versions across your boxes, and a converted Classic Version read now points at ISXOgreEQ2.Version.
- **Removed** · Bot: **IM.IsActive is gone, IsRunning stays.** OgreBotAPI.IM.IsActive was a second name for IM.IsRunning. It is retired; read IM.IsRunning.
- **Removed** · Bot: **Loot:Load is gone, Loot:Reload stays.** OgreBotAPI.Loot:Load did exactly what Loot:Reload does. It is retired; use Loot:Reload, which the loot messages now name.
- **Removed** · Bot: **Movement.PointToward is gone, Position.Toward stays.** OgreBotAPI.Movement.PointToward worked out the same point as Position.Toward. It is retired; use Position.Toward.
- **Removed** · Bot: **OgreBot:CloseMini and :CloseAll are gone.** ISXOgreEQ2.OgreBot:CloseMini and ISXOgreEQ2.OgreBot:CloseAll both closed OgreBot entirely, the same as :Close. Use ISXOgreEQ2.OgreBot:Close; the two other names are retired.
- **Removed** · Bot: **OgreBotAPI:LoadAutoTargetList is gone, AutoTarget:LoadSaved stays.** OgreBotAPI:LoadAutoTargetList loaded the same saved Auto Target list as AutoTarget:LoadSaved. It is retired; use AutoTarget:LoadSaved. The -LoadAutoTargetList command now runs LoadSaved, so a list the zone does not have is named on the console.
- **Removed** · Bot: **Quest.DeityPoints is gone.** OgreBotAPI.Quest.DeityPoints always read 0, as the old bot did. It is retired.
- **Removed** · Bot: **Quest.SkipShinies is gone.** OgreBotAPI.Quest.SkipShinies read the Loot tab do not loot shinies box. It is retired; read that box with OgreBotAPI.Options.Value[checkbox_loot_donotlootshinies].
- **Removed** · Bot: **Session:UpdateCharacterDetails is gone.** OgreBotAPI.Session:UpdateCharacterDetails rebuilt a table the bot already keeps up to date by itself, so calling it changed nothing. It is retired; delete any call to it.
- **Removed** · Bot: **TestAll is gone.** OgreBotAPI:TestAll printed two values that do not exist in this bot, so it only ever printed blanks. It is retired, as Test was.
- **Removed** · Bot: **The -NotSoloHO option is gone.** HOs:DoSetup and HOs:DoSetEnabled took -NotSoloHO, which only did what -NoModifyOptions does. It is retired and is now ignored like any unknown option; use -NoModifyOptions.
- **Removed** · Bot: **The Auto Target rescan time is gone.** Auto Target re-checks its list every 0.25 seconds, and the Rescan time slider never changed that. The slider, AutoTarget.RescanTime, AutoTarget:SetRescanTime, the -AutoTarget_SetRescanTime command and the fight file autotarget op setRescanTime are retired. A saved rescan time stays in the profile file and is not read.
- **Removed** · Bot: **The DebugLoading switch is gone.** OgreBotAPI.Debug.DebugLoading and Debug:SetDebugLoading kept a flag that nothing in the bot looked at, so they are retired. A converted Classic Get_DebugLoading or SetDebugLoading call is marked to delete.
- **Removed** · Bot: **Zone:ToggleZoneReuse is gone, Zone:ResetUpdateInfo stays.** OgreBotAPI.Zone:ToggleZoneReuse did exactly what Zone:ResetUpdateInfo does: read the Zone Reuse window again. It is retired; use ResetUpdateInfo. The -ToggleZoneReset command works as before.
- **Removed** · Windows: **ISXOgreX.UI:Show and UI:Hide are gone.** UI:Show and UI:Hide hid or showed the whole page while every window still said it was visible, and nothing used them. They are retired; show and hide one window at a time instead.
- **Removed** · Instance Controller: **Bot:ListSetups is gone, Encounter:List stays.** OgreBotAPI.Bot:ListSetups printed the same list as Encounter:List. It is retired, and a converted Classic DisplayAvailableSetups call now goes to Encounter:List.
- **Removed** · Instance Controller: **Encounter:Stop and Encounter:DryRun are gone.** ISXOgreEQ2.Encounter:Stop and ISXOgreEQ2.Encounter:DryRun were accepted and did nothing. They are retired; ogre ic stop stops a run.
- **Removed** · Navigation: **ogre nav -v is gone.** The -v and -verbose flags of ogre nav only added the word verbose to the heading line. They are retired: ogre nav status shows how far a trip has got.
- **Removed** · Navigation: **The four movement key commands are gone.** Movement:SetForwardKey, SetBackwardKey, SetFlyUpKey and SetFlyDownKey are retired. A key they set lasted only until your key binds next loaded or changed. Set the keys in the Key Binds tab.
- **Removed** · Crafting: **ogre craft shop fuel is gone.** The fuel errand only ever found something to buy while a queue was running, and a queue run buys its own fuel. ogre craft shop now takes books, sell or destroy.
- **Removed** · Console: **-Dispell is gone: use -DispellNPCWithSpell.** -Dispell was the same command as -DispellNPCWithSpell: your class dispel on the NPC you name. Use -DispellNPCWithSpell, beside -DispellNPCWithItem and -DispellNPCWithAny.
- **Removed** · Console: **-EndScript is gone: use -EndScriptOB.** -EndScript was the same command as -EndScriptOB (also -esob). Use -EndScriptOB with the for-who first, for example -EndScriptOB all MyScript.
- **Removed** · Console: **-ExecuteEvent_JSON_AP is gone: use -ExecuteEvent_AP.** -ExecuteEvent_JSON_AP and OgreBotAPI.Comms:ExecuteEventJSON did what -ExecuteEvent_AP and Comms:ExecuteEvent do, plus a leftover test line on the console. Use -ExecuteEvent_AP and Comms:ExecuteEvent.
- **Removed** · Console: **-Message_NT is gone: use -Message.** -Message_NT printed exactly what -Message prints; neither adds a timestamp. Use -Message.
- **Removed** · Console: **-OgreConsole_ShowRequiresOgreBot is gone: use -OgreConsole_Show.** -OgreConsole_ShowRequiresOgreBot was the same command as -OgreConsole_Show, with the same for-who and value. Use -OgreConsole_Show.
- **Removed** · Console: **-Raid and -Group are gone: use -InjectChat.** -Raid and -Group were a copy of -InjectChat that read the chat text as the for-who. Use -InjectChat with the for-who first, for example -InjectChat all "set up for x".
- **Removed** · Console: **-RunScriptOB_AP is gone: use -RunScriptOB.** -RunScriptOB_AP was the same command as -RunScriptOB, which also passes every argument after the script name to the script. Use -RunScriptOB.
- **Removed** · Console: **The -Pull console command is gone.** -Pull (also -Kannkor_TestPull1 and -TestPull1) never pulled anything, and OgreBotAPI.Movement:Pull did nothing either. Both are retired. An old MCP button that used it comes across with its name and no command, and the conversion lists it.
- **Removed** · Console: **The IRC -OSExecute command is gone.** -OSExecute never ran anything in this bot: the IRC hub only answered that it was disabled. The command is retired.
- **Removed** · Console: **The IRC auth commands have one name each.** -resetauth, -resetauthall and -removeauthall were second names for -unauthall, and -removeauth for -unauth. They are retired; use -unauthall and -unauth.
- **Removed** · Console: **The select window -debug flag is gone.** The -debug flag of Windows:Select and -Select_Window_AP set a switch that nothing read. It is retired, so -debug is now read as the option text like any other word; leave it off.
- **Removed** · Setup: **ISXOgreX.Options:Ready is gone.** Options:Ready refilled the open Options window and nothing called it. It is retired; Options:Open fills the window.
- **Removed** · Setup: **ogre patch class is removed.** Only nav meshes could ever be switched off, and ogre patch mesh off already does that. The class switch for the other kinds of files was saved and then ignored, so it is gone.
- **Removed** · Other: **Queue:Add no longer takes ApplyVerbCastBar or DialogChoices.** Queue:Add and Queue.Enqueue could not give these two kinds their third setting, so they always ran at their defaults. They are no longer kinds there; Actors:ApplyVerbIDQueued queues an apply-verb with its wait.

## 2026.11.08.004 {#r2026-11-08-004}

*Sunday, November 8, 2026 at 11:17 PM EST*

- **New** · Bot: **Inquisitor Verdict options are back, for epic and non-epic mobs.** The Inquisitor tab has a tick box and health % for Epic mobs and for non-Epic mobs; left blank, the % is 5 and 15. They apply to a Verdict entry in your Cast Stack of type UseInquisitorTab, and the entry's own options, such as Named NPCs Only, still apply. Run your ability export again so the type is offered.
- **New** · Bot: **One character name on several servers, and -s to choose.** A character is now its name plus its server, so the EQ2Chars tab can hold one name on several servers, with a tick marking the default. `ogre <toon>`, `ogre bot <toon>`, `ogre login <toon>` and -LogToonIn take a server, by name or short form (-s ior; `ogre login -?` lists them). Adding a new server now makes another row, so to fix a mistyped server remove the wrong row first.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Profiles have Save As, and Create now takes your changes with you.** Create now copies your current settings, unsaved changes included, and switches you to the new profile, so Save goes where you expect. Each profile also has a Save As button, which asks before overwriting any profile other than the loaded one. The profile you were on keeps what it last saved.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **A toon with Allow Camp Spot off keeps following.** A camp spot sent to the whole group no longer stops OgreFollow on a character with Allow Camp Spot off. Follow only gives way to a camp spot that character can actually use.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Auto Target when Hated leaves a dead group or raid member alone.** Targeting a dead group or raid member to res them no longer gets swapped to a mob by Auto Target when Hated. A dead mob still gives way to a mob on your group.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Changing class on a character reloads OgreBot for that class.** When the same character comes back as another class, OgreBot now reloads as it does for a character swap, instead of carrying on with the old class's cast stack. Each class and server also loads its own ability export, and one with no export gets the usual prompt to make one.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **Clicking the game releases an Ogre text box on more PCs.** On some PCs a real click on the game did not take the cursor out of an Ogre text box, so typing stayed in OgreConsole. Those clicks now count.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **Closing a window with a focused text box gives the keyboard back.** Closing, hiding or minimizing an Ogre window while its text box had the cursor left your keys stuck in that box until you clicked back in and pressed Esc. The keyboard now returns to the game.

## 2026.11.08.003 {#r2026-11-08-003}

*Sunday, November 8, 2026 at 5:21 PM EST*

- **Changed** · Bot: **An item row only uses that item's own clicky.** A Cast Stack row that names a worn item with no clicky of its own no longer clicks it, and the console says so once. If an adornment on it is the clicky, use an Equipped or Adornment row, which check the adornment's buff.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **-UseItemOnPlayer waits its turn.** -UseItemOnPlayer was lost if anything was on the cast bar at that moment. It now joins the queue like -UseItem and goes as soon as the bar is free.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **CoV waits for the cast bar.** A CoV command given while something was casting skipped the orb and carried on with no porter. It now waits until the cast bar is free, and the rotation holds off until it is done.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Item examines get longer to answer, and a failure says why.** An item examine now waits up to 6 seconds for its window instead of 2, so a slow one is read and saved instead of being left open on screen. If it still fails, the log says whether the window never opened or opened without a readable item.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Worn items in the Cast Stack are found, and a skipped item says exactly why.** A worn clicky on a Cast Stack row without Require Item Equipped now fires: every item row looks at your gear first, then your bags. The Casting debug log now says exactly why an item was skipped: not found, not equipped, adornment missing, nothing in that slot, or on its reuse timer. It also says where the item was found.

## 2026.11.08.002 {#r2026-11-08-002}

*Sunday, November 8, 2026 at 5:40 AM EST*

- **New** · Bot: **CancelCasting takes -UnlessCasting and -CastAbilityOnNPC.** CancelCasting now understands -UnlessCasting followed by an ability, the same as naming that ability to spare it, and -CastAbilityOnNPC followed by an ability and a mob, which queues that cast and then cancels. A line using either one used to cancel nothing.
- **New** · Bot: **Pass LORE items you already have to your group.** A new Leader Only box on the Loot tab, Pass LORE items I already have to the group, hands a LORE item you already have to a group member who does not have one. The bot asks the group once per chest, and only members whose bot answers can be given one. It does nothing in a raid, and the instance controller default setup ticks it.
- **New** · Windows: **MCP buttons can ask before they send.** Tick Ask when pressed in Build command, and pressing the button opens a small window with a field for each of its values, the cursor already in the first: Tab or Enter moves on, Enter on the last sends, Esc cancels, and blank keeps what the button says. Ready-made in Build command adds the old input buttons back - Assist, Ogre Follow, OgreFollow Off, CampSpot, Door, Use Item, Travel and more - and a new MCP has an Inputs page of them. A key assigned to an asking button opens the window too.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Close loot window when done is its own box.** Loot everything no longer closes the loot window, so anything the bot cannot take waits for you. The new Close loot window when done box closes a Leader Only window once the bot has finished with it. The instance controller default setup ticks it, so a run loots each chest and moves on.
- **Changed** · Instance Controller: **Queue a zone by name from one root.** ogre ic queue add custom followed by a zone name now looks for that zone in custom only, the same for test and default, so ogre ic queue add custom ${Zone.Name} works in a script. Before, anything after the root word was read as a file path and refused as no such zone file. A path ending in .json still queues that file.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **"Trakanon's Lair now follows the Raid Options box".** Trakanon's Lair is a raid, but its name has no [Raid] in it, so its fight was switched on by Enable Heroic Setups. It now follows Raid Options, like every other raid.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **"Trakanon's Lair: the hourglass goes to the right spot".** On Trakanon in Trakanon's Lair, players with the hourglass now go out to the proper spot and come back to their own spot when it falls off. Fighters and everyone else now have separate spots. Before, the fight used older positions, so the hourglass sent people to the raid's spot and fighters shared a spot with the raid.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Cast Stack target lists keep up with your group.** A group member who was still zoning in, or in another zone, was left out of the Cast Stack target list, and stayed out until the group changed again. Every member is listed by name now, wherever they are.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **CastAbilityOnNPC waits for its target, and stops if the mob is not there.** -CastAbilityOnNPC and OgreBotAPI.Abilities:CastOnNPC now target the mob, wait until it is your target, cast, and put your target back. Before, the cast went out at once and landed on whatever was selected at that moment, and a mob that could not be found still got a cast at your current target. As in the old bot, nothing is cast when the mob is missing or the ability is not ready.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Items no longer get Recovering after a spell.** An item was used the moment the previous spell finished, so the game answered Recovering and the item only went off when nothing else was casting. Every item use now waits until 0.8 seconds after the last cast, whether it comes from the Cast Stack, -UseItem, consumables, a fight file or anything else, and nothing else can take the cast bar meanwhile.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Leader Only loot no longer loops on an item it cannot take.** A chest with several copies of a LORE key kept the bot trying the same keys again and again until someone closed the window. An item that cannot be looted now gets one try and is then left in the chest, and a LORE item you already have is not tried at all. If a Smart Loot hand-out does not go through, the item goes to the next member who wants it.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **The quest helper no longer clicks zone doors.** A toon that arrived next to a zone teleporter with the quest helper on clicked it and zoned straight back out. The quest helper now skips any object whose name has the word zone, teleporter or exit, as well as everything on its ignore list. Every hail and click it makes now goes in the log file with the zone.

## 2026.11.07.001 {#r2026-11-07-001}

*Saturday, November 7, 2026 at 8:06 PM EST*

- **New** · Navigation: **Put a point in the middle of a path, or drag it to a new place.** The Paths window can now insert a point above the selected one, and you can drag a point to move it, so a change in the middle no longer means rebuilding the path. Scripts have OgreBotAPI.Paths:InsertPoint and MovePoint. The Edit button beside the Auto-Hunt path picker opens the picked path here, and so do `ogre paths` with a path name and ISXOgreEQ2.Paths:Open with the name.
- **New** · Console: **Chat commands have an ogre command.** `ogre chatcmd` starts the router that runs the commands your own characters send you in chat, and `ogre end chatcmd` stops it. It stays off until you start it. `ogre chatcmd status`, `debug`, `reloadauth` and `test` are the `ISXOgreEQ2.ChatCmd` methods of those names.
- **New** · Other: **A session can say exactly which build it runs.** `${ISXOgreEQ2.BuildHash}` and `${ISXOgreEQ2.CoreBuildHash}` give a fingerprint of the two files this session loaded, and the session log's first adapter line shows both. Two sessions with the same values run the same build.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Auto-Hunt brings the group along and camps it at your spot.** Switching Auto-Hunt on now tells the rest of your group (toons on this PC) to follow you. With Campspot or CS-JO-JI ticked, each pull camps the whole group at your spot, not wherever each toon stood, and nothing more is sent until no mob is left; then they are let go and follow you again. Turning Auto-Hunt off or pausing the bot mid-fight lets them go too, and a toon too far for the camp to pull in is named in the console.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Auto-Hunt holds the whole group for a pull.** The Campspot and CS-JO-JI boxes of Auto-Hunt only moved the toon running it. Now the whole group sets a camp spot for the pull and is let go afterwards, and with CS-JO-JI the casters stay at their camp spot while the rest may go in.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Auto-Hunt only walks.** Auto-Hunt could fly between points on a flying mount, then stand in the air unable to pull. It now only walks, a toon in the air lands first, and a point no walking route reaches ends the walk with a line naming it. A path you start yourself may still fly.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Cast, item and SpewStat events reach your other sessions through OC.** `OgreEvent_OthersOnAbilityCast`, `OgreEvent_OthersOnAbilityCastCompleted`, `OgreEvent_OthersOnItemUse` and `OgreEvent_SpewStats` now reach your other sessions through the Ogre console hub instead of a `relay`, and MCP layouts, MCP key binds and movement key binds sync the same way. The same sessions get them, with the same arguments, each one exactly as sent. A session that is zoning or at character select gets them when it reaches the world, in order, instead of at once.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Classic's Tradeskill Apprentice script is not coming back.** `ogre tsapp` and its manager, `ogre tsam` / `ogre tsappm`, were listed as planned for the Task Runner. They have been dropped instead. Delete those lines from your scripts: nothing replaces them.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Two old Classic content scripts are retired.** Classic's `ogre boz_dw2_korrosk` and `ogre vov_tstracker` were listed as not ported yet. They have been retired instead. Delete those lines from your scripts: nothing replaces them.
- **Changed** · Windows: **Settings that do nothing are now greyed.** In the OgreBot window, a setting that does nothing is now greyed, and hovering it says which kind it is: not built yet, or does nothing by design. It still takes a click and still saves. The guide also now says the Auto Hunt box is a real on/off switch, which it has been for a while.
- **Changed** · Windows: **Temp Adornments always apply.** Applying a temp adornment profile now puts every adornment on, even on a piece that already has it with time left, so you can top up before a long fight. The overwrite tick box and the overwrite argument of `-TempAdorns` and `OgreBotAPI.TempAdorns:Apply` are gone.
- **Changed** · Navigation: **A walk waits when something else has the toon.** A saved path used to end when the toon died, or when something else was moving it. It now waits and goes on from the same point: through a fight, until a res or a revive in the same zone, through a movement block, and through the Pause of the Nav window. A slow new route no longer reads as stuck.
- **Changed** · Navigation: **Changing a path from a script takes a for-who.** OgreBotAPI.Paths:AddPoint, RemovePoint, Clear and Delete now take a for-who first, so a line that reaches six boxes can change the path once. Two boxes saving at the same moment no longer lose an edit.
- **Changed** · Console: **ChatCmd:On no longer warns about classic's router.** `ISXOgreEQ2.ChatCmd:On` and `ogre chatcmd` no longer say that OgreBot Classic's router may still be running: Classic and the new bot refuse each other at load, so the two cannot share a session.
- **Changed** · Other: **A script's cast monitoring list now ends with the zone.** Mobs added with `SetCastMonitoring[...,-watch,"<mob>"]` or `ogre npccast watch` now last the zone, as they did in classic: they end at the next zone or when NPC Cast Monitoring is unticked, together with a script's radius. Zone and fight-file watches are not touched. `-radius` on its own and `ogre npccast radius` now tick NPC Cast Monitoring too, as `-watch` does, and the box stays ticked after the zone.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Auto-Hunt does not pull while you fly.** Auto-Hunt could pick a mob and try to pull it while you were flying, and its pull hold could stop a walk you started yourself in the air, where no pull can be cast. Now it pulls nothing in the air (no pull, target, camp or safety hold), a pull it was working ends, and one console line says so as you take off. Its own walk lands first and then pulls, and a walk you started yourself flies on.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Auto-Hunt holds steady on the mob it picks.** Auto-Hunt's line-of-sight check could flip from one frame to the next on a mob standing in plain view, so the hunt kept stopping and starting, and with Campspot on the group was camped and let go many times a second. It now looks from your eye height to the mob's, the same check your pull ability has to pass, and a picked mob stays picked until a different answer holds for 0.3 seconds. An empty Pull Abilities list now says so once in the console.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Auto-Hunt stops walking when something attacks it.** Auto-Hunt kept walking its path if an attacker was outside the Scan radius and Check Aggro was off. It now stops, fights and carries on at the same point, by the rule the Travel window uses, and a path you start yourself does the same.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Broadcast guild talk works again.** The Broadcast guild talk through OgreConsole box on the Setup tab did nothing, because the code behind it only ran after `ogre chatcmd`. Tick it on one character and guild and officer chat reaches OgreConsole on all your sessions, with no `ogre chatcmd` needed.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Examine finds an item with a coloured name.** Examine and Examine All missed an item whose name carries a colour code, because the backslash of the code was lost on the way to the game. They find it now, and Examine finds it whether or not you type the code.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **LogToonIn reaches a toon a zone dropped to character select.** When a zone drops a toon to character select, `oc !c -LogToonIn MyToon MyToon` now logs it back in: at character select or the login screen a box answers to the toon it last played, as well as to its session name. It is the one command that does - every other command aimed at that toon still does nothing there. LoginAtCharacterSelect is gone, because `all` with a name sent every box on the PC to log in as that toon: use `-LogToonIn <box> <toon>` and name the box.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **No Invis Casting lets the Cast Stack cast when a mob attacks you or your group.** With No Invis Casting ticked, a mob on you or your group now counts as a fight: once a mob near you has you or someone in your group as its target, outside a city, the Cast Stack casts again, so you help instead of watching. Before, it kept waiting until you hit back, even while the mob was already hitting you.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **No Invis Casting works.** The No Invis Casting box now works: out of combat, the Cast Stack does not cast while you are invisible, and says so once. In combat the box does nothing, and anything a command, script or fight file asks for still casts.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Out-of-combat buffs go up as soon as the fight ends.** NonCombatBuff rows on the Cast Stack no longer wait up to two seconds after a kill: they now read the same in-combat state classic reads. No Invis Casting uses that same state, so it starts holding again as soon as the fight is over.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Pick a path again to walk it again.** A path that ended or could not start on Auto-Hunt stayed ended even after picking it again. Picking it in the list now always asks again. A zone still ends the walk, and the next zone does not walk by itself.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Trade and Inventory.Count find an item with a coloured name.** `ogre trade` said an examined item with a coloured name was not in your bags, and Inventory.Count counted it as none. Both find it now.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **A window can always be dragged back, and Reset UI Windows lost its OFF-SCREEN badge.** A window dropped at the far left now keeps the part of its title bar you can drag on the screen; at a UI scale of 1.5 or more only its buttons showed. Resizing, a window getting narrower, a tall InnerSpace console and moving a hidden window can no longer take a title bar off the screen either. So Reset UI Windows drops its OFF-SCREEN badge, and `ogre ui report` says HIDDEN BY CONSOLE for a window the console has hidden.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **Temp Adornments spot a two-handed weapon.** A profile's Primary (two-handed) adornment is now used when your primary weapon is a two-hander, as in the classic bot. Before, it was used whenever your off-hand was empty, so a one-handed weapon with nothing in the off-hand got the two-handed adornment.
- **Fixed** · Navigation: **A path of one point goes there and finishes.** A looping path of one point, or one whose points were all where you stood, restarted over and over. It now goes to the point and finishes, loop or not.
- **Fixed** · Crafting: **Zoning while the craft bot reads your recipe book no longer leaves it short.** If you zoned while the craft bot was reading your recipe book, it could keep a partial list and then say a quest's recipes were not in your book. It now starts the read again after an interruption, and reads the book again if a recipe the game just gave you is missing. It also checks whether the book is really open, so it no longer closes a book you already had open.
- **Fixed** · Other: **A cast monitoring radius set from a script now holds.** `SetCastMonitoring[...,-radius,80]` and `ogre npccast radius` now keep their radius when that same call turns NPC Cast Monitoring on. Before, the console said 80 and the scan ran at 50. The radius now beats the zone's own radius, lasts through Reload and window edits, and ends at the next zone or when the box is unticked.
- **Fixed** · Other: **A fight's cast watch keeps working when you reopen OgreBot.** Reopening OgreBot in the middle of a fight no longer leaves its cast watch doing nothing. If the fight turned NPC Cast Monitoring on and that was not saved, the box comes back on when OgreBot opens. If you turned the box off during the fight, it stays off.
- **Fixed** · Other: **Cast monitoring requests hold before the bot loads and during a zone.** `SetCastMonitoring[...,-watch,"<mob>"]`, `-radius` and `ogre npccast watch` or `radius` given before OgreBot is loaded now tick NPC Cast Monitoring once it loads. Given during a zone change, including from a zone event, they now count for the zone you are arriving in instead of ending when it finishes loading. Unticking the box now always ends a script's mobs and radius.

## 2026.11.06.002 {#r2026-11-06-002}

*Friday, November 6, 2026 at 8:44 PM EST*

- **Changed** · Bot: **A missing or out-of-date ability export now loads OgreBot paused.** OgreBot used to load running on an old export, or on none. It now loads paused, as classic OgreBot did, and says so in the export prompt. It stays paused after the export finishes, so resume it when you are ready.
- **Changed** · Bot: **The AbilityViaDebug box on the Debug tab is now Ability query debug.** On the Debug tab, the box labelled AbilityViaDebug now reads Ability query debug. It is the same box, and your saved setting carries over.
- **Changed** · Bot: **The HO icon lookup reads Classic's -No options.** `OgreBotAPI.Abilities.FindCastableHOIconAbilityID` now reads the -No options Classic's `Get_HOIconAbility` took, such as -NoStun and -NoRoot, on top of your settings boxes. An option it does not use is named once on the console and ignored, where before it was dropped without a word.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Two more ability calls have names that say what they do.** `${OgreBotAPI.Abilities.InterruptID[actor]}` is now `${OgreBotAPI.Abilities.FindCastableInterruptID[actor]}`, and `${OgreBotAPI.Abilities.HOIconAbility[icon,...]}` is now `${OgreBotAPI.Abilities.FindCastableHOIconAbilityID[icon,...]}`. Each one finds an ability you can cast right now and gives back its id, without casting it. The arguments are the same and the old names are gone, so change them in your scripts.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Watcher alerts make their sound, and Track Shiny sees the whole zone.** Find now plays the alarm when a listed name appears or leaves, on the session that saw it, as classic OgreBot did. Track Shiny now dings every session when it finds a new shiny, and it looks through the whole zone, nearest first, where it used to stop at 100 metres.
- **Changed** · Other: **ogre export says where a script's options go.** `ogre export` still takes only -start, -default and stop, and now says where the options go when it refuses a word: a script passes them to `ISXOgreEQ2.Export:Abilities`, for example `ISXOgreEQ2.Export:Abilities[-tradeskill]`. The Classic conversion guide says the same, and it now answers for the old words `ogre tell`, `ogre mapper` and `ogre det`.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **A blank movement key call goes back to your key bind.** `OgreBotAPI.Movement:SetForwardKey`, `SetBackwardKey`, `SetFlyUpKey` and `SetFlyDownKey` with no key now go back to your own key bind; they used to set w, s, Home or End, whatever you had bound. Naming a key works as before, until your key binds next change. A script that named a key before anything had moved no longer leaves the other movement keys unset.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **A misspelt section name is reported in every data file.** Every data file you can layer with your own copy now prints one warning naming a section it does not know, such as "Zones" for "zones", where before the section was skipped without a word. Only that section is skipped, and a name starting with _ is a note. A crafting mats list with no "key" now says it was not used, and a Hide Effects add or remove for a group that does not exist says it did nothing, instead of "skipped".
- **Fixed** · Bot: **A relay group in the list is one name everywhere.** A group in the relay group list is now joined at profile load and left on close under the name you typed. A name with a space or a symbol used to become a squashed copy there, so the toon stayed in the real group after closing. `im trade` now gives the real reason an entry stopped short, such as the partner cancelling, instead of always saying the window cap was reached.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Ability checks know when you are dead or stunned.** Abilities.CanCastOn now answers dead or stunned, and heroic opportunities and the ability query stop picking abilities then, honouring the two stun checkboxes as the cast stack does. The ability query also uses the same range, movement and position checks as everything else, and Lifeburn and Manaburn are no longer refused for the IsReady test the cast stack skips.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Allow Specials to be Targets and Enable PvP now work.** Both boxes now do what they say: a Special actor, or an enemy player, can be your kill target, so the Cast Stack, auto-attack and movement act on it. A few zones whose fights need a Special allow it with the box off, as classic OgreBot did. A shiny now also waits for your cast to finish before the bot goes for it.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Cancelling a cast for a cure potion now drinks the potion.** With X Abilities to Auto Cure Potions ticked, the bot cancels your cast and drinks the potion, even with the auto cure potion box off. Before, it could cancel cast after cast and never drink, and a potion on recast could read as ready. It leaves a cure on the bar alone, stops if the cast stack or its cures are switched off, and does nothing while paused or told not to cure.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **CastInterrupt keeps your cast when no interrupt is ready.** Abilities:CastInterrupt looks for a ready interrupt first and cancels what you are casting only if it found one. Before, it dropped your cast and then found nothing to interrupt with, unlike the classic bot and the fight-file castInterrupt step.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Fighters use a Formless Energy Inverter to dispel.** A fighter holding a Handcrafted Formless Energy Inverter now uses it when a fight calls for a dispel. The bot searched for it in a way known to miss Formless items, so the dispel could stay silent, and a recast on it could read as ready. It now finds all five inverters the way the classic bot did.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Five smaller fixes from the audit.** Consume Items waits for a newly seen item's details, so its timer uses the real duration instead of 10 minutes. Looting forgets what it opened after every zoning, evacs included, and the Codex token button opens the API tokens page. Asking for Confront Fear only counts dirges within 100 m, and Call of the Veteran uses your item unless the porter nearby is yours.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **GetQuest stops on a dialogue it does not know.** GetQuest now clicks through a conversation only when the first reply is the row's opening line. Any other reply stops the run, clicks nothing and prints what it saw, and a first reply that merely contains the finished text now stops as maxed out on faction. A custom row must now have startingQuestText, or its file is refused with a line saying so.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Heroic Opportunities no longer pick stealth abilities.** The Heroic Opportunity picker now skips hostile abilities that require stealth, even while you are stealthed, as the classic bot does. Before, a stealthed scout could spend one on an HO icon.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Long game text no longer reads as empty.** A long quest step, stat tooltip, reply row or script variable now reads whole. Before, anything over about 1,000 characters came back empty.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Looting carries on between mobs.** In combat with nothing to attack, looting now follows Loot Corpses/Chests, as classic OgreBot did, so corpses and chests in reach are taken in the gap between mobs instead of waiting for combat to end. Loot InCombat now rules only while you have something to attack. Shinies still wait until you are out of combat.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Move behind and move in front do not back into a wall.** A toon too close to the mob now only backs out when the way to its spot is clear, as Classic did. Before, it kept backing into a wall or a ledge.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Names and commands with spaces stay whole.** A relay group name, a zone script path or a quoted word in a Load, OnZone or Unload list line, a chat or spawn event's code, or an NPC cast rule's command now stays in one piece instead of splitting at the space. Write such a line as you would type it in the console; a backslash before a quote is no longer needed. An NPC cast rule's OgreBotAPI command now runs once, where it used to run twice.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Names with a backslash or a quote reach the game whole.** Every item, ability, quest, zone and key name the bot puts into a game command is now quoted the same way, so a colour code, a backslash or a double quote in one arrives whole instead of losing a character or breaking the command. Fight files, zone files and travel data are no longer refused for holding a double quote in such a name. `Comms:ExecuteEvent` sends each argument whole again, so one with a comma stays one argument.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Ogre Follow: 0 means the default, and a missing leader stops it.** A distance of 0 for -ogrefollow now means its default instead of being refused. A leader who cannot be found now turns follow off, as Classic did, instead of leaving you following the last one.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Quest Helper holds object clicks after a hail.** Quest Helper no longer clicks a nearby object in the 5 seconds after a hail or an answered reply, as in the classic bot. A dialogue it has no answer for now writes one log line, not one every half second.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Quiver slots, stale research rows, and Allow Camp Spot on move commands.** The quiver refill now moves ammo to the container's next open slot, and Ability Research reports a row missing from your export and starts the next one, 3 seconds after research ends. Announce fills *target* in any case, Tell To Target only tells players, and auto-accepted missions share with the group when Auto Share Missions is on. With Allow Camp Spot off, a character now ignores Come2Me and Move2Area, as classic OgreBot did.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Sharing a mission follows the classic rules.** -ShareAllMissions and -ShareMission now stop if you leave the zone before the group has gathered, as the zone share already did. -ShareQuest shares straight away with whoever is here, where it used to wait up to 5 minutes for the group. A quest only counts as a mission for -ShareMission if its category is Mission or Mission: Weekly.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **The depot-all option leaves ammo and potions in your bags.** `ogre im depot -depotall` was also emptying your ammo and your poisons, potions and totems into their depots. It now uses the seven depots classic OgreBot used, and `-ada` still deposits all your ammo when you ask for it.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **The misspelt section warning no longer says the file still loads.** The warning for a section name the bot does not know no longer ends with "The file still loads". If the section was the only one the file had, the next line says the file was not used, and the two lines disagreed.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **The performance lists stop showing a diagnostic's name.** A diagnostic's name could show in the performance lists, the lag dump and the log, and now it does not. The Migration Assistant's InnerSpace profile item says Add what is missing, and its text says Classic. A Craft Grandmasters row for a recipe not in your book is no longer green, the Analysis Actors list shows its last count, and the Assign keys hint names gamepad buttons.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Trading counts a partner who accepts first.** When the other player accepted a trade in the last moment before the bot did, the items moved but the run read the trade as not accepted and stopped there. That accept now counts, and the run goes on to the next trade window.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **Close F2P upsell window is back on Settings.** The Close F2P upsell window box had gone missing from Settings. It is back, and it now closes the upsell within a second when you are out of combat, where it used to take up to 100 seconds.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **The Analysis history heading shows a name as it is.** The heading over the Analysis history list shows a name holding `&` or `<` as it is. Before, it showed `&amp;` or `&lt;`.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **Interrupts pick an ability that can reach the caster.** A fight file or NPC cast rule that interrupts now picks an ability that is in range, in line of sight and affordable on the mob that is casting. Before, it picked the fastest ready one and the cast could fail.
- **Fixed** · Crafting: **Buying waits for the purchase to show in your bags.** After each buy the merchant flow now waits up to 2 seconds for the items to show in your bags, and moves on the moment they do. It used to wait a flat second, so a slow bag update could buy the same items twice.
- **Fixed** · Console: **Move Bag Contents goes to open slots.** ogre mbc now puts each item into an open slot of the destination bag, so what is already there stays put and a smaller bag works. When that bag fills it stops and says how many items moved. ogre buyfuel now only takes the name from an item examine window, not a spell, effect or tooltip.
- **Fixed** · Console: **ogre trade hands over the item you examined.** `ogre trade` now hands over the item you examined. Before, it pointed one place off in your bags, so it could offer a different item. It now finds the item the same way as `ogre im trade`.
- **Fixed** · Console: **Reply window: the exact reply wins, and LAST_ENTRY works.** -ReplyDialog now picks the reply that says exactly your text before one that only contains it, so "Yes" no longer takes "Yes, but later" because it stands higher. LAST_ENTRY picks the last reply, as it did in Classic.
- **Fixed** · Console: **Select window: the last choice given wins, and a number can be a label.** -Select_Window_AP now uses the last option given, as Classic did, not the first. A number no row has is matched as the text of a row, so a list of amounts can be picked by its label.
- **Fixed** · Other: **Coming from Classic rows say the thing itself.** About 35 rows on the Coming from Classic pages and in the converter told you to see another row. Each now says what you need right there.
- **Fixed** · Other: **Help and docs corrected for Watcher, Inventory Manager and Migration Assistant.** Watcher's help now says the window's X stops Find and Track Shiny; it used to say closing the window stops nothing. Inventory Manager's help now gives the real way to remove a list row: click it, then right-click it. Migration Assistant now lists saved AutoTarget lists and the InnerSpace profile, SmartLoot's page covers + Group and + Raid, and the Assign keys pictures show keys on their button.
- **Fixed** · Other: **Removed Classic calls now say what to use instead.** When a removed Classic call has a replacement, the converter's to-do list and the Coming from Classic pages now name it instead of saying there is none: OgreBotAPI:Mount points at Consumables:MountUp and MountDown, for example. Console notes say Classic and the new command rather than V1 and V2, and the for-who advice is in plain words. Converted scripts come out the same.
- **Fixed** · Other: **The converter flags ogre words that kept their name but changed.** The Classic converter used to pass `ogre mesh "<zone>" -me`, `ogre npccastmonitoring` and `ogre move` without a word, though each now does something else. It flags those lines now and says what to write, and it answers for about 120 more old ogre words. The No Revision History box is gone from Settings, because there is no revision window for it to stop.
- **Fixed** · Other: **The converter now answers for 45 more old ogre words.** The Classic converter used to stop and ask at words such as `ogre meshint`, `ogre depot`, `ogre int` and `ogre map`, because it had no answer for them. Now each one says what to write instead: `ogre mesh`, `ogre im depot`, `ogre bot`, or that the line can go. Words that are not in the new bot yet say so, and the coming-from-classic pages list them all.
- **Fixed** · Other: **Window guides match the windows again.** The guides for TaskRunner Lists, OgreConsole, Ogre Options, Master Control Panel, Reset UI Windows and Inventory Manager were behind the windows. TaskRunner Lists is rewritten around its list box, Run button, Run options and drag to reorder. OgreConsole's Errors tab, the MCP's Reset all colours and the shorter right-click menu are now covered.

Send a console line instead: `oc !c -CastAbility igw:${Me.Name} "Assault"` for the sessions on this PC, `irc !c -CastAbility irw:${Me.Name} "Assault"` for a raid across PCs. `-CastAbilityNoExport`, `-CastAbilityOnPlayer`, `-UseItem` and `-UseItemOnPlayer` work the same way.

Type `ogre lag`, `ogre pulse`, `ogre pulseprof`, `ogre travel`, `ogre questcompare`, `ogre forwhogroups`, `ogre hideeffects`, `ogre safefall` and `ogre lt`. Each word is its own script method, for example `${ISXOgreEQ2.Lag:Report[30]}`, and a word a command does not know now says so.
- **Removed** · Console: **Radar and Inventory Manager are `ogre` commands only.** The separate `ogreradar` and `ogreim` commands are gone. - **Removed** · Console: **The spawn, window, loot and pack pony commands are script methods.** The separate `ogrespawn`, `ogrespawndelay`, `ogrewindows`, `ogrelootscan`, `ogrechatcmd`, `ogrepackpony` and `ogreeventspine` commands are gone. ## 2026.11.06.001 {#r2026-11-06-001}

*Friday, November 6, 2026 at 4:08 AM EST*

- **New** · Bot: **A Status tab, and an amber dot when something is holding a tab up.** The OgreBot window has a new Status tab showing what the bot is holding or set to, such as Auto Target suppressed, No Move and the camp spot. When Auto Target is suppressed, its tab gets an amber dot you can see from any tab, and a Held line that says why, with a Release button for holds a player set.
- **New** · Bot: **Auto Assist has a range.** The Assist tab has a new box, Only assist within (meters), 100 by default. A player further away is skipped and the bot tries the next name on the list. 0 means no limit.
- **New** · Windows: **Match on all sessions, and a shorter window menu.** Right-click a window's title bar and choose More, then Match on all sessions, to give every session on this PC the same place, size and scale for that window, locked or not. It saves nothing, so use Save Position to keep it. The menu is shorter too: Scale, Pin to back, When Console is open and Minimize all windows moved under More.
- **New** · Windows: **MCP buttons can have their own text size.** Right-click an MCP button and choose Set text size to give it its own size. Leave it blank to go back to the default. Converting an OldBot MCP now keeps its per-button sizes.
- **New** · Windows: **Tag Timers window.** A new window lists every Embargo and Allow tag on your character: the tag, its type, who set it, who it went to and how long is left. Tick Show Tag Timers window on the Tags tab, or use `ogre tags`.
- **New** · Navigation: **Points of interest and saved paths.** The new Points of Interest and Paths window (ogre paths) names spots in a zone and saves walks through them, by nav or by camp spot, and Auto-Hunt can walk one between pulls. The first time you enter a zone with an old OgreBot Classic AutoHunt route, it comes across by itself as a path called Default. An Import button on the window runs it again.
- **Changed** · Bot: **A tag lasts the same time on every character.** The longest a tag can hold is 600 seconds. A Duration above that used to run its full length on the caster and stop at 600 on everyone else; it now stops at 600 for all of them.
- **Changed** · Bot: **HoldUp merged into StopFollow, and -ccsb nudges the base spot.** Movement:HoldUp is gone: use Movement:StopFollow, and -holdup now runs it, so it also stops the move in progress. -ccsb now nudges the base camp spot, as -CS_Set_ChangeCampSpotBy does. JoustIn resumes a paused follow, and HeadingTo reads -1 and AlreadyFacing FALSE for an unknown actor.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Travel mesh: Stop, group trips, and no resume on arrival.** TravelMesh:Stop on a route someone else started now prints one line saying whose it is, and -force stops it anyway. A mesh trip no longer resumes the group on arrival, so a bot you paused stays paused; the Instance Controller still resumes its own group. -TravelMeshGroup sent to several characters now has each plan its own route and relays nothing, so it no longer restarts every route.
- **Changed** · Windows: **Lock no longer saves a window's position.** Locking a window, pinning it to the back and choosing its console mode now save only that setting. Before, each one also saved where the window was, and all accounts on a PC share that saved spot, so a lock on one account could undo a Save Position on another. Use Save Position to save where a window opens; it is dimmed while the window is locked.
- **Changed** · Navigation: **A point of interest works as a location.** A point of interest's name now works wherever a location does in that zone, such as -NavTo, -Move2Area, -ChangeCampSpot and -Waypoint and the verbs behind them. An unknown name prints one line and nothing moves.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **A refused craft start changes nothing.** A start refused for an empty queue, a low tradeskill level or no selected quest no longer turns craft lite on or clears the last run's stop reason. Do NOT load recipes on startup now also holds for Craft:Open and Craft:Lite. A craft panel that cannot open leaves craft as it was.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **A stuck Move2Area or Come2Me gives up.** A move into a wall used to hold forward until something else moved the toon. After 10 seconds with no progress it now stops and prints one line saying where it stuck and how far from its goal.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Auto Target can target you, and Enter adds a row.** Your own name on the Auto Target list works again: the bot targets you when nothing above you on the list is up. Pressing Enter in the name box now adds the row.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Auto-login uses the session a row names.** A launch always took the lowest free session, whatever the row named. A row above that came up on the wrong session, and the retry started a second client. Each row now launches on the session it names.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Camp spot nudges and resets.** CampSpot:SetRelativeLoc refuses a NULL or non-number coordinate instead of using 0. NudgeBy on a slot with no spot changes nothing and says so, SetRelativeBy after SetRelativeLoc moves the spot by exactly the nudge, and ResetAll now drops leash holds.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **ChangeZoneTo, Druid and ToGuildHall.** ChangeZoneTo now moves only the characters you named, and it recognises instance numbers of any length. Travel:Druid no longer answers a conversation it did not start. Travel:ToGuildHall needs a door within 15 units, and prints one line when there is none.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Fast travel -mto number picks that spot.** Fast travel -mto with a number always went to the last sub-map spot, whatever the number. A number now picks that spot, counting from 1, and -mto Last asks for the last one. Without -mto the last spot is still the default.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Harvest Lite while paused, oau, and a missed trade.** Harvest Lite and Targeting:Target now target while OgreBot is paused. oau scans an open container and leaves it open, or opens each Scroll Depot in range in turn and closes it after. A trade that finds nothing to hand over now rejects the window it opened.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **IM counts a depot withdraw, Decide handles every window.** IM.IsRunning, Mode and Status now report a depot withdraw from anywhere, so -end waits for it. A typed Loot:Decide now goes through every open loot window in turn, not just the one on top.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **IRC notices a link that has gone silent.** A link that died quietly used to look connected until the next line was lost. After 5 minutes with nothing from the server the hub now checks it and reconnects if nothing answers, and a line that fails to send goes out after the reconnect.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **LetsGo clears the joust ignore and stands a feigned toon.** LetsGo now turns Ignore Joust Commands off and stands a feigned toon, as OgreBot Classic did. An encounter that calls LetsGo stands a feigned toon too.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **LogToonIn skips locked characters.** Logging a toon in from another account's character list used to pick the first character listed, and a locked one sat until the 180 second timeout. It now picks the first character the account can play, and empty slots are ignored. A locked toon, or a list with nothing playable, now gets one line straight away.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Merchant:Buy accepts its prompt and says why it did nothing.** Merchant:Buy now accepts the purchase prompt, and Buy and Sell print one line when they cannot act. Overseer:BuyMissions refuses a first word that is not a flag, so a stray stop no longer starts a buy run. Scribe_Empyral touches only scribeable items.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **MountUp leaves a mounted toon alone.** Consumables:MountUp used to run its sit and toggle sequence whatever you were doing, which could unseat a toon already on a mount. It now prints one line and stops when you are mounted.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Pets engage when you are assisting a player.** The bot only sent your pet in when you had the mob targeted directly, so a character assisting a player, the default, often left its pet idle. It now sends the pet whenever your target leads to the mob, as old OgreBot did.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Reward windows open before OgreBot loaded are seen.** RewardWindowID, RewardID and AcceptReward only knew windows that appeared after the bot loaded. With none known, they now read the open window directly.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **The Auto Hunt box turns hunting on and off.** Ticking Auto Hunt on the tab now starts hunting and unticking stops it, the same switch as -autohunt, and each shows what the other did. It never loads ticked, so a profile always starts with hunting off.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **The tag "no duration" message names the ability and the reason.** When a cast cannot set its tag, the message now names what was cast and says why: it has no duration of its own, it lasts until cancelled, it is not in the ability export, or it is an item. Before, it blamed items on every cast. A Maintained tag with a blank Duration now works on an ability that lasts until cancelled, with a 10 minute limit.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **The word after !c is an IRC handle.** A word between !c and the command is an IRC handle, not a for-who. A typed line with a word that is not all, me or this PC's handle used to drop it and run on every box; it now runs nothing and says so in one line. Who a command is for goes after the command.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Travel mesh reads no longer freeze the client.** TMZones, TMEdges and the other travel data reads now answer at once, reading 0 or empty until the data has loaded. They used to wait for the load, with no limit.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Zoning or camping now ends what cannot survive it.** Depot withdraws, IM runs, refine, consume items and nav trips used to freeze over a zone and carry on with stale state in the next one. They now stop with a line, or end cleanly. Travel and the travel mesh still cross zones as before, and a mesh route walks on from where it lands.
- **Fixed** · Console: **CheckResearch reports to OgreConsole.** The -CheckResearch result now shows in OgreConsole, where it used to go only to the InnerSpace console.
- **Fixed** · Console: **IRC no longer looks disconnected with two connected PCs.** With two PCs on connected uplinks, the PC not on IRC told the other one IRC was down every 15 seconds, so MCP buttons kept saying "IRC not connected" and some went through OgreConsole instead. Each PC now listens only to its own IRC connection.
- **Removed** · Bot: **Auto-Hunt movement mode.** -autohunt and AutoHunt:SetMode now take off or hunt. The words movement, movementonly, move, on and grind are gone, and any of them now turns Auto-Hunt off with a line. To walk with no hunting, press Start in the ogre paths window or use -Path.

## 2026.11.05.001 {#r2026-11-05-001}

*Thursday, November 5, 2026 at 12:27 PM EST*

- **New** · Bot: **The Item Embargo tab now works.** When one of your characters uses an item on the Item Embargo list, it now tells your other characters to hold off that item for the row's Duration, with Group, Me, IRC, Hide from OgreConsole and Globally Mute working as in the old bot. Enable Item Embargo on the Settings tab has to be ticked on the character that uses the item and on the ones that should hold off. A row without a Duration sends nothing and says so, and the Include caster option no longer does anything.
- **New** · Setup: **Migration now brings your saved AutoTarget lists.** The Migration Assistant has a new item that copies the lists you saved per zone in OldBot. It runs by itself the next time the bot loads. A list you already have in the new bot is kept, and your OldBot files are not changed.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Enable Limited Raid Setups is gone from Settings.** The Enable Limited Raid Setups box is removed; it did nothing in this bot. Enable Raid Setups and Enable Heroic Setups are the boxes that turn encounter setups on or off.
- **Changed** · Bot: **HO picks read the Only if boxes the same way as the Cast Stack.** The Only if you are not tanking and Only if a fighter is not tanking boxes now mean the same thing for HO picks as for the Cast Stack. HO picks used to read them the other way round.
- **Changed** · Bot: **HUDs tab - Group Information and Raid Information, each with its own settings.** Group Distance and Raid Distance are now Group Information and Raid Information, and the group has its own Hide names, Hide casting and Name width. Every number box on the tab shows the value it uses while blank.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Inquisitor tab - the Verdict options are gone, use the Cast Stack.** The four Verdict options on the Inquisitor tab are removed; they did nothing in this bot. Verdict is now done in the Cast Stack: add it as an entry, set NPC HP < to the health you want, and tick Named NPCs Only if it is for named mobs. Any values saved for the old boxes are ignored.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Refine checks each item before it refines it.** ogre refine now goes through the same safety check as im destroy and im tse, and refining works as before. Before each refine it reads the item again and prints one REFINE line naming it, so it never refines something that moved in your bags. If the stack is gone it moves on to the next item.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Status lines and the Instance Controller's folders are tidier.** Status and startup lines no longer print internal reference numbers or folder names from our own development. The Instance Controller window now lists only the content folders you can use. If the Codex tabs have no API token yet, the message now tells you where to set it: open a Codex tab in OgreBot and click Setup API Token.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Two ability-query calls have names that say what they do.** `${OgreBotAPI.Abilities.TypeID[...]}` is now `${OgreBotAPI.Abilities.FindCastableID[...]}`: it finds an ability you can cast right now that matches the query and gives back its id, without casting it. `OgreBotAPI.Abilities:CastVia[...]` is now `OgreBotAPI.Abilities:FindAndCast[...]`: the same search, then it casts the winner. The arguments are the same, and the old names are gone, so change them in your scripts.
- **Changed** · Bot: **Unticking Enable Raid or Heroic Setups mid-fight stops the fight logic at once.** Turn the box off at any point to take over: everything the fight was doing stops straight away, including its movement. Tick it again and the bot carries on watching the same fight, without running the setup again. If a setup ran, its clean-up still happens when the mob dies, even with the box off; before, that clean-up waited until you ticked it again.
- **Changed** · Windows: **Reset no longer forgets a window's saved spot.** Reset, on a window's right-click menu or in Reset UI Windows, still puts the window back at its starting spot, size and scale and unlocks it, but it no longer saves that. Close the window or log out and back in and it comes back where you saved it. To keep the reset spot, use Save Position.
- **Changed** · Console: **Console command descriptions rewritten in plain words.** The descriptions in the OgreConsole command list were cleaned up: 35 texts now say what the command actually does, including some that were copied from another command, out of date or unfinished. The commands themselves did not change.
- **Changed** · Console: **The "target bugged" line no longer shows on the Errors tab.** When the game shows a target name with no real target behind it, the bot clears it by itself, so there is nothing for you to do. That line now goes to the regular console instead of OgreConsole's Errors tab.
- **Changed** · Other: **Classic's Mount, FastTravelOld, Report_Back and ascension calls are marked removed.** Classic's `Mount`, `FastTravelOld`, `Report_Back`, the five ascension combo calls and `GuidedAscension` were listed as not ported yet; they are removed on purpose, and each row says what to write instead. Classic's `Get_AbilityTypeID`, `Get_AbilityVia` and `CastAbility_Via` now point at `FindCastableID` and `FindAndCast`.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **-AcceptQuest with a name shares the quest again.** A group leader with auto share on now shares the named quest two seconds after accepting it.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **-GetToConcentration stops as soon as it reaches the target.** It cancelled one buff per point over the target, which could drop far more than needed. It now counts what each buff costs.
