- **Fixed** · Bot: **A bare console command now means you, the sender.** Left-out names and locations on a command now fill from the box that sent it, not each box that receives it. - **Fixed** · Bot: **A misspelt section name in a fight file is reported when it loads.** If an encounter (fight) file has a section name the bot does not know, such as "setups" or "OnPulse" for "onPulse", the console now prints one warning for that file naming each one, with the right spelling when only the capitals are wrong. ## 2026.11.03.002 {#r2026-11-03-002}

*Tuesday, November 3, 2026 at 5:28 PM EST*

- **Fixed** · Windows: **The windows now show on PCs where they were invisible.** On some PCs the OgreBot windows never appeared, although they still blocked clicks (the tour, for example). The game there draws its frames a second way that the windows were not hooked into; they now draw either way.

## 2026.11.03.001 {#r2026-11-03-001}

*Tuesday, November 3, 2026 at 3:40 PM EST*

- **New** · Windows: **For Who takes a typed value.** The For Who window's gear has a Custom box: type any target the buttons cannot say, such as charA|charB|priest, and MCP buttons and bound keys use it until you clear it. Scripts and extensions can set it with ISXOgreEQ2.MCP:SetForWho["..."] and read it with ${ISXOgreEQ2.MCP.ForWho}.
- **New** · Windows: **MCP can reset all colours at once.** The MCP's gear has a new Reset all colours button. After you confirm, every page and button, static ones included, goes back to the default colours. Names and commands are kept.
- **New** · Windows: **More for people who build their own windows.** Extensions can now send data straight to their windows and back without going through LavishScript, and a window can read shared memory directly, even another game's. Scripts can give a text box the keyboard with ISXOgreX.UI:Focus and hear when a window is hidden or shown again. The "Build your own window" page has the details.
- **New** · Windows: **Radar can always show quest NPCs.** The Radar Types window has a new qst npc button. It always shows NPCs with a feather or a quest update icon over their head, even with nokill hidden or quest only on. The quest only button is now labelled quest.
- **New** · Windows: **Radar can show only quest targets.** The radar's Types window has a new quest only button. It narrows NPCs, named and nokill NPCs to the ones that update one of your quests, a mob to kill or an object to click; players and every other type stay as their own buttons say. The radar only checks for quest targets while it is on.
- **New** · Windows: **Temp Adornments window and profiles.** `ogre tempadorns` opens a window where you pick the temporary adornment for each gear piece and save it as a profile. `ogre tempadorns <profile>` applies one on this toon, and `-TempAdorns <who> <profile>` applies it on other toons. Your classic Saved_Temp_Adorns.xml profiles are copied in, and the old PoP lists come ready-made as the profiles CBOC, Pot and HP.
- **New** · Windows: **The OgreBot window warns before you save after an Instance Controller run.** Once the Instance Controller starts a run, the OgreBot window of every character in it shows a warning under Save: the run may have changed settings, so load your profile again before saving. Save still works, and saving while the warning shows also prints it in the console. Loading a profile takes the warning away, and the Instance Controller's own reload at the end of a zone usually does that for you.
- **New** · Instance Controller: **A zone file's walk can kill the trash on the way.** A `path` step can now take `"killWithin": 15`: when a mob comes within 15 meters, the group stops where it is, kills it, then walks on. `killTypes` picks the kinds of mob to stop for (`"NPC"` unless you say otherwise), and `killLimitMs` leaves a mob behind that cannot be killed in two minutes.
- **Changed** · Bot: **"Fights react faster: quick steps no longer wait a quarter second each".** A fight's list of steps used to take a quarter of a second for every step, even one that did not apply to you, so a long list could put a call-out or a target switch several seconds behind the mechanic. Steps that only set things up, such as a setting, a timer, a message or a cast request, now run together at once. A list still pauses at a step that acts in the game, such as moving, clicking or examining something, and at its waits.
- **Changed** · Bot: **The embargo boxes on the Settings tab now work.** Enable Ability Embargo and Enable Item Embargo on the Settings tab now decide whether ability and item embargoes are followed, as in the old bot: both are off until you tick them. Before, every embargo applied whatever the boxes said. Item embargoes are now kept apart from ability embargoes, as in the old bot, and an item's LinkID also works in the unsigned form a guild bank or Census link shows.
- **Changed** · Bot: **The tag boxes on the Settings tab now work, and a profile load clears embargoes.** Enable Tag Embargo and Enable Tag Allow on the Settings tab now decide whether Embargo and Allow tags are followed and turned on, as in the old bot: both are off until you tick them. Before, every tag applied whatever the boxes said. Loading a profile now also clears any ability or item embargo still running, so a new profile does not inherit them.
- **Changed** · Windows: **Dragging moves the whole window.** When you drag a window, the whole window now follows the mouse smoothly, at any scale, without slowing the game. Restart the game after updating for this to take effect.
- **Changed** · Windows: **HUD nearest NPC and PC look across the whole zone.** The HUD's nearest NPC and nearest PC lines used to look only 200 metres out. They now show the nearest one anywhere in the zone, so a named further away still shows.
- **Changed** · Windows: **Ogre windows draw on the graphics card, outside the game.** Ogre's windows now run in their own small program, OgreUltralight.exe, which draws them on the graphics card instead of inside the game, so a click in a scaled window shows within a few milliseconds instead of a quarter of a second. If that program ever stops, the game carries on and the windows come back on their own, as after `ogre ui reload`. Restart the game after updating for this to take effect.
- **Changed** · Windows: **Radar Types is tidier, can hide unnamed actors and shorten names.** The Radar Types window now has its three switches ([all], quest only, no name) on one row, with the types in an even grid under them. The new no name button shows or hides actors with no name, and a name button cuts the radar's names to the number beside it, on and off with a click. The tradeskill button is now called craft.
- **Changed** · Windows: **Text in Ogre windows looks slightly different.** Window text is now drawn by a newer engine: it is a little lighter and a little wider, so a few tightly packed labels may be cut short or wrap differently. If a label you rely on no longer fits, tell us which window it is in.
- **Changed** · Instance Controller: **IC zone files are named after their zone, and `ogre ic queue add` takes a zone name.** The shipped zone files now carry their zone's clean name, such as `_01_Oogothl_Sprawl_VerBohten_Atoll.json`, and a saved queue follows them on its own. `ogre ic queue add Oogothl Sprawl: Ver'Bohten Atoll [Heroic]` queues a zone by its name and difficulty, and `ogre ic queue add ${Zone.Name}` queues the zone you are in. A name without a difficulty, for a zone that has several, is refused with a line that lists them.
- **Changed** · Instance Controller: **The Instance Controller rests for a minute after a wipe.** After a wipe, the Instance Controller now waits a minute where the zone starts over before it walks on. Revive sickness wears off and everyone buffs back up first. A zone file with its own wipe recovery steps is not changed.
- **Changed** · Console: **One name for temporary adornments: TempAdorns.** PoP_TempAdorns, PoPTempAdorns and ApplyTempAdorn are now OgreBotAPI.TempAdorns:Apply and the console command -TempAdorns, which apply a saved profile. MCP buttons that used the old commands are converted for you, and the script converter names the new form. Name the profile on the line (for example `-TempAdorns all cboc`): the old default cboc is not assumed.
- **Changed** · Other: **Converter adds the For Who to more console commands.** The script converter now writes auto in front of -ZoneDoor, -ImmRes, -ApplyVerb, -Raid, -Mentor and -EndScript when their first argument cannot be a For Who: a plain number or quoted text with a space (oc !c -ZoneDoor 1 becomes oc !c -ZoneDoor auto 1). A line that starts with a word or a variable stays on your to-do list, because that may already be the For Who. Running the converter again adds nothing.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **"A bot part that fails no longer closes the game".** When one part of the bot hits an error, the bot now catches it: the game stays open, the other parts keep working, and the failing part tries again on the next frame. The error goes to the log at most once every 30 seconds, with a count of the repeats. Before, an error like this closed the game.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **"A fight's wait for a move now waits for that move".** A fight step that waits for a move to finish could end at once if the move had not got going yet, for example while the zone's navigation map was still loading. It now waits until that move arrives, gives up or is stopped, or until the step's time limit runs out.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **"A saved file with an odd character still loads".** A settings or data file that held one character the bot cannot read, often from editing it by hand or from an older bot, used to load as if it were empty. It now loads with that character shown as a placeholder, and the log says where in the file it was.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **"Cthurath, the Consumer: the tank stays put for the stone ring, and the raid comes home".** Before the first fighter callout, the fighter tanking Cthurath no longer runs to the stone ring. A ring left standing after Forced Isolation is cured no longer sends the raid back out, and the isolation and ring messages show once per box instead of once per toon on every box.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **"Raid fights coordinate across computers again".** In raid fights, the messages one player's bot sends the others, such as a cure request or a hand-off, now reach players on every computer, not only those on the sender's own. Heroic and solo fights keep them on the sending computer.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **A raid chest you may not loot is left alone.** When the game says only the raid leader or assigned looters may loot a chest, auto-loot now leaves that chest for the rest of the zone. Before, it clicked it three more times and then warned that no loot window came.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Buffs that replace each other no longer loop.** Some out-of-combat buffs replace each other, such as cosmetic pets, familiar infusions and mount infusions. With several of them in the cast stack, the bot could cast them back and forth forever. After one of these buffs lands, the bot now waits for it to show as up (or one second) before casting another, so the highest one in your list stays.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Curable-disable no longer warns about an ability a character lacks.** A character without the curable-disable ability (for example 'Natural Cleanse' on a class that has no such spell) printed "not in your ability export" in the console. It now goes to the log file only.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Item embargoes now stop the item.** An item embargo (-ItemEmbargo, or Inventory:AddEmbargo with an item's LinkID) now makes the cast stack skip that item until the time is up. Before, it was stored and never checked, and a negative LinkID, which many items have, was thrown away. Abilities:ClearEmbargo now clears any ability id that was added, however large, and Inventory:ClearEmbargo clears an item's.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Joust On and Joust Off pick their usual toons again.** OgreBotAPI.Movement:JoustOn with no For Who now acts on the melee, and JoustOff on the casters, as in Classic. Before, a bare call acted on everyone. A call that names its For Who is unchanged.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **No more casting at a group member who is out of sight.** A buff, heal or cure aimed at a group member who was far away or zoning could fire over and over, each time refused as too far away. The bot now treats a member it cannot see as out of range and waits until they are back.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Qworux in Thresinet's Den is fought in the middle of the platform.** In The Fabled Castle Highhold: Thresinet's Den, the group now fights Qworux in the middle of the platform instead of at the ledge. He sometimes ended up on the stairs, out of line of sight.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **Radar dots no longer swim when you zoom.** Zooming the radar made the dots slide in and out before settling. They now jump straight to their new places; normal movement still glides.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **Radar no longer labels unnamed dots with ?** On the radar, something with no name used to be labelled ?, which looked just like a ? shiny. It now has no label, as in the old radar.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **The HUD comes back after a UI reload.** After ogre ui reload, or the window host restarting, the on-screen HUD (nearest NPC, nearest PC, raid lines) stayed gone until you reloaded the profile. It now comes back by itself.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **The OSA no longer slows down every window.** With the OSA open, the in-game windows could get stuck redrawing the whole screen several times a second, so clicks and check boxes lagged badly, worst with a scaled window. The OSA now redraws only its own rows.
- **Fixed** · Navigation: **A group zoning in no longer warns about the props file.** When several of your characters zoned in together, one of them could warn that it "could not write" a props file (Windows error 5). They were all saving the same file at the same moment, and the retry always saved it. The warning now shows only if the retry fails too.
- **Fixed** · Other: **Converted calls keep their For Who.** The script converter now gives every call it rewrites its For Who: an old call with no arguments gets the old default (OgreBotAPI:Jump becomes OgreBotAPI.Movement:Jump[all]), and a renamed console command gets auto. CoV and the auto-consume calls now convert with their arguments. -StatPotions_AutoConsume with no potion name uses your configured stat potion again, as in Classic.

## 2026.11.01.001 {#r2026-11-01-001}

*Sunday, November 1, 2026 at 1:42 PM EST*

- **New** · Bot: **"The Ghouly Ghast in Revelations of Consequence [Raid] is set up".** The bot now sets up The Ghouly Ghast: raid and tank spots, looting off, enchanters on the named with PowerDrain, a Reverberating Boom countdown and a call when a torchbearer spawns. A player with Burning Affliction runs to the torch and clicks it. With GhoulyGhast_Movement on, scouts and mages also step out of their add's death blast.
- **New** · Bot: **"Thet-ki-dua in Revelations of Consequence [Raid] is set up".** The bot now sets up Thet-ki-dua: the raid follows each add until it dies, splits to the three crystals by raid group when they are up, and regroups at the center. Each player clicks their own station's crystal until the channel lands, and fighters, enchanters and rogues get their target lists.
- **New** · Bot: **"Yon-Solhoth the Corrupted in Steppes of Oblivion [Raid] is set up".** The bot now sets up Yon-Solhoth the Corrupted: raid and tank spots on the east side, fighters on the named with tank swapping, and Targeted Devastation stops the marked fighter tanking until it wears off. Stench of Corruption and both add summons get on-screen countdowns and a call.
- **New** · Console: **"OgreConsole has an Errors tab for every box's warnings and errors".** OgreConsole has a new **Errors** tab: every warning and error the bot logs on any of your boxes shows up there, with the character's name in front. When one lands while you are on another tab, the tab turns red, pulses and counts how many you have not seen. A repeating message shows once every 30 seconds and a box sends at most 20 a minute; the session log still has every line.
- **Changed** · Windows: **Ending the Watcher stops Find and Track Shiny too.** Closing the Watcher window with its X, or ogre end watcher, now stops Find and Track Shiny as well as closing the window. Before, both kept watching in the background with no window open. To stop just one, use ogre end find or ogre end trackshiny.
- **Changed** · Crafting: **Every automated craft run empties the setup queue before it adds.** Writs, quest crafting, auto tinkering and low level leveling now all fill the setup queue the same way: each round empties it, then adds that round's recipes and crafts them. Your queue is no longer set aside during writs or quest crafting, and the loops no longer craft your rows with their next round. To craft your own recipes, stop the run first; Stop never empties the setup queue, so anything you added since the last round is still there.
- **Changed** · Crafting: **Merchant craft and Craft Grandmasters empty the setup queue the same way.** Merchant craft (`ogre mc`) and Craft Grandmasters now fill the setup queue like the other automated craft runs: each round empties it, then adds its recipes and crafts them, so recipes you queued yourself are no longer crafted with a round. Every automated run now takes its recipes the moment it adds them, and one that stops before crafting them takes them back out, leaving yours alone. Stop never empties the setup queue.
- **Changed** · Console: **"`ogre getquest reload` waits for the run to end".** While `ogre getquest` is running, `ogre getquest reload` now says "a run is active - stop it first" and changes nothing; the run carries on. Before, a reload in the middle of a run could make the run use another area's quest. Stop the run (`ogre end getquest`) first, then reload.
- **Changed** · Console: **"`ogre overseer populate` waits for the run to end".** While the daily Overseer run is going, `ogre overseer populate` now says "the daily Overseer run is in progress - ask again when it ends" and changes nothing; the run carries on. Before, a populate in the middle of a run dropped the run without finishing it, and no Overseer run could start again until OgreBot was reloaded. Wait for the run to end, or stop it (`ogre overseer stop`), then populate.
- **Changed** · Console: **IRC auth commands show in OgreConsole even when sent with !ci.** Auth commands sent over IRC with the invisible !ci marker (-auth, -unauth, -authlist, -list_sessions, -killsession, Auth raid and -AIIR) now show in OgreConsole, marked "(invisible)". Every other !ci line stays hidden, as before.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **"Effect tracking keeps saving when a name has an odd character".** The effect tracker now saves its zone files, its known effects and its fight log even when an effect or NPC name holds a character it cannot read. That character is saved as a placeholder. Before, the save failed and could stop the game; the same fix covers the other saves and windows that hold game or typed names.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **"Rage of Cthurath raid fights: mechanics fixed in a review pass".** Temper's Raging Curse now moves only the cursed player, and Darathar's Draconic Misdirection moves the right players and keeps asking for the cure. Kryterion now calls when an attunement is gone, Cthurath keeps a stood-down fighter off the named, and Benelith clicks the nearest crystal. Swarmguard, Oogiloi Eye, Ghouly Ghast, Emnitiun, Phyorn, Veru, Agent of Disgust, the Unseen and Tha'Bael also got timing and targeting fixes.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Merc abilities wait while your mercenary is suspended.** A suspended mercenary still shows its name, so merc abilities such as Shrink Mercenary were tried with no merc in the world. The cast stack now casts them only when your mercenary is actually summoned.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **"For Who \"Me\", \"Group\" and \"Raid\" are not sent from character select".** At character select or the login screen, a Master Control Panel button with For Who set to Me, Group or Raid now says "not sent - no character yet" instead of sending. Before, after you camped, it was sent for the character you had just camped from.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **"For Who \"Me\", \"Group\" and \"Raid\" name you while you zone".** A Master Control Panel button sent with For Who set to Me, Group or Raid now names your character even while you zone, so a pause sent mid-zone reaches your group. The Overseer group buy now sends to the For Who you picked; before, Me, Group and Raid did not work there. If no character has loaded yet, the button says "not sent - no character yet" instead of sending.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **"Instance Controller saves when a name has an odd character".** The Instance Controller now saves its window settings, its queue and each run's values even when a character, zone or list name holds a character it cannot read. That character is saved as a placeholder. Before, the save failed.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **"The Instance Controller starts nothing at character select".** At character select, at the login screen or while zoning, `ogre ic run`, `ogre ic runlist`, `ogre ic wipe` and the Run button now say there is no character in the world and do nothing. Before, a run started from character select sent your setup list with no character to send it for. Stop, End, Pause, Resume and the settings commands still work there.
- **Fixed** · Console: **"`ogre craft`, `ogre patch` and `ogre encounter` say what your word runs".** The "Loading ... via:" line now names what the word you typed runs, for example `ogre encounter reload` says `ISXOgreEQ2.Encounter:Reload`. Before, it named the command's default action for every word.
- **Fixed** · Console: **"`ogre overseer stop` during a populate ends just the populate; `probe` waits for the run".** `ogre overseer stop` while `ogre overseer populate` is running now ends the populate and says "populate stopped". Before, it said "run done" and held off the next daily Overseer run for an hour, though no run had started. While the daily Overseer run is going, `ogre overseer probe` now says "the daily Overseer run is in progress - ask again when it ends" and leaves the run alone.
- **Fixed** · Console: **"A session at character select answers to no character's name".** A session at character select or the login screen no longer acts on commands sent to the character it camped from, to that character's class or to its group (`igw:`). Commands sent to everyone, or to the session by its own name, still reach it. While zoning, your character still answers as before.
- **Fixed** · Console: **"Commands sent by group slot, group leader or role reach you while you zone".** A command aimed by raid group (`g1` to `g4`), by `groupleader`, by role (`@Tank`, `@Healer1`) or by archetype slot (`@Scout1`) now reaches a character that is zoning, which answers from its group as it was just before the zone. So a pause sent to them mid-zone arrives on time. Commands aimed by actor id, `@PCTarget` or `@NPCsTarget` still skip a zoning character, and a session at character select answers to none of these.
- **Fixed** · Console: **"Raid commands, and your newest group, reach you while you zone".** A command aimed at your raid (`irw:` and its forms) now reaches a character that is zoning, as `igw:` already did, answered from the raid as it was just before the zone. A character that changes group or raid and then zones now answers to the new one, even when no command reached it in between, and the same holds on the first zone after the extension is reloaded. A session at character select still answers to none of these.
- **Fixed** · Other: **"`OgreBotAPI.Access.UnauthPCsNearMe` answers for every account".** `${OgreBotAPI.Access.UnauthPCsNearMe}` now works on every account. It is TRUE when a player who is not one of your own characters (the characters in your accounts list) is closer than the distance you give it (999 if you give none). Before, it could read NULL.
- **Fixed** · Other: **"Coming from Classic: `-cs-set-cs-jo-ji-opt` points at commands that exist".** The coming-from-classic console page and the converter told you to change `-cs-set-cs-jo-ji-opt` to `-cs-jo-ji`, which no longer exists. They now say to write the three steps it did: `-campspot <who> <min> <max>`, `-joustoff <joustoff>` and `-joustin <joustin>`, the same as `-cs-jo-ji`.
- **Fixed** · Other: **"Coming from Classic: arguments the new call still takes are no longer listed as dropped".** The coming-from-classic pages and converter listed arguments of seven calls as dropped, such as the potion name of `OgreBotAPI:Change_StatPotionsAutoConsume`, though the new call takes them; only real drops are listed now. `-Poison_AutoConsume` and `-Poison_Replenish` now say to name the poison: left blank, the new rows refuse it or pull a stat potion. Eight console argument descriptions that were cut off are whole again.
- **Fixed** · Other: **"Coming from Classic: ItemCount, the zone reset reload and Ask point at what works".** The coming-from-classic pages and the converter said `Obj_OgreUtilities.ItemCount` does nothing yet and `ZoneReset_PopulateInternalMemory` is not ported, but both have working twins: `${OgreBotAPI.Inventory.Count[<name>,contains]}` and `OgreBotAPI.Zone:ResetUpdateInfo[<who>]` (then wait for `${OgreBotAPI.Zone.ResetReady}`). `OgreBotAPI.Ask` and the `Ask_*` calls now point at `OgreBotAPI.Comms.GroupQuery`, which their instructions already described.
- **Fixed** · Other: **"Coming from Classic: SetQuestion is a setting, and -Ask points at GroupQuery".** The coming-from-classic pages and the converter said `OgreBotAPI:SetQuestion` is not ported. It sets one option, which the new bot has: write `OgreBotAPI.Options:Set[<who>,checkbox_loot_donotlootshinies,TRUE]` (TRUE = do not loot shinies). The `-Ask` console command now points at `OgreBotAPI.Comms.GroupQuery` too.
- **Fixed** · Other: **"Coming from Classic: the poison calls are ported, and the Ask counts are in GroupQuery".** The coming-from-classic pages and converter said `OgreBotAPI:Change_PoisonAutoConsume` and `Get_Poisons` are not ported: they are `OgreBotAPI.Inventory:AutoConsumeStatPotions` and `OgreBotAPI.Consumables:ReplenishStatPotions`, and now need the poison's name. The Ask counts point at GroupQuery, as the Ask calls do: `answeredCount` and `yesCount` in `${OgreBotAPI.Comms.GroupQuery.Result[<id>]}`. The embargo note no longer says `Abilities:AddEmbargo` takes no for-who: it takes one first.

## 2026.10.30.002 {#r2026-10-30-002}

*Friday, October 30, 2026 at 2:02 AM EDT*

- **Fixed** · Crafting: **Crafting reads your whole recipe book, even a very large one.** With a large recipe book, the bot could read only part of it, so a recipe a quest had just given you could be reported as "not a recipe in your book". It now keeps the recipe book open until the game has finished listing every recipe, and never opens it while a craft is running.
- **Fixed** · Console: **An Auth raid button sent over IRC now works.** An Auth raid or Unauth raid MCP button set to send over IRC did nothing: every bridge read it as a request for a character named "all". It now runs on your own characters, and your bridge asks the raid once, the same as a button sent through OgreConsole.

## 2026.10.30.001 {#r2026-10-30-001}

*Friday, October 30, 2026 at 12:11 AM EDT*

- **New** · Bot: **"Illicus, Zon Zobboz Swarmer in Revelations of Consequence [Raid] is set up".** The bot now sets up Illicus in Zon Zobboz: Revelations of Consequence [Raid]: camp spots, curse cures on, joust out, and a spread spot for each player with Crowded Animosity. His reflect puts up a 45-second REFLECT UP timer and backs pets off, and fighters hear "reflect up", "reflect down" and "Eye up" for the Commanding Eye. You still handle the mezzing.
- **New** · Console: **Auth raid authorizes everyone in your raid on IRC in one click.** The new Auth raid command (-RaidAuth, ready for an MCP button) has every IRC bridge with a character in your raid authorize the others, and nobody outside the raid. Each PC posts one line, and every ask and answer shows in OgreConsole. Unauth raid (-RaidUnauth) takes back only the nicks added that way; nicks you authorized by hand stay.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **"Aveliur: with movement on, each group hides behind its corpse".** With Aveliur_Movement on, each raid group now heads for its tentacle corpse about half a second after the corpses land and stays hidden for the full 15 seconds; before, the hide ended almost at once. Within 5m of the hide spot counts as hidden, a pull outside a raid behaves as group 1, and corpses already lying there when the fight restarts no longer start a false Hide.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **"Illicus: everyone with Crowded Animosity gets their own spread spot".** In both Illicus fights (The Outer Swarmyard and Revelations of Consequence), players hit by Crowded Animosity now wait two seconds for everyone's report before picking a spread spot. Two players no longer end up on the same spot, and nobody is left standing in the group.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **"Timed fight steps no longer end the moment they start".** In 20 fights a timed step (a hide, a joust out, a HUD countdown, a failsafe) could end a moment after it started instead of waiting out its time. Among them: Aveliur, Y'lus, Frejn, Emnitiun, The Soulbleeder, Do'Guen, Iron Forged Constructs, Kyrus of the Old Ways, The Kly, Xalgoz, Trakanon, Guardian of Arcanna'se, Sir Rouland, Kluzen, Beefcake, Chohnkanon and Territus.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Mercenary abilities are no longer cast when you have no mercenary up.** Shrink Mercenary and Mercenary Aspect: Roehn Theer (both forms) only work on your own mercenary, but the bot kept trying to cast them with no mercenary up. It now skips them until a mercenary is up.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **OgreBot mini shows "Campspot active" instead of "Following" while a camp spot is on.** With a camp spot on, the mini window's status line still said it was following someone, even though the bot does not follow while a camp spot holds the character. It now shows "Campspot active" whenever a camp spot is on.
- **Fixed** · Console: **IRC bridge commands from others are shown, and auth changes are said only when real.** OgreConsole now shows every IRC bridge command another person sends, such as -auth or -unauth, and commands from people who are not authorized, which are not run. Auth lines are said only when the list really changed, and your own IRC name is always authorized and never announced. Several -AIIR on one line now work, and the reply from your own sessions no longer posts to the channel.
- **Fixed** · Console: **IRC says what it is doing, and "ogre irc" connects with the settings saved now.** OgreConsole now shows each IRC connection step - connecting, joined the channel, connection lost, stopped - and what a settings reload changed, such as the old and new channel. `ogre irc` reads the saved settings every time it connects, so a channel changed in OgreConsoleIRC.json is no longer ignored. A failing server's retries are shown once, not every 15 seconds.

## 2026.10.29.003 {#r2026-10-29-003}

*Thursday, October 29, 2026 at 8:41 PM EDT*

- **Changed** · Windows: **"ogre craft minimize, and ogre export brings back the window an export hid".** `ogre craft minimize` (and `ISXOgreEQ2.Craft:Minimize`) rolls the craft window up to its run controls while crafting keeps going, and `ogre craft` brings it back. Typing `ogre export` while an export runs now shows its window again without stopping the export. `ogre export close` is gone: let it run, or end it with `ogre end export` or the window's X.
- **Changed** · Console: **"Removed: ogre ic close, ogre craftingmats close and the Nav window's Close button".** A window that hid itself while its work kept running is no longer an option: you let it run, or you end it with `ogre end <command>` or the window's X. `ogre ic close` and `ogre craftingmats close` are now unknown words, and the Nav window has no Close button - move or resize it instead; its STOP button and X work as before.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Characters rejoin the bot's relay group after ISBoxer clears it.** When ISBoxer loads a character set it takes every session out of all its relay groups, which left the bot's group commands unable to reach those characters. Each session now joins the bot's relay group again the moment that happens, along with any groups in your Relay Groups auto-join list, as the old bot did.
- **Fixed** · Console: **"ogre end" and the X now fully close eleven more commands.** `ogre end` and the window's X now stop what the command is doing and close its window for Analysis, Effect Tracker, Level Transmuting, Safe Fall, NPC Cast, Zone Reset, Travel Helper, Hide Effects and Codex Inspect. `ogre end windowreset` closes Reset UI Windows. Zone Reset stops only what it started itself, so a zone read the Instance Controller asked for keeps going.
- **Fixed** · Console: **"ogre end" and the X now fully close the Instance Controller and six other commands.** `ogre end ic` only paused the Instance Controller; it now stops the run and closes the window, the same as the window's X. Export, Crafting Mats, Task Runner, Pot CB and Watcher also stop what they are doing and close their windows on `ogre end` or the X. `ogre end atb` no longer closes OgreBot; use `ogre end bot` for that.
- **Fixed** · Console: **"The window X now ends Ogre Craft, Craft Grandmasters, Inventory Manager and Nav".** Closing these windows with the X now does what `ogre end` does: Ogre Craft ends all crafting, Craft Grandmasters stops its run, Inventory Manager stops its work and Nav stops the trip. `ogre end nav` now closes the Nav window too, and `ogre end mesh` also cancels a trip you ordered while zoning. The X on OgreBot now closes it the same way as `ogre end bot`, so the relay group close settings apply and no combat hold is left behind.

- **New** · Bot: **Crowd Control now mezzes the adds on your group.** With Enable Crowd Control ticked, the bot now mezzes extra mobs that are attacking your group, using the Crowd Control tab's Priority Order list, top first. - **Changed** · Bot: **SpewStats faction and currency events say "Faction" and "Currency", as classic OgreBot.** The `OgreEvent_SpewStats` events a SpewStat faction or currency check sends now have `Command` set to `Faction` or `Currency`, the same words classic OgreBot sends. Before, they were `-faction <name>` and `-currency <name>`. This covers the faction "Not Found" event too.

Before, it set the cures for no class, or for the character you had just camped. Send it again once a character is in the world.

Max wait per zone never turns text into "no limit": text that is not a number changes nothing and says why, below 0 becomes 1 second, and a fraction rounds up. Adding a zone to the queue says "queued row" again, from the panel and `ogre ic queue add` alike.

- **Fixed** · Bot: **A class override set with ClassInfo_ChangeValue stays with its character.** A class override set with ClassInfo_ChangeValue, such as making a character count as a fighter, now applies only to the character it was set for. It now does nothing unless you are in the world, and a pony run that a zone or camp interrupts simply ends and tries again later.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Pack Pony works on characters that have a pet out.** A character with its own pet summoned (a coercer's Possess Essence, a necromancer's or summoner's pet and so on) always failed with "could not find the pack pony", because the game reports the pony differently when you already have a pet. The pony is now found either way, and if it ever is not, the message lists every spawn the bot saw so the cause can be read straight from it.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Raid invites skip members of your group.** A raid invite - `-RaidInvite` in OgreConsole, `OgreBotAPI.Roster:RaidInvite` in scripts, a `-r` name in `-Inviter`, or a "raid invite" tell - now skips a character who is already in your group, the way the console's raid invite works in classic OgreBot. Before, that character was sent a raid invite.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Sell and destroy lists keep each item's For Who.** An item on your sell or destroy list that you limited to some characters, such as `{ "forwho": "scout" }`, now keeps that limit when you add or remove another item. Before, the next change saved it as everyone, so on the destroy list more characters destroyed it. A For Who you set on a name from the shipped list is now saved too.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Yynzik and Arachlord Dyrraga print a setting command that works.** At set up, Yynzik the Scornridden and Arachlord Dyrraga print the command to change their fight settings. That command now works: it reads `OgreBotAPI.Vars:Set[...]`. Before, it named a command the new bot does not have, so typing it did nothing.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **A box no longer appears after your text in OgreBot's text fields.** Some players got an invisible control character, drawn as a box, added to a field (a Cast Stack HP % for example), which made the value invalid. Control characters are now kept out of every OgreBot text field. If you still see one, click Keyboard dump on the Debug tab (or type `ogre keys`) and send the lines: they now list the last characters sent to a field and where each came from.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **A quick drag in a list lands where you let go.** A row dragged quickly and let go at once, in the Cast Stack, the OgreBot lists, the Instance Controller or TaskRunner Lists, could stay where it was. It now lands where you let go.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **Minimizing the MCP rolls it up to its title bar instead of stretching it across the screen.** Clicking Minimize on the Master Control Panel made its title bar grow wider and wider until it filled the screen, and restoring left it the wrong size. It now rolls up to its title bar like every other window and comes back at the size it had.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **The Commands window's argument box reads text like the console.** The argument box in the Commands window now reads what you type exactly as the console reads the same text after `ogre <command>`. Inside quotes, `\"` is a quote and `\\` is one backslash, so write `\\` to keep a backslash in a quoted path. Text with no backslash in it reads as it always did.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **IC run says what is missing.** `ogre ic run` and `ISXOgreEQ2.IC:Run` given only part of a zone file, or none of it, now say which part is missing, with the same line from the console and from a script. Before, a script call with nothing given said "no such zone file: /".
- **Fixed** · Navigation: **Nav status and reset now cover the route settings too.** `ogre nav status` now lists every nav setting you have changed from its default, including the route settings funnelclear, ledgeclear, nearcost, stepcost and dumppath, which it used to leave out. `ogre nav -reset` now puts those back too, all at once or one with `ogre nav -reset <setting>`. The status list and `ogre nav -set` now call them all settings rather than tunables.
- **Fixed** · Console: **-Cast_Interrupt stops your current cast first.** `-Cast_Interrupt` now cancels the cast you are in the middle of before it casts the interrupt, unless that cast is already an interrupt, the way OldBot did. Before, it left the current cast running.
- **Fixed** · Console: **A quoted word after an `ogre` command arrives whole.** A quoted word you type after an `ogre` command now reaches it whole, even with a comma, bracket or quote inside. `ogre find "Krayte, Titan of Colors"` watches for that one NPC instead of splitting the name into pieces. A quoted value with spaces stays one word too: `ogre pushover Pull now -title "Raid Night"` titles the alert Raid Night.
- **Fixed** · Console: **Guild talk sent through OgreConsole shows exactly as typed.** With "Broadcast guild talk through OgreConsole" on, a guild or officer line now reaches every session's OgreConsole exactly as it was typed. Before, some symbols in the line could be read as script, which changed what was shown.
- **Fixed** · Console: **oc and irc come back on their own if the old OgreBot extension tries to load.** If something ran the old OgreBot extension in a session where the new OgreBot was already running, the old extension was refused but deleted the oc and irc commands on its way out, so oc answered "Unknown command". The new OgreBot now notices within a second, registers both again, and says so in the console.
- **Fixed** · Console: **OgreConsole reads \" and \\ inside quotes.** Inside a quoted word, OgreConsole now reads `\"` as a quote and `\\` as a backslash, the way LavishScript does, so a word with a quote in it no longer splits in two. A backslash inside quotes now escapes the next character, so write `\\` to keep one. The `-tab`, `-rg` and `-cfw` values read the same way, and MCP buttons, `oc` lines and the bot's own group and fight commands are written this way for you.
- **Fixed** · Setup: **The auto-login runner links the Auto-Login guide.** The uplink's auto-login runner showed a placeholder ("TODO(A7): ...") where its help pointed you to the setup guide, both when you had no profiles yet and under Help. It now gives the address of the Auto-Login page in the documentation, the same page the Auto-Login window's ? button opens.
- **Fixed** · Setup: **The core's log is now one file per session, like the game adapter's.** The ISXOgreX log was one file that every session rewrote when it loaded, so on a six-box setup only the last session's lines survived. Each session now writes its own, with the session's name in the file name, the same way the ISXOgreEQ2 log already does. When sending logs for a problem, send both files for the session that had it.
- **Fixed** · Other: **Effect tracker saves a mob's effect description under the right effect.** With descriptions on, the effect tracker now finds a mob's effect again right before it reads its name and description. Before, if the mob's effects had shifted since the effect was spotted, it could save a different effect's name or description under this one.
- **Removed** · Console: **Anti-AFK, Overseer, Craft and nine more tools are `ogre` commands only.** `ogreafk`, `ogredets`, `ogreexamine`, `ogreharvestlite`, `ogreabilityefficiency`, `ogreabilityupgrades`, `ogrereplenishnames`, `ogremerchantcraft`, `ogrerefine`, `ogreoverseer`, `buyoverseermissions`, `ogrecraft` and `ogre ogrecraft` are gone. Type `ogre` and `afk`, `dets`, `examine`, `hl`, `ae`, `oau`, `replenishnames`, `mc`, `refine`, `overseer`, `buyoverseermissions` or `craft` with the same words. Scripts call `${ISXOgreEQ2.AntiAfk:Run[...]}`, `Overseer:Run`, `Craft:Run` and the like.
- **Removed** · Console: **Get Quest, Find, Track Shiny, Nav and Pot/CB are `ogre` commands only.** The separate `ogregetquest`, `ogrefind`, `ogretrackshiny`, `ogrenav` and `ogrepotcb` commands are gone. Type `ogre getquest`, `ogre find`, `ogre trackshiny`, `ogre nav` and `ogre potcb` with the same words, and `ogre end <name>` to stop one. Scripts can call `${ISXOgreEQ2.GetQuest:Run[...]}`, `${ISXOgreEQ2.Watcher:Find[...]}` / `:TrackShiny[...]`, `${ISXOgreEQ2.Nav:Run[...]}` and `${ISXOgreEQ2.PotCb:Run[...]}`.
- **Removed** · Console: **Perf, Heartstone, Experiment, Codex and Travel Survey are `ogre` commands only.** The separate `ogreperf`, `ogreheartstone`, `ogreexperiment`, `ogrecodextoon`, `ogrecodexinspect` and `ogretravelsurvey` commands are gone. Type `ogre perf`, `ogre heartstone`, `ogre experiment`, `ogre codextoon`, `ogre codexinspect` and `ogre travelsurvey` with the same words. Scripts can call `${ISXOgreEQ2.Perf:Run[...]}`, `Heartstone:Run`, `Experiment:Run`, `Codex:Toon` / `:Inspect` and `TravelSurvey:Run`.
- **Removed** · Console: **The Quest Helper's command is `ogre quest` only.** The separate `ogrequesthelper` command is gone. Use `ogre quest` (or `ogre qh` / `ogre questhelper`): `ogre quest 1`, `ogre quest status`, `ogre quest list`, `ogre quest reload`, and `ogre end quest` to stop it. Scripts can call `${ISXOgreEQ2.QuestHelper:Run[<verb>]}` with the same words.

## 2026.10.27.006 {#r2026-10-27-006}

*Tuesday, October 27, 2026 at 5:08 PM EDT*

- **New** · Windows: **Every Ogre window can be minimized to its title bar.** A new arrow in each window's title bar rolls the window up to its title bar where it sits, and restores it to the same size; double-clicking the title bar does the same. The right-click menu also has Minimize all windows / Restore all windows. A window always opens at its normal size.
- **New** · Instance Controller: **The Instance Controller runs Sodden Archipelago - The Forsaken Isle.** The Instance Controller can now run Sodden Archipelago: The Forsaken Isle at Solo, Heroic I and Heroic II. It does all five nameds with their chests and shinies, and the bonus named Charred Lemange when he is up. New fight files handle Tavvi Ticky's stomp, ask for an Intercept when Xavaree or Valahal Den puts Insatiable Hunger on you, and on Heroic II take the group down below the platform to fight Valahal Den.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **A huge spread ring no longer stalls loading, and a negative id or count is ignored.** A fight file's spread ring with a very large spot count, or a very small degree step, built hundreds of millions of spots while the fight loaded. A ring now stops at 360 spots, one per degree, and is still a whole ring. A negative number written for an id, a count or a quantity no longer turns into a number around 4 billion; the setting keeps its normal default.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **A mistyped on/off word no longer turns a setting off.** A script verb that switches a setting on or off read any word it did not know as off, so a typo such as `Movement:SetRunMode[all,run]` walked instead of running. A word that is not one of 1/0, TRUE/FALSE, yes/no or on/off now leaves the setting as it was. Leaving the value out still does what the verb documents.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **FaceLoc, Waypoint and FaceAngle refuse a missing argument; the converter flags short calls.** `Movement:FaceLoc`, `Waypoint` and `FaceAngle` no longer treat a missing or blank coordinate or angle as 0 (facing or marking 0,0, or facing north) - the call is refused with one console line naming what it needs; a 0 you pass still works. The script converter no longer marks a Classic call DONE when it leaves off an argument the new call requires (an `AbilityEmbargo_AddRotateTimer[id]` with no duration, say); it lists it as a to-do.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Move and mouse calls missing a coordinate now say so instead of going to 0,0.** Script calls that move the toon or the mouse - `Movement:Move2Area`, `Move2AreaNoTarget`, `ToLoc`, `NavTo`, `FaceLockLoc` and `Client:SetMousePosition` - no longer treat a missing coordinate as 0 (walking toward 0,0 or sending the mouse to the corner), and `Abilities:AddEmbargo` no longer runs without its duration. A call with one of these left off or blank is refused with one console line naming what it needs; a 0 you actually pass still works.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Movement distance and position reads now use the actor id you pass.** OgreBotAPI.Movement.DistanceTo, Distance2DTo, HeadingTo, AlreadyFacing, BehindLoc, FrontLoc, RightLoc and LeftLoc read the actor id from the wrong place, so they answered about no actor (and BehindLoc[id,5] took 5 as the id). They now read the id you pass first and the distance second. Movement.PointToward also read every coordinate one place late and now reads them in the order written.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **Dragging an Instance Controller row lands where the line shows.** When the Instance Controller window updated while you were dragging a row in the queue or the startup options list, the row could drop at the end of the list, or not move at all, whatever line was drawn. The window now waits until you let go, so the row lands where the line shows, and then shows the update.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **Fight file castMonitor can run extra actions.** A fight file's `castMonitor` step can now run extra actions when the named casts: list them in its `steps`, for example `{ "do": "template", "use": "castMonitor", "steps": [ { "do": "joust", "op": "out" } ] }`. They run after the interrupt, or on their own with `"interrupt": false`. Before, there was no way to write them in a fight file, and an unknown action or field inside `steps` is now refused when the file loads.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **Fight file random numbers no longer crash the game.** A fight file's `{ "random": [min, max] }` no longer crashes the game client when the range is very wide (for example `[0, 4294967295]`). A range written backwards now works too: `[5, 1]` picks from 1 to 5, both ends included, the same as `[1, 5]` (before, it always gave the first number). The only range a fight file now refuses at load is one that covers every whole number there is.
- **Fixed** · Navigation: **Navigation no longer stalls and fails beside large objects.** A trip ending close to a large object (a tent or a depot in a guild hall, for example) no longer stands still a few steps from its goal and then gives up as "stuck" - it walks on to the goal. A new nav order sent while a trip is still running now replaces that trip, instead of being refused with "movement is blocked by another subsystem". The movement log also writes each destination once, instead of the same two lines many times a second.
- **Fixed** · Crafting: **Level transmuting's stop line names stones and visits.** When level transmuting stops, its console line said "bought N" for the stones bought. It now names both counts, for example "stones bought 12, visits 4", the same words the Transmute window uses.
- **Fixed** · Console: **oc commands go to the relay group set on the Relay Groups tab.** Every oc line and cross-session command still went to every EverQuest II session (ogre_everquest2), whatever relay group the Relay Groups tab set, because the uplink passed them all on to that one group. They now go to your configured group, and oc -rg sends a single line to the group you name.

- **Fixed** · Bot: **A Cast Stack entry ignores its Target when the ability no longer needs one.** When an ability changes from single target to group (an epic upgrade, for example) and a new export says so, an entry still aimed at someone like @Tank kept trying to cast it on that one player, or not at all when they were missing. A self, group or raid buff now ignores the Target, and every such ability is cast plainly instead of on a named player; a group heal still waits until the named player is hurt.

The bot now targets the pet, casts, and puts your target back, and it sees when the buff is already on the pet. Tick Enable Pets in Dropdowns to pick pets in the Target list.

## 2026.10.26.003 {#r2026-10-26-003}

*Monday, October 26, 2026 at 11:59 PM EDT*

- **New** · Windows: **Scripts can move and size any Ogre window.** ISXOgreX.UI:Move[name,x,y] and ISXOgreX.UI:Size[name,width,height] place any open window by its name - your own, or OgreBot's such as mcp and osa - in the same screen pixels ${ISXOgreX.UI.Window[name]} reads back. A script's move is not saved; the window still opens where the player last put it. See Build your own window in the developer docs.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Camping out of a busy zone no longer crashes the game.** Camping to the login screen or to another character could crash the game about a second later, most often in a furnished guild hall with hundreds of objects. Ogre kept reading the zone's objects while the game was already removing them; it now lets go of them the moment the camp or zone starts.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **ogre Name loads OgreBot once after switching characters.** Switching to another character with ogre Name while OgreBot was open loaded the bot twice in a row: once on its own for the new character and once more for the command. It now loads once, the way you typed it (for example ogre Name -p comes up paused).
- **Fixed** · Crafting: **Crafting no longer skips recipes right after you zone.** After logging in or zoning, the game shows no recipes until the recipe book is opened, and the bot could not read a recipe's details until then, so it skipped the recipe ("could not determine the crafting device"). It now opens the book first and waits for the whole list to arrive.
- **Fixed** · Setup: **Auto-Login no longer opens an extra session when one is still starting.** After ISBoxer launched a set, a session that was still starting did not answer in time, and Auto-Login launched another client in its slot. A session InnerSpace lists is now always used: Auto-Login waits for it to answer before logging into it, and never launches a second one.

## 2026.10.26.001 {#r2026-10-26-001}

- **Fixed** · Bot: **Cast Stack - an equipped-slot entry no longer chain-casts a clicky adornment.** A Cast Stack entry for an equipment slot (an _EQUIPPED_ entry) whose clicky is really an adornment on that gear was used again and again, because the bot only knew the item's own effects and never saw the buff as up. The entry now reads the item and every adornment on it, so it waits while the buff is up. Each adornment is examined once and remembered.

## 2026.10.24.004 {#r2026-10-24-004}

*Saturday, October 24, 2026 at 6:18 PM EDT*

- **New** · Other: **Scripts get a timer - ogretimer.** Scripts can declare a countdown: `variable ogretimer Timer_X` (stopped) or `variable ogretimer Timer_X = 1500` (running, ms), then `Timer_X:SetSeconds[20]` and read `${Timer_X.TimeLeft}` (ms left), `.SecondsLeft` and `.Running`. ## 2026.10.24.002 {#r2026-10-24-002}

*Saturday, October 24, 2026 at 4:43 PM EDT*

- **New** · Setup: **Auto-login can launch an ISBoxer character set.** An auto-login profile can now name an ISBoxer character set (the list shows this PC's sets). Start launches that set through ISBoxer first, then logs your characters into the sessions it opened, and only launches a session that is still missing. Sessions opened under a game profile that does not load the new bot get it loaded before the login.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **"Not enough concentration" rebuffs again.** When the game says "Not enough concentration", the bot again cancels your concentration buffs, so the cast stack can recast them into the slots you have. It tells the group "Max Concentration! Removing buffs and rebuffing." It does nothing if you have turned off the cast stack's buffs.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **Old unpack MCP buttons work again.** MCP buttons that still used -Unpack_Quantity, a reward choice straight after the item, or the Empyral / Planar stone unpack rows stopped working when unpacking became one -Unpack command. They are now rewritten once to that command with -qty, -pick or -all, for example `-Unpack auto "Zon Zobboz Heritage Crate" -qty 20`. Your old MCP file is kept beside it as OgreMCP.json.unpackfix.bak.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **The Auto-Login window resizes properly.** Making the Auto-Login window taller now makes the log at the bottom bigger too, and making it smaller again no longer lets you scroll the whole window so the log disappears. The column headers line up with the boxes under them, the number boxes keep one size, and Dry run and Start stay together when the window gets narrow.
- **Fixed** · Crafting: **Exporting a few abilities is fast.** An ability export that names only some abilities ("Just these abilities", or the export crafting runs when a reaction bar shows an art it does not know) now looks at just those abilities. It used to read and examine every tradeskill ability in your book first, which could take well over a minute; a crafting round's few new arts now take seconds.
- **Fixed** · Crafting: **Far Seas Crafting Station reactions are used.** Crafting at the Far Seas Crafting Station now answers its own reactions (Hold It, Pop Knuckles, Grounded, Concentrate Hard, Awaken and Extinguish). These six arts now ship with the bot in a new file, ReactionArtsSpecial.json, which is applied after the bot's own ability export, so an export can no longer lose or re-file them. Your own custom ReactionArts.json still overrides it.
- **Fixed** · Crafting: **Quest crafting understands more step wordings.** Quest crafting now finds the recipe for steps such as "Cook the seasoned fish on the fire" (Svarni Seasoned Fish), "Craft a Child's Pillow for Alghoza", "Craft the scrolls of Enhanced Undead Control" (one Scroll of...) and "Craft some paper" (Sheaf of Paper - when several recipes fit, the one you scribed most recently is used). It crafts one, then checks the quest moved before making more.
- **Fixed** · Console: **"ogre <name> -ph" loads the bot paused.** `ogre <name> -p` and `ogre <name> -ph` (and `ogre bot <name> -ph`) now log the character in and load the bot paused, with -ph also hiding the main window. The flag after the name used to be ignored, so the bot loaded running. A word after the name that is not -p or -ph is now refused with a message instead of being ignored.
- **Fixed** · Console: **The uplink console window opens again.** The OgreConsole window in the InnerSpace uplink could fail with "Script file 'OgreConsole/uplink/OgreConsoleUplink' not found", because its script was never shipped with the new bot. It now ships under Scripts\Ogre\Common\OgreConsole, so the window opens when the console hub loads.
- **Fixed** · Setup: **Auto-login sees sessions you opened yourself.** Auto-login now finds the EverQuest II sessions already open on that PC, including ones launched by ISBoxer or by hand, and logs into them instead of opening new ones. It used to see only sessions it had launched itself, so with ISBoxer it opened a full new set of sessions.
- **Fixed** · Setup: **Auto-login Start from the panel finds your profile again.** Pressing Start (or Dry run) in the in-game auto-login window failed with "No profile named" for every profile, because the name reached the uplink with quote marks around it. The name now arrives as you typed it, including names with spaces. Desktop shortcuts were not affected.
- **Fixed** · Setup: **The ISXOgreX InnerSpace profile is added whatever you named the game.** The migration now adds the "Everquest 2 ISXOgreX" InnerSpace profile under every InnerSpace game that runs EverQuest2.exe, whatever the game is called. It used to look only for a game named Everquest 2 or EverQuest II, so a game you made yourself (such as "EQ2") was skipped. If yours was skipped, load the new bot again and it is added.

## 2026.10.24.001 {#r2026-10-24-001}

*Saturday, October 24, 2026 at 12:46 AM EDT*

- **New** · Bot: **TaskRunner can run your destroy list after the harvest depot.** TaskRunner Lists has a new chore option, **Destroy list after depot**. With it and **Harvest depot after** both on, a Pack Pony run deposits its harvests, then destroys the items on your Ogre IM destroy list (ogre im -destroy -end) to clear out the excess. Paste it to whoever is helping you, so they can see what was on screen without asking you to reproduce it.

- **New** · Other: **The script converter follows your #include files.** ogre_convert.py now follows a script's own #include files, so a script split over several files is checked and converted in one run. Ignore Balanced Synergy now works, and a character running a solo HO for a fight does not join in.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Consume Status Ingots uses them all.** Consume Status Ingots no longer stops after a few. An item it cannot use, such as a tradeskill ingot, is skipped after two tries and it goes on to the next one, as the old bot did. Before, the first such item ended the whole run.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Hail works with Assist on.** With Assist on, -Hail no longer hails the character you assist instead of the NPC: the target now stays on the NPC until the hail is done. The same goes for anything else that has to target something for a moment, such as getting or using a flag and repairing gear. If the NPC is still not targeted after a second, the hail is skipped rather than hailing something else.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **No Offensive and No Defensive go by the ability.** No Offensive now holds back every hostile ability in the cast stack, and No Defensive every beneficial one, whatever type the entry is, Custom included. Before, they went by the entry's type, so a Custom entry was never held back by either.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **ogre ae says plainly when it could not write its report.** When `ogre ae` cannot save its report, it now says the report was NOT written and why (for example, Windows refused to create the folder). Before, the failure line ended in the file's path just like the success line, so it read as "here is your file" when there was no file.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Possess Essence pet swap and Channeler dissonance fixed.** The Coercer tab now dismisses a pet of the wrong essence so Possess Essence can go on your preferred archetype, but only once Possess Essence is off cooldown and never against your combat or instance settings. Construct's Sacrifice is no longer recast while it is already on you. Channelers no longer try abilities they lack the dissonance for.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **Spew relay group reports the group in use.** OgreBotAPI.Comms:SpewRelayGroup now reports the relay group each character really sends to, including a group set in the Relay Groups tab, instead of always saying ogre_everquest2.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **The ability research check makes sure the Knowledge book closes.** After checking ability research, the bot now makes sure the Knowledge book has closed, and closes it again if it comes back. It also closes the book when a check ends early. If the book still will not close, a warning in the log says so.
- **Fixed** · Bot: **The relay group setting now moves OgreConsole lines too.** "Send this bot's fleet commands to another group" now also sends OgreConsole lines (such as oc !c -Jump) to that group, so two fleets can be kept apart. Typing a name into its box no longer joins a group for each letter typed: it only sets where this character sends. For a character to hear a group, add it to "Also join these groups".
- **Fixed** · Windows: **Ogre windows stay when the game's screen size changes.** Changing the game's resolution or window size (loading a UI options file with `/load_custom_options_file`, for example) no longer makes every Ogre window disappear, including the HUDs, which then stayed gone even after reloading OgreBot. The windows now stay where they are, a window the smaller screen left off-screen is moved back onto it, and each one gets its own size back on a larger screen.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **The MCP button builder shows which who is chosen.** In Build command, the who list (who ▾) now highlights the choice the field already holds, the way the For Who window does - Auto when the field is auto or blank. Lists for other settings highlight their current value too.
- **Fixed** · Windows: **The OgreBot mini window stays small.** The OgreBot mini window keeps its own small size again, so it no longer grows over the windows beside it. Its cog makes it bigger only while you choose what it shows, so the Done button is never cut off, and it goes back on Done. It also no longer shows the unsaved-changes star; the main OgreBot window still does.
- **Fixed** · Instance Controller: **Pausing the Instance Controller no longer counts against a step's wait.** Time the Instance Controller spends paused is no longer counted against the step it paused in. A walk paused part-way used to fail the moment you resumed it; now every step - walks, loot, nameds, waits - picks up where it stopped.
- **Fixed** · Crafting: **Quest crafting makes steps that are just the recipe's name.** Quest crafting now crafts a quest step that is only the item's name, such as "Delectable Drink (0/4)", when a recipe in your book has exactly that name. Before, only steps that started with a word like Craft or Create were made, and the rest were left for you.
- **Fixed** · Crafting: **Quest crafting waits for components you are still gathering.** Quest crafting no longer fails three times when a step needs a component you have not gathered yet. It says what it is missing and waits, counting again whenever your bags change, then crafts as soon as it is there; after 60 minutes it stops and names what is still missing. When the Begin button is not available, the message now names any missing items.
