# OgreBotAPI.Abilities

## Members

### `CanCastOn`

`${OgreBotAPI.Abilities.CanCastOn[ability,target]}`

Tells you whether you could cast an ability on a target right now, and if not, why. It runs the bot's own castability check (range measured edge to edge, power, cooldown, position, stealth, line of sight, target type), so a script never has to rebuild it.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ability` | ability name or id |  | the ability to check |
| `target` | actor name or id |  | who to cast it on; blank = yourself |

**Returns:** string: "eligible" when it can be cast now. Otherwise the reason: "no ability given", "unresolved" (ability not found), "no valid target" (also when not in the world), "no target", "target gone", "cannot target self", "wrong target type", "target type unreadable", "ability not known", "on cooldown", "just cast this line", "not enough power", "not flanking", "not behind", "position unreadable", "requires stealth", "moving", "distance unreadable", "out of range", "line of sight unknown" or "line of sight blocked".

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Abilities.CanCastOn["Intercept",${Target.ID}]}
```

### `CancelCurrentCast`

`${OgreBotAPI.Abilities.CancelCurrentCast}`

Reads the cancel-current-cast flag that :SetCancelCurrentCast raises. It stays TRUE until the next cast starts or ends, then clears itself.

**Returns:** bool: TRUE while a cancel of the current cast is pending, FALSE otherwise.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Abilities.CancelCurrentCast}
```

### `Count`

`${OgreBotAPI.Abilities.Count}`

The number of usable abilities in the loaded export: one per ability line, the highest rank your level allows.

**Returns:** int: the number of usable abilities, one per line. 0 when no export is loaded.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Abilities.Count}
```

### `FindCastableHOIconAbilityID`

`${OgreBotAPI.Abilities.FindCastableHOIconAbilityID[iconId,options...]}`

Finds an ability you own that matches a heroic opportunity icon and can be cast now, and gives its id without casting it. Your "no stuns"-style settings are honoured; -offensive keeps only hostile abilities, and -ActorID &lt;id> (or -HOTarget &lt;id>) checks against that actor instead of your current NPC target.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `iconId` | number | `0` | the heroic opportunity icon id |
| `options...` | text |  | -offensive, -ActorID &lt;id> or -HOTarget &lt;id>, and the -No options, each on top of your settings boxes: -NoStun, -NoDaze, -NoFear, -NoStifle, -NoInterrupt, -NoDispel, -NoRoot, -NoSnare, -NoCures, -NoGroupCures, -NoForceTargets, -NoThreatIncreases, -NoThreatDecreases. The console names any other option once, and it is ignored. |

**Returns:** int64: the id of the ability to cast. 0 when nothing you own matches the icon or can be cast now.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Abilities.FindCastableHOIconAbilityID[3,-offensive]}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.Get_HOIconAbility`

### `FindCastableID`

`${OgreBotAPI.Abilities.FindCastableID[query...]}`

Picks an ability that is ready now by its properties instead of its name and gives its id without casting it; all terms have to match. Your "no stuns"-style settings still rule abilities out, except for the property you searched on, and a bad query is reported in the console.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query...` | text |  | query terms, each member, comparison, value (such as "IsInterrupt","=","TRUE"), plus options such as -NPCRequired or -ActorID &lt;id> that check against a target |

**Returns:** int64: the id of the matching ability (fastest cast time wins). 0 when nothing matches, when the query is refused, or when no export is loaded.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Abilities.FindCastableID["IsInterrupt","=","TRUE","-NPCRequired"]}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.Get_AbilityTypeID`, `OgreBotAPI.Get_AbilityTypeID_Ref`, `OgreBotAPI.Get_AbilityVia`

### `Ready`

`${OgreBotAPI.Abilities.Ready[fw,ability,actor]}`

Asks whether an ability is ready. Without an actor it checks only that the ability is off cooldown; with an actor it runs the full can-I-cast-this-on-them check (range, power, position, line of sight, target type), the same check as CanCastOn.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `ability` | ability name or id |  | the ability to check |
| `actor` | actor name or id |  | who you would cast it on; blank = cooldown only |

**Returns:** bool: TRUE when the ability is ready (and castable on the actor, if one is given). FALSE when it is not, when the ability or actor cannot be found, when you are not in the world, or when the for-who does not include this character.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Abilities.Ready[all,"Assault"]}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.AbilityReady`


*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:SpewAbility`

### `AddEmbargo`

`OgreBotAPI.Abilities:AddEmbargo[fw, id, durationSec]`

Embargoes an ability: the cast stack skips it for that many seconds while the Enable Ability Embargo setting is ticked. Both the ability and the duration are required (an error is printed otherwise); 0 seconds expires at once.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `id` | ability name or id |  | the ability to embargo |
| `durationSec` | number |  | embargo length in seconds |

```text

```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:AbilityEmbargo_AddRotateTimer`

### `AnnounceCasted`

`OgreBotAPI.Abilities:AnnounceCasted[fw, caster, seconds]`

Tells the bot sessions that a caster has put up a cast-while-moving effect: every session (this one too) in the caster's group lets its rotation cast while moving for that many seconds. A blank caster, or seconds that are missing, 0 or less, or not a number, is refused with a console line and nothing is sent.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `caster` | player name |  | who cast the effect (required) |
| `seconds` | number |  | how long the effect lasts, more than 0 (required) |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Abilities:AnnounceCasted[all,${Me.Name},30]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:CastedCastOnTheMove`

### `AnnounceCasting`

Like AnnounceCasted with you as the caster: every session in your group (this one too) lets its rotation cast while moving for that many seconds. Seconds that are missing, 0 or less, or not a number are refused with a console line and nothing is sent.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |

### `CancelCasting`

`OgreBotAPI.Abilities:CancelCasting[fw, except..., -HOAbility, -HOAbilityUI, -CastTime s, -CastAbility ability, -CastAbilityOnPlayer ability player, -CastHOAbilityIconID iconId, -CastAbilityOnNPC ability mob, -UnlessCasting ability]`

Cancels the spell you are casting, unless it is one of the abilities you name (any rank) or a guard option says to keep it. -CastAbility, -CastAbilityOnPlayer, -CastAbilityOnNPC and -CastHOAbilityIconID queue that cast first; any other -option cancels nothing (a warning is printed once).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `except...` | ability name or id |  | abilities never to cancel |
| `-HOAbility` | flag |  | cancel only an ability that has a heroic opportunity icon |
| `-HOAbilityUI` | flag |  | cancel a heroic opportunity ability only when your settings disable it |
| `-CastTime s` | flag + number |  | cancel only when at least s seconds of the cast remain |
| `-CastAbility ability` | flag + ability name or id |  | queue this ability first, then cancel |
| `-CastAbilityOnPlayer ability player` | flag + ability + player |  | queue this ability on that player first, then cancel |
| `-CastHOAbilityIconID iconId` | flag + number |  | queue the ability with this heroic opportunity icon id first, then cancel |
| `-CastAbilityOnNPC ability mob` | flag + ability + mob name or id |  | queue this ability on that mob first, then cancel |
| `-UnlessCasting ability` | flag + ability name or id |  | the same as naming the ability plainly: never cancel it |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Abilities:CancelCasting[all,-CastTime,0.5,-HOAbilityUI]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:CancelCasting`

Stops (TRUE) or allows (FALSE) AE casting: it sets the ignore-PBAE, ignore-encounter-nukes and ignore-counter-abilities options, casts Singular Focus (Focus Offensive on a Guardian) and cancels class buffs that proc AEs; FALSE cancels the focus buff instead. -allowcounters keeps counter abilities and counter buffs, -AllowEncounters leaves encounter nukes on while disabling, -verbose announces the setting changes, and -aggressive does nothing.

# OgreBotAPI.Access

## Members

### `UnauthPCsNearMe`

`${OgreBotAPI.Access.UnauthPCsNearMe[dist]}`

TRUE when another player character closer to you than dist is not one of the characters saved in your accounts list (EQ2Chars), matched by name ignoring case. Your own character never counts, a nearby player whose name has not loaded counts as not yours, and a dist that is not a number reads as 0, which is always FALSE.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dist` | float | `999` | range from you; a player counts only when strictly closer than this |

**Returns:** bool: TRUE when at least one player character within dist is not one of your saved characters; FALSE when no other player is within dist or every one of them is yours.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Access.UnauthPCsNearMe[200]}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.UnauthPCsNearMe`

## Methods

### `SetLevel`

`OgreBotAPI.Access:SetLevel[fw, value, silent=FALSE]`

Sets this session's access level to value at once, clamped between 0 and the highest level your account has; asking for more than that uses your highest level and prints a warning. The new level is announced in the console only when it actually changed, and silent TRUE hides both the warning and the announcement; it also works at the character select screen.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `value` | int |  | the level to set; below 0 becomes 0, above your highest level becomes your highest level, and a value that is not a number counts as 0 |
| `silent` | bool | `FALSE` | TRUE hides the over-the-maximum warning and the level-changed announcement |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Access:SetLevel[${Me.Name},0]
```

# OgreBotAPI.Actors

## Members

### `CountByName`

`${OgreBotAPI.Actors.CountByName[name,...]}`

Counts the actors around you with this name, an exact match in any case unless -partial is given. Optional flags narrow it by distance and type, and the count is 0 when nothing matches.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | the actor name to count; case does not matter |
| `...` | flags |  | any of: -partial (or -substring) to count names that contain the text; -distance F to count only actors within F (999 or more means no limit, the default); -Type S to count only actors whose Type is S, any case |

**Returns:** int: how many actors match; 0 when none do.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Actors.CountByName["a gnoll",-partial,-distance,30]}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.GetActorCountByName`

### `CountByType`

`${OgreBotAPI.Actors.CountByType[type,-distance,distance]}`

Counts the actors of one Type (NPC, NamedNPC, PC, Corpse and so on, any case), optionally only those within a distance; the type may be a lone word or follow -Type, and each flag and its value are separate arguments. With no type given it counts Type Special, and PC never counts you, because your own Type is Me.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | string | `Special` | the actor Type to count, any case; -Type and then the type works the same |
| `-distance` | string |  | the word -distance, when a distance follows it |
| `distance` | float | `999` | count only actors within this distance; 999 or more means no limit |

**Returns:** int: how many actors of that type are in range; 0 when none are.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Actors.CountByType[NPC,-distance,20]}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.GetActorCountByType`

### `IsPC`

`${OgreBotAPI.Actors.IsPC[actorType]}`

Tells you whether an actor Type word means a player character. Pass the actor's Type, not its name or id.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actorType` | string |  | an actor's Type, such as the value of ${Target.Type} |

**Returns:** bool: TRUE when the type is Me or PC (any case); FALSE for anything else.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Actors.IsPC[${Target.Type}]}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.IsAPC`

### `MobID`

`${OgreBotAPI.Actors.MobID[name]}`

Returns the id of the nearest actor whose name matches exactly, in any case. A number is handed back only when that actor is here, and the usual target words (@ aliases, pet:&lt;owner>, a class word for a group or raid member) are understood too.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | the actor's full name, or an actor id |

**Returns:** int64: the actor id; 0 when no actor matches, the name is blank or that id is not here.

```text

```

*Was (OldBot):* `GetInfoOb.ActorToID`, `GetInfoOb.GetMobID`, `Obj_OgreIH.Get_NPC_ID`

### `NPCsWithin`

`${OgreBotAPI.Actors.NPCsWithin[distance]}`

Counts the living NPCs and named NPCs within the distance, aggro or not, measured edge to edge: your own model size and each mob's size widen the reach, as an area spell around you does. A distance of 0 or less counts nothing and prints a console warning.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `distance` | float |  | the radius around you, above 0 |

**Returns:** int: how many living NPCs and named NPCs are in reach; 0 when none are, when the distance is not above 0, or when the actor list is not ready yet.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Actors.NPCsWithin[10]}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.NPCsWithinRange`

## Methods

### `ApplyVerb`

`OgreBotAPI.Actors:ApplyVerb[fw, actor, verb]`

Applies a verb at once to the actor whose id you give, else the nearest one whose name contains the text, or of that type when the text is a type word, using the game's apply_verb command. A blank actor or verb gets one line, and so does an actor that does not match.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `actor` | string |  | the actor's name or part of it, any case, its actor id, or a type word: npc, namednpc, nokillnpc, pc, special, chest, resource, door |
| `verb` | string |  | the verb as it shows on the actor's right-click menu |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Actors:ApplyVerb[igw:${Me.Name},"Strange Device","Use"]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:ApplyVerbForWho`, `OgreBotAPI:ApplyVerbIDForWho`, `OgreBotAPI:ApplyVerb`

### `ApplyVerbQueued`

`OgreBotAPI.Actors:ApplyVerbQueued[fw, actor, verb, waitDs=40]`

Queues a verb on the actor whose id you give, else the nearest one whose name contains the text, or of that type when the text is a type word, then waits out the cast it starts, exactly as ApplyVerbIDQueued does. The actor is looked up when you call it; a blank actor or verb, or no match, gets one line and queues nothing, and one gone by its turn is dropped with a console line.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `actor` | string |  | the actor's name or part of it, any case, its actor id, or a type word: npc, namednpc, nokillnpc, pc, special, chest, resource, door |
| `verb` | string |  | the verb as it shows on the actor's right-click menu |
| `waitDs` | int | `40` | the longest wait for the cast to end, in tenths of a second |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Actors:ApplyVerbQueued[igw:${Me.Name},"Strange Device","Use"]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:ApplyVerbIDQueuedForWho`, `OgreBotAPI:ApplyVerbQueuedForWho`

### `Click`

`OgreBotAPI.Actors:Click[fw, nameOrId, ...]`

Double-clicks an actor at once: an id as given, or else the nearest interactable actor whose name contains the text (or matches it exactly when the third argument is TRUE). Nothing happens, with no message, when no actor is found.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `nameOrId` | string |  | an actor id, or a name to search for among interactable actors |
| `...` | bool |  | exact: TRUE matches the whole name (any case) instead of any name containing it; default FALSE |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Actors:Click[${Me.Name},"Strange Lever"]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:Actor_Click`, `call Obj_OgreUtilities.HandleClickActor`

### `ClickQueued`

`OgreBotAPI.Actors:ClickQueued[fw, nameOrId, ...]`

Queues a double-click on an actor found the same way as Click, then waits out the cast the click starts. At its turn it waits up to 5 seconds for a free cast bar, clicks once, and holds the cast bar until that cast ends or the wait runs out; an actor gone by then is dropped with a console line.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `nameOrId` | string |  | an actor id, or a name to search for among interactable actors |
| `...` | bool, int |  | exact, then waitDs: exact TRUE matches the whole name instead of any name containing it (default FALSE); waitDs is the longest wait for the cast to end, in tenths of a second (default 40) |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Actors:ClickQueued[${Me.Name},"Ancient Altar",FALSE,60]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:Actor_ClickQueued`, `OgreBotAPI:AltarOfTheAncients`, `OgreBotAPI:TargetAndDoubleClickActor`

### `Hail`

`OgreBotAPI.Actors:Hail[fw, nameOrId]`

Queues a hail: target the actor, face it, then hail, about 0.3 seconds apart, and the hail is abandoned if the target does not change to that actor within 1 second. A blank or 0 hails the nearest nokill NPC within 10 (nothing happens when there is none); a name that finds nobody, or an id that is not here, says so on the console and hails nobody.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `nameOrId` | string |  | an actor id, a name (any actor whose name contains it, nearest first), an @ alias or pet:&lt;owner>; blank or 0 uses the nokill NPC fallback |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Actors:Hail[${Me.Name},${Target.ID}]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:HailNPC`, `call Obj_OgreUtilities.DoHail`, `call Obj_OgreUtilities.DoHailID`

### `SetCastMonitoring`

`OgreBotAPI.Actors:SetCastMonitoring[fw, -watch "<mob>" ..., -unwatch "<mob>, -clear, -radius N]`

Adds or removes the mob names this script asks NPC cast monitoring to watch, or sets the scan radius, for this zone; -watch and -radius also tick NPC Cast Monitoring, and watched mobs in range raise OgreEvent_CastMonitoring_CastingStarted and OgreEvent_CastMonitoring_CastingEnded. Flags run in the order written with one console line each, watches added by the zone or an encounter are never touched, and one bad flag refuses the whole call.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `-watch "<mob>" ...` | string |  | -watch followed by a mob name to watch, matched as a whole name in any case; repeat the pair for more mobs; it ends at the next zone or when NPC Cast Monitoring is unticked, and the tick stays |
| `-unwatch "<mob>` | string |  | -unwatch followed by a mob name to stop watching (only a watch a script added) |
| `-clear` | flag |  | drops every watch scripts added |
| `-radius N` | int |  | -radius followed by the scan radius, a whole number from 5 to 500 (default 50); it beats the zone's own radius and ends at the next zone or when NPC Cast Monitoring is unticked |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Actors:SetCastMonitoring[${Me.Name},-watch,"a ravenous gnoll",-radius,60]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:NPC_CastMonitoring`

# OgreBotAPI.Assist

## Members

### `InControl`

`${OgreBotAPI.Assist.InControl}`

Whether this character picks its own target instead of following someone else's. With the Auto Assist box off nobody drives this character, so it reads TRUE.

**Returns:** bool: TRUE when auto-target is on, the Auto Assist box is off, you are the assist anchor, or no assist rule names anyone to follow; FALSE when you follow another player, and FALSE when not in the world.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Assist.InControl}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.InControlOfAssisting`

### `IsAssisting`

`${OgreBotAPI.Assist.IsAssisting}`

The exact opposite of InControl: whether this character follows someone else's target. It reads FALSE whenever the Auto Assist box is off.

**Returns:** bool: TRUE when the Auto Assist box is on and you follow another player's target; FALSE when you pick your own target, and FALSE when not in the world.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Assist.IsAssisting}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `GetInfoOb.IsAssisting`, `OgreBotAPI.IsAssisting`

### `TargetID`

`${OgreBotAPI.Assist.TargetID}`

The assist decision as one number: who this character would take its target from right now. It is read fresh on each call and reports the decision even when the Auto Assist box is off or auto-target is on.

**Returns:** int64: greater than 0 is the ID to target (with Direct Assist Targeting on, the assisted player's target; otherwise the assisted player, which is your own ID when you are the anchor); 0 when you pick your own target; -1 when your current target should be left alone (Direct Assist Targeting on and the player you assist has no live target); NULL when not in the world.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Assist.TargetID}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.GetAssistID`

## Methods

### `Anchor`

`OgreBotAPI.Assist:Anchor[fw, who=me]`

Sets who this character takes its kill target from: a group or raid member's name or alias, an actor ID, blank for yourself, or off to clear it (the literal word me is looked up as a name and sets nothing). It does not target anything itself - the bot retargets on its pulse while Auto Assist is ticked, a name not in your group or raid sets nothing and says so in the console, and the anchor clears when you zone into a different zone.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `who` | string | `me` | The player to assist: a name, an alias, an actor ID, or off to clear the anchor; blank anchors on yourself |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Assist:Anchor[igw:${Me.Name},${Me.Name}]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:AssistForWho`, `OgreBotAPI:Assist`

# OgreBotAPI.AutoHunt

## Members

### `Active`

`${OgreBotAPI.AutoHunt.Active}`

TRUE when AutoHunt is switched on in Hunt mode. It reflects the mode only, so it stays TRUE while the hunt sits idle because OgreBot is closed or the bot is paused.

**Returns:** bool: TRUE when the mode is Hunt; FALSE when it is Off.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.AutoHunt.Active}
```

### `AllowMovement`

`${OgreBotAPI.AutoHunt.AllowMovement}`

TRUE when AutoHunt is letting this character move: a camp spot pulls again and the path picked on the Auto-Hunt tab walks on. It is FALSE while it holds position because a safety check tripped or a mob or an add is being dealt with, and TRUE while the character flies, since AutoHunt holds nothing in the air; it is updated on each hunt tick, and it reads FALSE after the mode is set to Off.

**Returns:** bool: TRUE when AutoHunt has released its hold on movement; FALSE when it is holding position or AutoHunt is Off.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.AutoHunt.AllowMovement}
```

### `FreezeReason`

`${OgreBotAPI.AutoHunt.FreezeReason}`

Which safety check stopped the hunt on its last tick, or None when it was safe or the character was flying (the checks are not read in the air). It is not cleared when the mode is set to Off, so it can still show the last reason after AutoHunt is turned off.

**Returns:** string: None, Aggro, Dead, LowHP, LowMana or ExquisiteChest. Only the first check that tripped is named, and a group or raid member who is not in the zone counts as Dead or LowHP when those checks are on.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.AutoHunt.FreezeReason}
```

### `LastAction`

`${OgreBotAPI.AutoHunt.LastAction}`

What AutoHunt decided to do on its last tick. It reads None after the mode is set to Off and keeps the last value while the hunt sits idle.

**Returns:** string: None, Walk, HoldPosition, MoveGroupToCamp, Prebuff, AcquireTarget, Pull or Cleanup. Walk means no mob is in reach, or the character is flying and AutoHunt pulls nothing in the air, so the character may walk on. None while the character is dead: AutoHunt holds as it stands.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.AutoHunt.LastAction}
```

### `Mode`

`${OgreBotAPI.AutoHunt.Mode}`

The AutoHunt mode this character is in: Off or Hunt. It starts as Off when the extension loads and is not saved, and it still reads Hunt while the hunt sits idle because OgreBot is closed or the bot is paused.

**Returns:** string: Off or Hunt.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.AutoHunt.Mode}
```

### `PullTargetID`

`${OgreBotAPI.AutoHunt.PullTargetID}`

The actor ID of the mob the last Hunt tick picked to pull, or 0 when none was found in the scan radius or the character is flying (no pull in the air); a different answer counts only after it has held for 0.3 seconds. It is 0 after the mode is set to Off, and an add already attacking the group is handled first but is not shown here.

**Returns:** int64: the actor ID picked to pull on the last tick; 0 when there was none.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.AutoHunt.PullTargetID}
```

### `SafetyTripped`

`${OgreBotAPI.AutoHunt.SafetyTripped}`

TRUE when one of the AutoHunt safety checks (aggro, dead, low health, low power, exquisite chest) stopped the hunt on its last tick. It keeps the last tick's value while the hunt sits idle and reads FALSE after the mode is set to Off.

**Returns:** bool: TRUE when a safety check that is ticked in the AutoHunt settings tripped on the last tick; FALSE when all were clear, the character was flying (the checks are not read in the air) or AutoHunt is Off.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.AutoHunt.SafetyTripped}
```

## Methods

### `SetCheckHP`

`OgreBotAPI.AutoHunt:SetCheckHP[fw, n]`

Sets the AutoHunt Check HP threshold in the loaded OgreBot profile: with Check HP ticked, the hunt holds position while any group or raid member (this character included) is below n percent health, and a member who is not in the zone counts too; it does not tick the checkbox, and 0 never trips. A missing value or no loaded profile prints a line and sets nothing, a value outside 0 to 100 or a word is stored clamped with a line saying so, and the change is kept only when the profile is saved.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `n` | int |  | Health percent; the hunt holds when a member is below it. 0 never trips; outside 0 to 100 it is clamped. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.AutoHunt:SetCheckHP[igw:${Me.Name},60]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:AutoHunt_CheckHP`

### `SetCheckMana`

`OgreBotAPI.AutoHunt:SetCheckMana[fw, n]`

Sets the AutoHunt Check Mana threshold in the loaded OgreBot profile: with Check Mana ticked, the hunt holds position while any group or raid member in the zone (this character included) is below n percent power; it does not tick the checkbox, and 0 never trips. A missing value or no loaded profile prints a line and sets nothing, a value outside 0 to 100 or a word is stored clamped with a line saying so, and the change is kept only when the profile is saved.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `n` | int |  | Power percent; the hunt holds when a member is below it. 0 never trips; outside 0 to 100 it is clamped. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.AutoHunt:SetCheckMana[igw:${Me.Name},30]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:AutoHunt_CheckMana`

### `SetMode`

`OgreBotAPI.AutoHunt:SetMode[fw, off|hunt]`

Sets the AutoHunt mode on each matching character: off stops it, ends its walk, releases its hold on the camp spot and lets go a group it holds at a camp, and hunt tells the rest of its group to follow it, then picks a mob in the scan radius (an add on the group first), targets it, uses the first ready ability or item from the AutoHunt pull list and walks the path picked on the Auto-Hunt tab between pulls. The mode is not saved, and an unknown word, or hunt while OgreBot is not open, sets Off and echoes why to the console.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `off\|hunt` | string |  | The mode, any case: off or hunt. Blank means off, and any other word, movement, on and grind included, sets Off. Hunt sends the follow once, as an OgreFollow through OgreConsole, so only characters on this PC get it; off leaves them following. With the Campspot or CS-JO-JI option a pull camps the whole group at this character's spot, a new pull from the same spot sends nothing, and the group is let go (a LetsGo, and this character's own camp cleared) once no mob has been in reach for 1.5 seconds, or at once when the bot is paused or the mode goes off. In the air it pulls, targets and holds nothing (a pull it was working ends, and one console line says so as it takes off), and while it is dead it holds everything as it is. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.AutoHunt:SetMode[${Me.Name},hunt]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:AutoHunt_SetMode`

### `SetScanRadius`

`OgreBotAPI.AutoHunt:SetScanRadius[fw, n]`

Sets the AutoHunt scan radius in the loaded OgreBot profile, the distance Hunt mode searches for a mob to pull; 0 means the longest reach among your enabled pull abilities (35 when none has a reach on file). A missing value or no loaded profile prints a line and sets nothing, a negative or a word is stored as 0 with a line saying so, and the change is kept only when the profile is saved.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `n` | int |  | Scan radius in game units; 0 uses the longest reach among your pull abilities. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.AutoHunt:SetScanRadius[igw:${Me.Name},50]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:AutoHunt_ScanRadius`

# OgreBotAPI.AutoTarget

## Members

### `Active`

`${OgreBotAPI.AutoTarget.Active}`

TRUE when the master checkbox is on, no Suppress reason is held, the working list has at least one entry, and the scanner may scan now: out of combat that needs Out Of Combat Scanning on or something hating you. It reads FALSE whenever nothing would be picked.

**Returns:** bool: TRUE when enabled, not suppressed, the list is not empty and the scanner may scan now; FALSE otherwise.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.AutoTarget.Active}
```

### `Count`

`${OgreBotAPI.AutoTarget.Count}`

The number of entries in the working list - the list auto-target picks from right now.

**Returns:** int: the number of entries; 0 when the list is empty.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.AutoTarget.Count}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `Ob_AutoTarget.Items`

### `Enabled`

`${OgreBotAPI.AutoTarget.Enabled}`

Reads the master auto-target checkbox from the profile. When it is off, auto-target never picks a target, whatever the list holds.

**Returns:** bool: TRUE when the auto-target checkbox is ticked; FALSE when it is unticked or was never set.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.AutoTarget.Enabled}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.AutoTarget_Enabled`

### `Entry`

`${OgreBotAPI.AutoTarget.Entry[n]}`

The working-list entry at position n, counting from 1, as JSON text with its fields: ActorName, MinHPToTarget, CheckCollision, AggroOnGroupOnly, MaxHPToTarget, AggroOnNonFighterOnly, AggroOnNotMe, and KeepLast when set.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|

**Returns:** string: the entry as a JSON object; "{}" when n is out of range.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.AutoTarget.Entry[1]}
```

### `HasActor`

`${OgreBotAPI.AutoTarget.HasActor[name]}`


### `ListName`

`${OgreBotAPI.AutoTarget.ListName}`

The name of the saved list or built-in list the working list is: set by LoadSaved, Save and LoadPreset. It is blank after Clear, and after any entry is added, changed or removed, since the list then matches no saved list.

**Returns:** string: the saved-list or built-in list name; "" when none.


### `OutOfCombatScanning`

`${OgreBotAPI.AutoTarget.OutOfCombatScanning}`

Reads the out-of-combat scanning checkbox. When it is off, auto-target only looks for a target while you are in combat or something hates you.

**Returns:** bool: TRUE when out-of-combat scanning is ticked; FALSE when it is unticked or was never set (unset counts as off).


### `ScanHeight`

`${OgreBotAPI.AutoTarget.ScanHeight}`

Reads the scan height setting as stored - the largest height difference an actor may have from you and still be picked (it must be less than this). An unset or 0 value reads 0 here, but auto-target then uses 5.

**Returns:** int: the stored scan height; 0 when unset.

```text

```

### `ScanRadius`

`${OgreBotAPI.AutoTarget.ScanRadius}`

**Returns:** int: the stored scan radius; 0 when unset.

```text

```

### `Suppressed`

`${OgreBotAPI.AutoTarget.Suppressed[key]}`

Asks whether auto-targeting is paused by Suppress. With no key it asks whether any reason is holding it; with a key it asks about that reason only (case does not matter).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|

**Returns:** bool: TRUE when the reason (or, with no key, any reason) is holding targeting paused; FALSE otherwise.


*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.AutoTarget_Disabled`

### `WhenHated`

`${OgreBotAPI.AutoTarget.WhenHated}`

Reads the auto-target-when-hated checkbox. When it is on and the character has nothing to fight, the bot about once a second targets an NPC within 30 that is attacking the group, and says so in the console.

**Returns:** bool: TRUE when the checkbox is ticked; FALSE when it is unticked or was never set.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.AutoTarget.WhenHated}
```

## Methods

### `AddActor`

`OgreBotAPI.AutoTarget:AddActor[fw, name, minHP=0, checkCollision=FALSE, aggroOnGroupOnly=TRUE, maxHP=0, aggroOnNonFighterOnly=FALSE, aggroOnNotMe=FALSE, keepLast=FALSE]`

Adds one entry to the working list (with no name it does nothing, and the same name can be added twice) and blanks ListName; auto-target tries entries top-down and takes the first entry that matches anything, keeping your current target if it matches. The working list lasts for this session only (it survives zoning) - use Save to keep it.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `name` | string |  | What to target: part of an actor name (matches any actor whose name contains it, case not mattering), NPC (any normal NPC), NamedNPC or Named (any named NPC), or a number for an actor ID. |
| `minHP` | int | `0` | Only pick the actor while its health is at least this percent; 0 = no limit. |
| `checkCollision` | bool | `FALSE` | TRUE to only pick actors you have a clear line to. |
| `aggroOnGroupOnly` | bool | `TRUE` | TRUE to only pick actors whose target is in your group. A word that is not yes/no keeps the default, TRUE. |
| `maxHP` | int | `0` | Only pick the actor while its health is below this percent; 0 = no limit. |
| `aggroOnNonFighterOnly` | bool | `FALSE` | TRUE to only pick actors targeting a player who is not a fighter. |
| `aggroOnNotMe` | bool | `FALSE` | TRUE to skip actors that are targeting you. |
| `keepLast` | bool | `FALSE` | TRUE to keep this entry at the bottom: later adds go in above it. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.AutoTarget:AddActor[igw:${Me.Name},"a gnoll guard",0,FALSE,TRUE]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:AutoTarget_AddActor`, `Ob_AutoTarget:AddActor`

### `Clear`

`OgreBotAPI.AutoTarget:Clear[fw]`

Empties the working list and blanks ListName. Saved lists on disk are not touched.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.AutoTarget:Clear[igw:${Me.Name}]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:AutoTarget_Clear`, `OgreBotAPI:AutoTarget_ClearActors`, `Ob_AutoTarget:Clear`

### `DeleteSaved`

`OgreBotAPI.AutoTarget:DeleteSaved[fw, name]`

Deletes a saved list from the current zone's file on disk; a blank name, or one that is not found, deletes nothing and says so on the console. The working list is not touched, but ListName is blanked when it named that list; it needs the character in the world.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `name` | string |  | The saved list to delete, matched whole, case not mattering. |

```text

```

*Was (OldBot):* `Ob_AutoTarget:DeleteList`

### `LoadPreset`

`OgreBotAPI.AutoTarget:LoadPreset[fw, name]`

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |

# OgreBotAPI.Bot

## Members

### `Paused`

`${OgreBotAPI.Bot.Paused}`

TRUE while the bot is paused, whether by Pause, the mini toolbar's pause button or a camp in progress. The bot starts out paused, so this is also TRUE before OgreBot has been loaded.

**Returns:** bool: TRUE when the bot is paused or has not been loaded yet; FALSE when it is running.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Bot.Paused}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.Paused`

### `ScriptBaseName`

`${OgreBotAPI.Bot.ScriptBaseName[path,removeExtension]}`

Returns the last part of a script path with its folders removed; back slashes count as forward slashes. A trailing .iss (any case) is removed unless removeExtension is FALSE.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string |  | The script path or file name. |
| `removeExtension` | bool | `TRUE` | TRUE strips a trailing .iss; FALSE keeps it. A word that is not a yes word reads as FALSE. |

**Returns:** string: the file name, without .iss unless removeExtension is FALSE; the whole text when it has no slash.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Bot.ScriptBaseName["${LavishScript.HomeDirectory}/Scripts/EQ2OgreBot/OgreBotDev.iss"]}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.Get_ScriptBaseName`

## Methods

### `CampToDesktop`

`OgreBotAPI.Bot:CampToDesktop[fw, loginOnly=FALSE]`

Queues a camp out: it stops following, pauses the bot for the camp and camps to the login screen, then closes the session unless loginOnly is TRUE. It refuses with a console line while you are in combat mode, and if the camp fails the bot's run state is put back.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `loginOnly` | bool | `FALSE` | TRUE stops at the login screen and keeps the session open; FALSE camps out and then closes the session. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Bot:CampToDesktop[${Me.Name},TRUE]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:CampToDesktop`

### `End`

`OgreBotAPI.Bot:End[fw]`

Closes OgreBot on the next frame, the same as typing ogre end bot. Closing also clears the no-offensive, no-defensive and threat ignore settings.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Bot:End[all]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:End_Bot`

### `EndScript`

`OgreBotAPI.Bot:EndScript[fw, script]`

Ends a running script on each selected character, matched by its file name with folders and .iss removed, and shows the name in OgreConsole. Does nothing when no script of that name is running, and needs the character in the world.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `script` | string |  | The script's name or path. Only the file name counts, with .iss removed. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Bot:EndScript[all,"MyScripts/hello"]
```

### `ExitClient`

`OgreBotAPI.Bot:ExitClient[fw, seconds=30]`

Queues an exit of this game client: a message box warns that the client closes in the given number of seconds, and clicking OK on it cancels. If the time runs out with the box still open, the session is closed with the character still in the world (no camp).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `seconds` | int | `30` | Seconds to wait before the exit. Anything that is not a whole number of at least 1 uses the default. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Bot:ExitClient[${Me.Name},60]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:ExitClient`

### `Load`

`OgreBotAPI.Bot:Load[fw]`

Starts OgreBot on the next frame, the same as typing ogre: it opens resumed with its main window hidden. Unlike Reload it also runs when OgreBot is not running, and on a running bot it reopens it the way Reload does.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

`OgreBotAPI.Bot:RunScript[fw, script, args...]`

Runs a script on each selected character, passing each later argument as its own quoted parameter, and shows the line in OgreConsole. It refuses with an OgreConsole line when the script is not found or a script of the same name is already running, and needs the character in the world.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |

### `SetUpFor`

`OgreBotAPI.Bot:SetUpFor[fw, what="", restart=TRUE]`

Sets up for an encounter on the next pulse: the fight of the named mob given in what, or with what blank the nearest or engaged named in this zone. Needs the character in the world; a name no encounter owns prints a warning to the console.

|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

| `restart` | bool | `TRUE` | TRUE re-runs a setup that is already running; FALSE only sets up an encounter that is not running yet. |

```text

```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:SetUpFor`

# OgreBotAPI.CampSpot

## Members

### `Active`

`${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.Active}`

The camp spot slot the leash is using now, 1 to 8. It starts at 1 and only SetActive or ResetAll change it.

**Returns:** int - the active slot number (1 to 8).

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.Active}
```

### `AnchorLoc`

`${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.AnchorLoc}`

The active slot's own spot as one "x,y,z" text without the relative layer, or "" when the active slot has no spot. Use it as the fixed reference when a relative layer may be in play; EffectiveLoc is where the character will actually go.

**Returns:** string - "x,y,z", or "" when there is no spot.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.AnchorLoc}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `Ogre_CampSpot.AbsoluteCampSpotLoc`, `Ogre_CampSpot.Get_AbsoluteCampSpot`

### `AnchorX`

`${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.AnchorX}`

The X coordinate of the active slot's own spot, without the relative layer. It reads 0 when the active slot has no spot.

**Returns:** float - the X coordinate, or 0 when there is no spot.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.AnchorX}
```

### `AnchorY`

`${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.AnchorY}`

The Y coordinate of the active slot's own spot, without the relative layer. It reads 0 when the active slot has no spot.

**Returns:** float - the Y coordinate, or 0 when there is no spot.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.AnchorY}
```

### `AnchorZ`

`${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.AnchorZ}`

The Z coordinate of the active slot's own spot, without the relative layer. It reads 0 when the active slot has no spot.

**Returns:** float - the Z coordinate, or 0 when there is no spot.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.AnchorZ}
```

### `AtCampSpot`

`${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.AtCampSpot}`

TRUE when this character is closer to the effective spot than HowClose, measured in 2D unless Use3D is on. It reads FALSE when the active slot has no spot, and it does not check the zone.

**Returns:** bool - TRUE if at the camp spot.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.AtCampSpot}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `Ogre_CampSpot.AtCampSpot`

### `DistanceTo`

`${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.DistanceTo}`

The distance from this character to the effective spot, measured the way the leash measures it: on the ground plane (X and Z) unless Use3D is on. It reads -1 when the active slot has no spot.

**Returns:** float - the distance, or -1 when there is no spot.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.DistanceTo}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `Ogre_CampSpot.DistanceFromCampSpot`

### `EffectiveLoc`

`${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.EffectiveLoc}`

Where the leash will take this character: the active slot's spot with the relative layer applied, as one "x,y,z" text with two decimals. It is "" when the active slot has no spot.

**Returns:** string - "x,y,z", or "" when there is no spot.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.EffectiveLoc}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `Ogre_CampSpot.Get_CampSpot`, `Ogre_CampSpot.Get_RelativeCampSpot`, `Ogre_CampSpot.RelativeCampSpotLoc`

### `EffectiveX`

`${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.EffectiveX}`

The X coordinate of the spot the leash will take this character to, with the relative layer applied. It reads 0 when the active slot has no spot, so check HasSpot first.

**Returns:** float - the X coordinate, or 0 when there is no spot.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.EffectiveX}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `Ogre_CampSpot.Get_X`

### `EffectiveY`

`${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.EffectiveY}`

The Y coordinate of the spot the leash will take this character to, with the relative layer applied. It reads 0 when the active slot has no spot, so check HasSpot first.

**Returns:** float - the Y coordinate, or 0 when there is no spot.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.EffectiveY}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `Ogre_CampSpot.Get_Y`

### `EffectiveZ`

`${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.EffectiveZ}`

The Z coordinate of the spot the leash will take this character to, with the relative layer applied. It reads 0 when the active slot has no spot, so check HasSpot first.

**Returns:** float - the Z coordinate, or 0 when there is no spot.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.EffectiveZ}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `Ogre_CampSpot.Get_Z`

### `Enabled`

`${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.Enabled}`

TRUE while the leash is turned on. It starts TRUE and only the Enable and Disable methods change it; the leash still needs a spot in the current zone to move anyone.

**Returns:** bool - TRUE if the leash is on.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.Enabled}
```

### `HasSpot`

`${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.HasSpot}`

TRUE when the active slot holds a camp spot. It does not check the zone or whether the leash is on.

**Returns:** bool - TRUE if the active slot has a spot.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.HasSpot}
```

### `HowClose`

`${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.HowClose}`

The arrival radius of the active slot: inside this distance the character counts as at the camp spot and the leash stops. A slot that was never set reads 1.

**Returns:** float - the arrival radius.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.HowClose}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `Ogre_CampSpot.Get_HowClose`, `Ogre_CampSpot.HowClose`

### `HowFar`

`${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.HowFar}`

The leash radius of the active slot: the leash walks the character back only from farther than HowClose and no farther than HowFar, and beyond HowFar it does not chase. A slot that was never set reads 125.

**Returns:** float - the leash radius.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.HowFar}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `Ogre_CampSpot.Get_HowFar`, `Ogre_CampSpot.HowFar`

### `Leashing`

`${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.Leashing}`

TRUE while the leash is walking this character back toward the camp spot right now. It goes FALSE once the character arrives, is paused, dead, zoning, or held by a movement block.

**Returns:** bool - TRUE while the leash is moving the character.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.Leashing}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `Ogre_CampSpot.ValidStayAtCampSpotOptions`

### `MaxSlots`

`${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.MaxSlots}`

The number of camp spot slots there are. It is always 8.

**Returns:** int - 8.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.MaxSlots}
```

### `OutsideLeash`

`${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.OutsideLeash}`

TRUE when this character is farther from the effective spot than HowFar, which is where the leash stops trying to walk back. FALSE when the active slot has no spot.

**Returns:** bool - TRUE if beyond the leash radius.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.OutsideLeash}
```

### `RelativeActive`

`${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.RelativeActive}`

TRUE when the relative layer changes where the character goes: the effective spot differs from the anchor, or the offset is not 0,0,0. UsingRelativeBy answers a different question (which mode the layer is in).

**Returns:** bool - TRUE if a relative layer is in effect.

```text

```

*Was (OldBot):* `Ogre_CampSpot.UsingRelative`

### `RelativeLoc`

`${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.RelativeLoc}`

The relative layer as one "x,y,z" text: the offset in offset mode, or the fixed destination after SetRelativeLoc. It reads "0.00,0.00,0.00" when the layer is clear.

**Returns:** string - "x,y,z".

```text

```


### `SlotCount`

`${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.SlotCount}`

How many of the 8 camp spot slots currently hold a spot. Slots that are not active still count.

**Returns:** int - the number of slots with a spot (0 to 8).

### `Use3D`

TRUE when the relative layer is an offset added to the spot (the default, and still TRUE with a 0,0,0 offset); FALSE after SetRelativeLoc, when it is a fixed destination instead. To ask whether the layer changes anything, read RelativeActive.

### `ValidOptions`

`${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.ValidOptions}`

TRUE when everything ValidOptionsCommon checks is true and this character is in the zone the active spot was set in. It does not look at Enabled or at how far away the character is, and reads the two options when asked, so a change made while the leash is paused counts at once.

**Returns:** bool - TRUE if the camp spot options are in force here.


### `ValidOptionsCommon`

`${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.ValidOptionsCommon}`

TRUE when the Allow Camp Spot and Dynamic Camp Spot options are both on, no movement block or leash hold is in, and the active slot has a spot. It does not check the zone (ValidOptions does), and reads the two options when asked, so a change made while the leash is paused counts at once.

**Returns:** bool - TRUE if the camp spot options allow the leash.

```text

```

*Was (OldBot):* `Ogre_CampSpot.ValidCampSpotOptionsCommon`

### `Zone`

`${OgreBotAPI.CampSpot.Zone}`

The short name of the zone the active slot's spot was set in; the leash only acts in that zone. It is "" when the slot was never set with SetHere, SetSlotHere or SetFormation, or after ClearAll.

**Returns:** string - the zone short name, or "".

```text

```

## Methods

### `ClearAll`

`OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:ClearAll[fw]`

Clears the spot and zone in all 8 slots and clears the relative layer, and also drops any hold on the leash (for example from a joust). Each slot keeps its radii and the active slot stays the same; ResetAll resets those too.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:ClearAll[igw:${Me.Name}]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:ClearAll`, `Ogre_CampSpot:ClearAll`

### `ClearCampSpot`

`OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:ClearCampSpot[fw]`

Clears the spot in the active slot, so the leash stops. The slot keeps its zone and radii, the relative layer is kept, and the other slots are not touched.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:ClearCampSpot[igw:${Me.Name}]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `Ogre_CampSpot:ClearCampSpot`

### `ClearRelative`

`OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:ClearRelative[fw]`

Clears the relative layer back to a 0,0,0 offset, so the leash goes to the active slot's own spot again. The spots are not touched, and it works even when OgreBot is closed.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:ClearRelative[igw:${Me.Name}]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:ClearRCS`, `Ogre_CampSpot:ClearRelative`

### `Disable`

### `Enable`

`OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:Enable[fw]`

### `NudgeBy`

Adds dx, dy and dz to the active slot's camp spot, keeping its zone and radii; a slot with no spot stays as it is, with one line. Nothing is set, with a line on the console, when OgreBot is not open (unless Movement:UseWithoutOgreBot is on).


### `Release`

`OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:Release[fw]`

Lets the character go: clears every camp spot (as ClearAll), stops a running jump route, clears the manual target overrides, the reasons that hold auto target, the reasons that stop offensive and defensive abilities, the no-offensive list, the threat ignore list, the no-bow flag and the HO icon lists, resumes a held follow, unlocks facing, turns Ignore Joust Commands off and stands a feigned toon. Named movement blocks set with Movement:Block stay in.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |


*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:LetsGo`, `LetsGo`

### `ResetAll`

Puts all 8 slots back to new: no spot, no zone, radii 1 and 125, 3D off; clears the relative layer and makes slot 1 active. It also drops any hold on the leash, as ClearAll does, and it does not change Enabled.

### `SetFormation`

`OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:SetFormation[fw, kind=circle, dist=7, x, y, z, useRelative=FALSE, middle="", circleSpots=0]`

Places each character on a ring of radius dist around x,y,z and makes that the active slot's camp spot in the current zone, so the leash walks it there: circle spaces by group order 60 degrees apart, monkey 72 degrees with the named middle character on the centre, and monkeyraid 360/circleSpots degrees (default 5) by raid order with the middle for-who on the centre. The centre is required: a missing x, y or z, or one that is not a number, prints a line and does nothing, as does an unknown kind or OgreBot not open.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `kind` | string | `circle` | circle, monkey or monkeyraid. |
| `dist` | float | `7` | Ring radius; 0 or less means 7. |
| `x` | float or name |  | X of the centre, or the whole centre as one word: the name of a point of interest in this zone, or x,y,z. An unknown name prints one line and does nothing. |
| `y` | float |  | Y of the centre. Not read when x holds the whole location. |
| `z` | float |  | Z of the centre. Not read when x holds the whole location. |
| `useRelative` | bool | `FALSE` | TRUE to also set the ring spot as the relative layer's fixed destination. |
| `middle` | string | `""` | Who stands on the centre: a character name for monkey, a for-who for monkeyraid, TRUE for this character; FALSE or blank for nobody. Ignored for circle. |
| `circleSpots` | int | `0` | Number of ring spots for monkeyraid; less than 1 means 5. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:SetFormation[igw:${Me.Name},circle,7,${Me.X},${Me.Y},${Me.Z},FALSE,"",0]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:Set_Formation_Circle`, `OgreBotAPI:Set_Formation_MonkeyInMiddle`, `OgreBotAPI:Set_Formation_MonkeyInMiddleRaid`

### `SetHere`

`OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:SetHere[fw, howClose=2, howFar=200]`

Sets the active slot's camp spot to where this character stands now, in the current zone, with the given arrival and leash radii (0 or less falls back to 1 and 125); the relative layer is kept. Nothing is set, with a line on the console, when OgreBot is not open (unless Movement:UseWithoutOgreBot is on) or when the Allow Camp Spot option is off.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `howClose` | float | `2` | Arrival radius: inside this distance the character counts as at the spot. |
| `howFar` | float | `200` | Leash radius: the leash walks back only from within this distance. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:SetHere[igw:${Me.Name},2,200]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:CampSpot`, `Ogre_CampSpot:Set_CS`, `Ogre_CampSpot:Set_CampSpot`

### `SetHowClose`

`OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:SetHowClose[fw, v=0]`

Sets the active slot's arrival radius: inside this distance the character counts as at the spot. 0 or less (and the default) sets 1, and it works without a spot.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `v` | float | `0` | The arrival radius; 0 or less means 1. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:SetHowClose[igw:${Me.Name},3]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `Ogre_CampSpot:Set_HowClose`

### `SetHowFar`

`OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:SetHowFar[fw, v=0]`

Sets the active slot's leash radius: the leash walks back only from within this distance. 0 or less (and the default) sets 125, and it works without a spot.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `v` | float | `0` | The leash radius; 0 or less means 125. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:SetHowFar[igw:${Me.Name},150]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `Ogre_CampSpot:Set_HowFar`

### `SetLoc`

`OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:SetLoc[fw, x|point, y, z]`

Moves the active slot's camp spot to x,y,z (three values, one "x,y,z" text, or the name of a point of interest in this zone), keeping its zone and radii; it does not start a camp on its own, so the leash only walks there if the slot was set with SetHere, SetSlotHere or SetFormation in this zone. A missing, NULL or non-number coordinate or an unknown name sets nothing and prints a warning, and nothing is set (with a console line) when OgreBot is not open, unless Movement:UseWithoutOgreBot is on.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `x\|point` | float or name |  | X coordinate of the new spot, or the whole spot as one word: "x,y,z" or the name of a point of interest in this zone. |
| `y` | float |  | Y coordinate of the new spot. Not read when x holds the whole location. |
| `z` | float |  | Z coordinate of the new spot. Not read when x holds the whole location. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:SetLoc[igw:${Me.Name},${Me.X},${Me.Y},${Me.Z}]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:CCS`, `OgreBotAPI:ChangeCampSpotWho`, `Ogre_CampSpot:Set_ChangeCampSpot`

### `SetLocAtAngleFromActor`

`OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:SetLocAtAngleFromActor[fw, angle, nameOrId, dist=3, skipIfAggro=FALSE, includeNpcSize=TRUE]`

Moves the active slot's camp spot to dist from the actor at angle degrees from the way it faces (0 is the SetLocBehindActor spot, 180 the SetLocInFrontOfActor spot), and with includeNpcSize TRUE the actor's size is added, so the same dist lands farther out than those two. Nothing happens when the actor is not found or is this character, and like SetLoc it moves the leash only if the slot was set with SetHere, SetSlotHere or SetFormation in this zone.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `angle` | float |  | Degrees from the actor's facing; 0 is behind, 180 is in front. |
| `nameOrId` | string |  | The actor: an ID, a name, an @role, pet:&lt;owner> or a class word. Blank uses this character's NPC target (its target, or its target's target). |
| `dist` | float | `3` | Distance from the actor; this character's own size is added. |
| `skipIfAggro` | bool | `FALSE` | TRUE to do nothing while the actor's threat on this character is at 100. |
| `includeNpcSize` | bool | `TRUE` | TRUE to add the actor's size to the distance as well. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:SetLocAtAngleFromActor[igw:${Me.Name},90,${Target.ID},3,FALSE,TRUE]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:SetCS_NPC_ForWho`, `OgreBotAPI:SetCS_NPC`

### `SetLocBehindActor`

`OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:SetLocBehindActor[fw, nameOrId, dist=3, skipIfAggro=FALSE]`

Moves the active slot's camp spot to dist behind the actor, from the way it faces now (a one-time spot, not a follow), and the character walks there; nothing happens when the actor is not found or is this character. Like SetLoc, it moves the leash only if the slot was set with SetHere, SetSlotHere or SetFormation in this zone.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `nameOrId` | string |  | The actor: an ID, a name, an @role, pet:&lt;owner> or a class word. Blank uses this character's NPC target (its target, or its target's target). |
| `dist` | float | `3` | Distance from the actor; this character's own size is added. |
| `skipIfAggro` | bool | `FALSE` | TRUE to do nothing while the actor's threat on this character is at 100. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:SetLocBehindActor[igw:${Me.Name},${Target.ID},3,FALSE]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:SetCS_BehindNPC`

### `SetLocByRole`

`OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:SetLocByRole[fw, nameOrId, dist=3, skipIfAggro=FALSE]`

Each character picks its own side - fighters take the spot in front of the actor and everyone else the spot behind it, as SetLocInFrontOfActor and SetLocBehindActor do; nothing happens when the actor is not found or is this character. Like SetLoc, it moves the leash only if the slot was set with SetHere, SetSlotHere or SetFormation in this zone.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

| `dist` | float | `3` | Distance from the actor; this character's own size is added. |
| `skipIfAggro` | bool | `FALSE` | TRUE to do nothing while the actor's threat on this character is at 100. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:SetLocByRole[igw:${Me.Name},${Target.ID},3,FALSE]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:SetCS_PositionNPC`

### `SetLocInFrontOfActor`

`OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:SetLocInFrontOfActor[fw, nameOrId, dist=3, skipIfAggro=FALSE]`

Moves the active slot's camp spot to dist in front of the actor, from the way it faces now (a one-time spot, not a follow), and the character walks there; nothing happens when the actor is not found or is this character. ```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:SetCS_InFrontNPC`

### `SetRelativeBy`

`OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:SetRelativeBy[fw, dx=0, dy=0, dz=0]`

Adds dx, dy and dz to the relative offset (it does not replace it) and puts the layer in offset mode, so the leash goes to the active slot's spot plus the offset; after SetRelativeLoc the spot stays where it is and moves by exactly that amount. Nothing is set, with a line on the console, when OgreBot is not open (unless Movement:UseWithoutOgreBot is on).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `dx` | float | `0` | Amount added to the X offset. |
| `dy` | float | `0` | Amount added to the Y offset. |
| `dz` | float | `0` | Amount added to the Z offset. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:SetRelativeBy[igw:${Me.Name},0,0,5]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:CS_Set_ChangeRelativeCampSpotBy`, `Ogre_CampSpot:Set_ChangeRelativeCampSpotBy`

### `SetRelativeLoc`

`OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:SetRelativeLoc[fw, x, y, z]`

Makes x,y,z the fixed destination of the relative layer, so the leash takes this character there instead of the slot's spot (which is kept, and ClearRelative goes back to it); x, y and z are all required, and a missing, NULL or non-number value gets one line and sets nothing. Nothing is set, with a line on the console, when OgreBot is not open (unless Movement:UseWithoutOgreBot is on).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `x` | float |  | X of the destination. |
| `y` | float |  | Y of the destination. |
| `z` | float |  | Z of the destination. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:SetRelativeLoc[igw:${Me.Name},${Target.X},${Target.Y},${Target.Z}]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:CRCS`, `OgreBotAPI:Set_Relative`, `Ogre_CampSpot:Set_Relative`

### `SetSlotHere`

`OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:SetSlotHere[fw, n=1, howClose=2, howFar=200]`

Sets slot n (1 to 8; anything else does nothing) to where this character stands now, in the current zone, without changing the active slot, so the leash uses it once SetActive picks that slot. Nothing is set, with a line on the console, when OgreBot is not open (unless Movement:UseWithoutOgreBot is on) or the Allow Camp Spot option is off.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `n` | int | `1` | The slot to set, 1 to 8. |
| `howClose` | float | `2` | Arrival radius for that slot (0 or less falls back to 1). |
| `howFar` | float | `200` | Leash radius for that slot (0 or less falls back to 125). |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:SetSlotHere[${Me.Name},2,2,200]
```

### `SetUse3D`

`OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:SetUse3D[fw, on=TRUE]`

Turns 3D distance on or off for the active slot; off measures on the ground plane only (X and Z). Left out means on, and a word that is not yes or no leaves it as it is.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `on` | bool | `TRUE` | TRUE for 3D distances, FALSE for ground-plane distances. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CampSpot:SetUse3D[igw:${Me.Name},TRUE]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `Ogre_CampSpot:Set_Use3D`
