# OgreBotAPI.CastStack

## Members

### `TagAllowRemaining`

`${OgreBotAPI.CastStack.TagAllowRemaining[tag]}`

Seconds left on an allow tag's clock on this session, as a decimal number; 0 when the tag is not held or has run out, and a tag tied to a maintained buff reads the time left on its limit. Tag names are case-insensitive, and reading changes nothing.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tag` | string |  | The allow tag name, case-insensitive. Blank returns 0. |

**Returns:** float: seconds left before the allow tag ends; 0 when it is absent, expired or blank. A tag tied to a maintained buff reads the time left on its limit, and 0 when it has none (such a tag can still be active).

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.CastStack.TagAllowRemaining[Burn]}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.AbilityTag_GetTagAllowTimeRemaining`

### `TagEmbargoRemaining`

`${OgreBotAPI.CastStack.TagEmbargoRemaining[tag]}`

Seconds left on an embargo tag's clock on this session, as a decimal number; 0 when the tag is not held or has run out, and a tag tied to a maintained buff reads the time left on its limit. Tag names are case-insensitive, and reading changes nothing.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tag` | string |  | The embargo tag name, case-insensitive. Blank returns 0. |

**Returns:** float: seconds left before the embargo tag ends; 0 when it is absent, expired or blank. A tag tied to a maintained buff reads the time left on its limit, and 0 when it has none (such a tag can still be active).

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.CastStack.TagEmbargoRemaining[Stuns]}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.AbilityTag_GetTagEmbargoTimeRemaining`

## Methods

### `AddEntry`

`OgreBotAPI.CastStack:AddEntry[fw, name, where, options...]`

Adds a row to the cast stack at the place you name, with any of its options. It takes effect at once, and is kept in the profile only when you Save.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `name` | text |  | The ability's name (or id), or Item:&lt;item name> for an item row. |
| `where` | text |  | top, bottom, or the row number the new row gets (1 to one past the last row). |
| `options...` | key, value pairs |  | Key, value pairs, as many as you like: Type, Target, Named, NamedOrEpic, RD, Tag, ETag, ATag, EType, AType, ID, DT, MAX, IE, IAE, RIE, Conc, UseSolo, UseGroup, UseRaid, disabled, RW&lt;, HP&lt;, HP>, MP&lt;, MP>, N_HP&lt;, N_HP>, Aggro&lt;, Aggro>, Fervor&lt;, Fervor>, D&lt;, D>, Sav, Sav&lt;, % and #, the same options the Cast Stack window sets; all of them go on or none do, and a refusal prints why. A yes/no option takes TRUE or FALSE (FALSE unticks it). A number option takes a number, and having it at all is the condition. Type is one of the Cast Stack's types (Buff, CA, Heal ...); EType and AType are Both, Trigger Only or Listen Only. Type must be one of them. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CastStack:AddEntry[${Me.Name},"Item:Eye of the Siren",bottom,Type,Buff,Target,Mailmanx]
```

### `ClearAllAllows`

`OgreBotAPI.CastStack:ClearAllAllows[fw]`

Removes every allow tag, including ones set by cast stack entries, on this session, at once and with or without the console hub, then on every session on this PC in this session's relay group whose for-who matches, sent through the hub and applied on each session's next pulse. Only a session that is itself in the for-who sends it, and nothing is saved.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CastStack:ClearAllAllows[igw:${Me.Name}]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:AbilityTag_ResetAllAbilityTagAllows`

### `ClearAllEmbargos`

`OgreBotAPI.CastStack:ClearAllEmbargos[fw]`

Removes every embargo tag, including ones set by cast stack entries, on this session, at once and with or without the console hub, then on every session on this PC in this session's relay group whose for-who matches, sent through the hub and applied on each session's next pulse. Only a session that is itself in the for-who sends it, and nothing is saved.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CastStack:ClearAllEmbargos[igw:${Me.Name}]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:AbilityTag_ResetAllAbilityTagEmbargos`

### `ClearAllow`

`OgreBotAPI.CastStack:ClearAllow[fw, tag]`

Removes one allow tag on this session, at once and with or without the console hub, then on every session on this PC in this session's relay group whose for-who matches, sent through the hub and applied on each session's next pulse. Only a session that is itself in the for-who sends it, a blank tag gets one line, and nothing is saved.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `tag` | string |  | The allow tag to remove, case-insensitive. A blank gets one line - use ClearAllAllows to remove them all. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CastStack:ClearAllow[igw:${Me.Name},Burn]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:AbilityTag_ResetAbilityTagAllow`

### `ClearEmbargo`

`OgreBotAPI.CastStack:ClearEmbargo[fw, tag]`

Removes one embargo tag on this session, at once and with or without the console hub, then on every session on this PC in this session's relay group whose for-who matches, sent through the hub and applied on each session's next pulse. Only a session that is itself in the for-who sends it, a blank tag gets one line, and nothing is saved.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `tag` | string |  | The embargo tag to remove, case-insensitive. A blank gets one line - use ClearAllEmbargos to remove them all. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CastStack:ClearEmbargo[igw:${Me.Name},Stuns]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:AbilityTag_ResetAbilityTagEmbargo`

### `ClearEntryOption`

`OgreBotAPI.CastStack:ClearEntryOption[fw, row, keys...]`

Removes options from a cast stack row, as blanking a field or unticking a box in the window does. It takes effect at once, and is kept in the profile only when you Save.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `row` | number or text |  | The row: its number as the Cast Stack shows it (1 is the top row), or its name when exactly one row has that name (case-insensitive). An item row's name is Item:&lt;item name>. |
| `keys...` | option names |  | The options to remove, by the same names SetEntryOption takes. One the row does not have is fine; an unknown name removes nothing and prints why. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CastStack:ClearEntryOption[${Me.Name},"Battle Tactics",HP<,RD]
```

### `ClearItemCache`

`OgreBotAPI.CastStack:ClearItemCache[fw]`

Empties the shared item effect file on disk at once, for every character on this PC, and prints a line to the console. This session then re-examines its item entries from the next pulse, including ones that failed earlier.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CastStack:ClearItemCache[${Me.Name}]
```

### `Dump`

`OgreBotAPI.CastStack:Dump[fw]`

On the next pulse, checks every cast stack entry against the current game state, prints one line per entry with its verdict to the console, and sends the same list to the OgreBot window. It casts nothing and changes nothing.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CastStack:Dump[${Me.Name}]
```

### `ExamineItems`

`OgreBotAPI.CastStack:ExamineItems[fw]`

From the next pulse, examines the cast stack's item entries that are not in the shared item effect file yet, and rebuilds the list of adornments on your equipped gear. What it learns is written to the shared item effect file, which every character on this PC reads.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CastStack:ExamineItems[${Me.Name}]
```

### `HoldTag`

`OgreBotAPI.CastStack:HoldTag[fw, tag, duration, type, -m]`

Sets an embargo or allow tag for some seconds on this session, at once and with or without the console hub, then sends it through the hub to every session on this PC in this session's relay group whose for-who matches, applied on each session's next pulse, for that session only. Only a session that is itself in the for-who sends it, so run it on every session (oc !c) or from one inside the for-who, and the tag only blocks or allows entries while Enable Tag Embargo or Enable Tag Allow is ticked.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `tag` | string |  | The tag name, case-insensitive. A blank gets one line. |
| `duration` | int |  | How long the tag lasts, in seconds. 0, blank or not a number ends it at once. A new hold never shortens a tag that is already running longer. |
| `type` | string |  | Allow sets an allow tag. Any other word, blank included, sets an embargo tag. |
| `-m` | switch |  | Optional: -m followed by a maintained buff name or ability id ties this session's hold to its own buff: the hold ends when the buff drops, or at the duration if that comes first, after a grace of the cast time plus 1 second (5 seconds for an item). Other sessions hold plain until this one tells them to let go. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CastStack:HoldTag[igw:${Me.Name},Stuns,13,Embargo]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:AbilityTag_AddRotateTagTimer`

### `Import`

`OgreBotAPI.CastStack:Import[fw, path, profile=""]`

Replaces this session's cast stack with the cast stack from an OgreBot EQ2Save XML file, and prints the entry count and any notes, or why it failed, to the console. It takes effect at once and lasts only until the profile is next opened, reloaded or edited.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `path` | string |  | Full path of the EQ2Save XML file. A relative path is read from the game's working folder, not from Scripts. |
| `profile` | string | `""` | The profile inside the file whose cast stack to take. Blank takes the first profile that has a cast stack. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CastStack:Import[${Me.Name},"${LavishScript.HomeDirectory}/Scripts/MyCastStack.xml",Raid]
```

### `Load`

`OgreBotAPI.CastStack:Load[fw, path]`

Replaces this session's cast stack with the entries in a JSON cast stack file, and prints the entry count, or why it failed, to the console. It takes effect at once and lasts only until the profile is next opened, reloaded or edited - the profile and the OgreBot window are not changed.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `path` | string |  | Full path of the JSON file, which must hold an "entries" array. A relative path is read from the game's working folder, not from Scripts. An ability entry may give its name alone: names are looked up in this toon's ability export, as a profile load does. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CastStack:Load[${Me.Name},"${LavishScript.HomeDirectory}/Scripts/MyCastStack.json"]
```

### `LoadFromProfile`

`OgreBotAPI.CastStack:LoadFromProfile[fw]`

Reloads this session's cast stack from the OgreBot profile already open, including edits not saved yet, matches each ability name to your ability export, and re-examines item entries from the next pulse. Nothing is read from disk or saved, and with no profile open the stack is left empty.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CastStack:LoadFromProfile[${Me.Name}]
```

### `MoveEntry`

`OgreBotAPI.CastStack:MoveEntry[fw, row, to]`

Moves a cast stack row up or down one place, to the top or bottom, or to a row number. It takes effect at once, and is kept in the profile only when you Save.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `row` | number or text |  | The row: its number as the Cast Stack shows it (1 is the top row), or its name when exactly one row has that name (case-insensitive). An item row's name is Item:&lt;item name>. |
| `to` | text |  | up, down, top, bottom, or the row number it moves to. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CastStack:MoveEntry[${Me.Name},"Item:Eye of the Siren",top]
```

### `ReloadRangeExtenders`

`OgreBotAPI.CastStack:ReloadRangeExtenders[fw]`

Re-reads the per-zone range extender file, Ogre/EQ2/Encounters/RangeExtenders.json (it comes with the bot), at once and prints how many zones and entries it loaded, or a warning. The file lists, per zone, detrimental effects that change your ability range; nothing is saved.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CastStack:ReloadRangeExtenders[${Me.Name}]
```

### `RemoveEntry`

`OgreBotAPI.CastStack:RemoveEntry[fw, row]`

Removes a row from the cast stack. It takes effect at once, and is kept in the profile only when you Save.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |

| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `row` | number or text |  | The row: its number as the Cast Stack shows it (1 is the top row), or its name when exactly one row has that name (case-insensitive). An item row's name is Item:&lt;item name>. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CastStack:RemoveEntry[${Me.Name},5]
```

### `SetEntry`

`OgreBotAPI.CastStack:SetEntry[fw, ability, TRUE|FALSE|toggle, silent=FALSE]`

Enables, disables or flips the cast stack entries that match the name, and prints a line to OgreConsole for each entry that actually changed unless silent is TRUE. It takes effect at once in the rotation and the OgreBot window, and is kept in the profile only when you Save.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `ability` | string |  | The entry: its whole name (case-insensitive), an ability id (finds the entry that holds that ability), or one of IsStun, IsInterrupt, IsDaze, IsFear, IsStifle or Ascension to match every entry of that kind. Blank does nothing. |
| `TRUE\|FALSE\|toggle` | string |  | TRUE enables (1, yes and on count as TRUE too). toggle, or blank, flips each matching entry. Any other word disables. |
| `silent` | bool | `FALSE` | TRUE skips the OgreConsole lines. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CastStack:SetEntry[igw:${Me.Name},Assault,FALSE]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:ChangeCastStackListBoxItem`, `ChangeCastStackListBoxItem`

### `SetEntryByTag`

`OgreBotAPI.CastStack:SetEntryByTag[fw, tag, TRUE|FALSE|toggle, partial=FALSE, silent=FALSE]`

Enables, disables or flips the cast stack entries whose tag matches, and prints a line to OgreConsole for each entry that actually changed unless silent is TRUE. It takes effect at once in the rotation and the OgreBot window, and is kept in the profile only when you Save.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `tag` | string |  | The entry tag to match, case-insensitive. This is the entry's own tag, not an embargo or allow tag. Blank does nothing. |
| `TRUE\|FALSE\|toggle` | string |  | TRUE enables (1, yes and on count as TRUE too). toggle, or blank, flips each matching entry. Any other word disables. |
| `partial` | bool | `FALSE` | TRUE matches every entry whose tag contains the word; FALSE needs the whole tag. |
| `silent` | bool | `FALSE` | TRUE skips the OgreConsole lines. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CastStack:SetEntryByTag[igw:${Me.Name},AE,toggle,TRUE]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:ChangeCastStackListBoxItemByTag`, `ChangeCastStackListBoxItemByTag`

### `SetEntryOption`

`OgreBotAPI.CastStack:SetEntryOption[fw, row, options...]`

Sets one or more options on a cast stack row. It takes effect at once, and is kept in the profile only when you Save.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `row` | number or text |  | The row: its number as the Cast Stack shows it (1 is the top row), or its name when exactly one row has that name (case-insensitive). An item row's name is Item:&lt;item name>. |
| `options...` | key, value pairs |  | Key, value pairs, as many as you like: Type, Target, Named, NamedOrEpic, RD, Tag, ETag, ATag, EType, AType, ID, DT, MAX, IE, IAE, RIE, Conc, UseSolo, UseGroup, UseRaid, disabled, RW&lt;, HP&lt;, HP>, MP&lt;, MP>, N_HP&lt;, N_HP>, Aggro&lt;, Aggro>, Fervor&lt;, Fervor>, D&lt;, D>, Sav, Sav&lt;, % and #, the same options the Cast Stack window sets; all of them go on or none do, and a refusal prints why. A yes/no option takes TRUE or FALSE (FALSE unticks it). A number option takes a number, and having it at all is the condition. Type is one of the Cast Stack's types (Buff, CA, Heal ...); EType and AType are Both, Trigger Only or Listen Only. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CastStack:SetEntryOption[${Me.Name},3,HP<,50,Named,TRUE]
```

### `TestCast`

`OgreBotAPI.CastStack:TestCast[fw, ability=""]`

Arms one real cast for the next pulse and then stops: the given ability, or with no ability the first entry the cast stack would cast right now; a name this toon's export does not know gets one line and arms nothing. It fires even while the bot is paused, but needs OgreBot loaded and is ignored while a cast is already in flight.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `ability` | string | `""` | The ability to cast: a name (short or any rank) or an ability id. It is cast with no target, and skipped with a console line if it is not ready. Blank casts the first eligible cast stack entry instead; a name that cannot be found gets one line and casts nothing. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CastStack:TestCast[${Me.Name},Assault]
```

### `Tick`

`OgreBotAPI.CastStack:Tick[fw]`

Runs one evaluation of the cast stack straight away and casts nothing, even while the bot is paused. It prints only when the Debug tab's cast stack eval or casting boxes are ticked, and it changes and saves nothing.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.CastStack:Tick[${Me.Name}]
```

# OgreBotAPI.Client

## Methods

### `ResetCamera`

`OgreBotAPI.Client:ResetCamera[fw]`

Recentres the camera: in first person it uses the game's camera recentre, otherwise it sets the camera pitch to 0 the way Client:SetCameraPitch does. While a camera pitch from Client:SetCameraPitch is still running, the pitch is not changed and one line says so.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Client:ResetCamera[${Me.Name}]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:ResetCameraAngle`, `call Obj_OgreUtilities.ResetCameraAngle`

### `SetCameraPitch`

`OgreBotAPI.Client:SetCameraPitch[fw, pitch=0, endInFirstPerson=FALSE]`

Queued: switches to third person if needed, sets the camera pitch, and goes back to first person when endInFirstPerson is TRUE. A pitch outside -75 to 75, or a call while one is still running, prints a console line and is dropped.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `pitch` | int | `0` | Camera pitch from -75 to 75; 0 is level |
| `endInFirstPerson` | bool | `FALSE` | TRUE to switch to first person after setting the pitch |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Client:SetCameraPitch[${Me.Name},-20,FALSE]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:Set_CameraPitch`, `call Obj_OgreUtilities.Set_LookDown`, `call Obj_OgreUtilities.Set_LookUp`

### `SetMousePosition`

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:SetMousePosition`

# OgreBotAPI.Combat

## Members

### `InCombat`

`${OgreBotAPI.Combat.InCombat}`

TRUE when your character is in combat or something hates it; for your whole group, use ${OgreBotAPI.Roster.InCombat}. Always FALSE while you are not in the world, such as at character select.

**Returns:** bool: TRUE when Me.InCombat or Me.IsHated is TRUE; FALSE otherwise or out of the world.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Combat.InCombat}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.InCombat`

### `IsReady`

`${OgreBotAPI.Combat.IsReady}`

TRUE when OgreBot is up: its main window or mini toolbar is open and a profile is loaded (the same check as ${ISXOgreEQ2.OgreBot.IsReady}); FALSE after it is closed.

**Returns:** bool: TRUE when OgreBot is open and ready; FALSE otherwise.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Combat.IsReady}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.IsReady`

### `NoDefensive`

`${OgreBotAPI.Combat.NoDefensive}`

TRUE while any no-defensive reason is held (SetNoDefensive). While it is TRUE the bot skips defensive abilities.

**Returns:** bool: TRUE when at least one no-defensive reason is held; FALSE when none is.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Combat.NoDefensive}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.CheckNoDefensiveOn`

### `NoOffensive`

`${OgreBotAPI.Combat.NoOffensive}`

TRUE while offensive actions are held off: a no-offensive reason is set (SetNoOffensive), or your current NPC target matches the no-offensive list (AddNoOffensive). While it is TRUE the bot skips offensive abilities and, while running, turns auto-attack off.

**Returns:** bool: TRUE when a no-offensive reason is held or the current NPC target is on the no-offensive list; FALSE otherwise.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Combat.NoOffensive}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.CheckNoOffensiveOn`, `OgreBotAPI.NoOffensiveOn`

### `NoReqBowAbilities`

`${OgreBotAPI.Combat.NoReqBowAbilities}`

Returns the flag SetNoReqBowAbilities sets, FALSE until something sets it. While it is TRUE the cast stack skips abilities that need a bow.

**Returns:** bool: TRUE when SetNoReqBowAbilities turned the flag on; FALSE otherwise.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Combat.NoReqBowAbilities}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.CheckNoReqBowAbilities`, `OgreBotAPI.bNoReqBowAbilities`

### `Zoning`

`${OgreBotAPI.Combat.Zoning}`

TRUE while a zone change is in progress, including the short wait after arriving before the character is settled. FALSE once you are in a zone and settled.

**Returns:** bool: TRUE while zoning or not yet settled after a zone; FALSE otherwise.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Combat.Zoning}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.Zoning`

## Methods

### `AddNoOffensive`

`OgreBotAPI.Combat:AddNoOffensive[fw, mobName, exactOnly=TRUE]`

Adds a mob name to the no-offensive list: while your current NPC target matches an entry, NoOffensive is TRUE and the bot holds off offensive abilities and auto-attack. Matching ignores case, adding a name already listed replaces its exactOnly setting, and the list is kept until ClearNoOffensive, LetsGo or the bot closing.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `mobName` | string |  | The mob name to add. A blank name is ignored. |
| `exactOnly` | bool | `TRUE` | TRUE matches the whole name only; FALSE matches any target whose name contains mobName. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Combat:AddNoOffensive[all,"a shield of Yothshaval",TRUE]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:AddNoOffensiveOn`

### `ClearNoOffensive`

`OgreBotAPI.Combat:ClearNoOffensive[fw]`

Empties the no-offensive list built by AddNoOffensive. Reasons set with SetNoOffensive are not touched.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Combat:ClearNoOffensive[all]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:ClearNoOffensiveOn`

### `Countdown`

`OgreBotAPI.Combat:Countdown[fw, seconds=10]`

When this character is grouped and is the group leader, runs the game's countdown for the given seconds; on anyone else it does nothing. A number below 1 counts down from 1 and one over 30 from 30, with a console line saying so.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `seconds` | int | `10` | Seconds to count down, 1 to 30. A word that is not a number reads as 0, so it counts down from 1. The -countdown console row passes 1 when its time is left blank. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Combat:Countdown[igw:${Me.Name},5]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:Countdown`

### `RemoveNoOffensive`

`OgreBotAPI.Combat:RemoveNoOffensive[fw,mobName]`

Takes a mob name off the no-offensive list that Combat:AddNoOffensive adds to; the name is matched ignoring case. A name not on the list changes nothing.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `mobName` | string |  | The mob name to take off the list. A blank name is ignored. |


*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:RemoveNoOffensiveOn`

### `SetNoDefensive`

`OgreBotAPI.Combat:SetNoDefensive[fw, on=TRUE, reason=""]`

Turns no-defensive on or off by reason: on adds the reason (manual when blank), off with a reason removes just that one, and off with no reason clears them all. While any reason is held the bot skips defensive abilities; LetsGo and reopening the bot clear every reason.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `on` | bool | `TRUE` | TRUE adds the reason; FALSE removes it, or every reason when reason is blank. A word that is not yes or no changes nothing. |
| `reason` | string | `""` | A name for why it is on, so several callers can hold it at once. Blank means manual when adding and every reason when removing. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Combat:SetNoDefensive[igw:${Me.Name},FALSE,"tank swap"]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:SetNoDefensive`

### `SetNoOffensive`

# OgreBotAPI.Comms

## Members

### `Dispatched`

`${OgreBotAPI.Comms.Dispatched}`

How many received events at least one of the bot's own handlers acted on. Events no handler wants, and events dropped by for-who, are not counted.

**Returns:** int64: events handled

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Comms.Dispatched}
```

### `Errors`

`${OgreBotAPI.Comms.Errors}`

How many received events were thrown away as unreadable: bad base64, bad JSON, not an event, a newer envelope version, no name, or a name unfit for a script event. For-who drops and a full inbox are not counted here.

**Returns:** int64: unreadable events

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Comms.Errors}
```

### `GroupQuery`

`${OgreBotAPI.Comms.GroupQuery[fw,question...]}`

With arguments, starts a groupQuery on this session and returns it - every read of this form asks again; with no arguments it is the handle whose .Last, .Done[id] and .Result[id] read queries. Answers come over this PC's relay group only, so group or raid members on other PCs show as missing, and a bad question prints a groupQuery error.

All of it: [OgreBotAPI.Comms.GroupQuery](Comms.GroupQuery.md)

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `question...` | string |  | one JSON object, or -key,value pairs: -question (itemCount, abilityReady, slotResolve or LavishScript["${...}"]), -item, -ability or -slot, -compare with -value, -sendTo (default igw:&lt;me>), -limitMs (default 3000), -askAgainIfBlank |

**Returns:** groupquery object: its text is the new query id (read .Done and .Result on it); NULL when the for-who does not name this character or the question is refused. With no arguments: the handle with .Last, .Done[id], .Result[id]

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Comms.GroupQuery[all,-question,itemCount,-item,"Mechanized Platinum Repository of Reconstruction"]}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.Ask`, `OgreBotAPI.Ask_AllFalse`, `OgreBotAPI.Ask_AllTrue`

### `Query_Active`

`${OgreBotAPI.Comms.Query_Active[id]}`

TRUE while a query is still collecting replies, before its timeout. An empty id reads the last query (Query_Last); an unknown or cleared id reads FALSE.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string |  | the query id from Query_Last; empty = the last query |

**Returns:** bool: TRUE while the query is collecting replies; FALSE once it is done, or for an unknown id

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Comms.Query_Active[${OgreBotAPI.Comms.Query_Last}]}
```

### `Query_Count`

`${OgreBotAPI.Comms.Query_Count[id]}`

How many characters have replied to a query; an unknown id reads 0. Only in-world sessions on this PC answer, and this session answers its own question.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string |  | the query id from Query_Last; empty = the last query |

**Returns:** int: replies so far (final once Query_Done); 0 for an unknown id

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Comms.Query_Count[${OgreBotAPI.Comms.Query_Last}]}
```

### `Query_Done`

`${OgreBotAPI.Comms.Query_Done[id]}`

TRUE once a query's timeout has passed and its tally is final. The tally stays readable for 60 seconds after that, then the query is forgotten and this reads FALSE again.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string |  | the query id from Query_Last; empty = the last query |

**Returns:** bool: TRUE when the query has finished; FALSE while it runs, after it is forgotten, or for an unknown id

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Comms.Query_Done[${OgreBotAPI.Comms.Query_Last}]}
```

### `Query_Json`

`${OgreBotAPI.Comms.Query_Json[id]}`

Every reply to a query as one JSON object of responder name to raw answer: the item count, seconds until the ability is ready, the equipped item name, or the expression's text. An empty id reads the last query.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string |  | the query id from Query_Last; empty = the last query |

**Returns:** string: JSON such as {"Name1":"5","Name2":"0"}; {} when nobody replied or the id is unknown

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Comms.Query_Json[${OgreBotAPI.Comms.Query_Last}]}
```

### `Query_Last`

`${OgreBotAPI.Comms.Query_Last}`

The id of the last query this session started with Comms:Query; the bot's own group, loot and quest questions do not change it, and a refused :Query leaves the previous id in place.

**Returns:** string: the query id; empty before any query started

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Comms.Query_Last}
```

### `Query_TrueCount`

`${OgreBotAPI.Comms.Query_TrueCount[id]}`

How many replies to a query answered TRUE: has the item, ability ready, slot filled, or the expression read true. An empty id reads the last query; an unknown id reads 0.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string |  | the query id from Query_Last; empty = the last query |

**Returns:** int: TRUE replies so far; 0 for an unknown id

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Comms.Query_TrueCount[${OgreBotAPI.Comms.Query_Last}]}
```

### `Queued`

`${OgreBotAPI.Comms.Queued}`

How many received events are waiting to be handled right now. They are handled on the next pulse, so this is normally 0.

**Returns:** int64: events waiting

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Comms.Queued}
```

### `Received`

`${OgreBotAPI.Comms.Received}`

How many events this session has received from its relay group since it loaded or since the last ResetStats, counting its own events and events its for-who then dropped. It stays 0 when the uplink's OgreConsoleHub is not loaded, because then nothing comes back.

**Returns:** int64: events received

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Comms.Received}
```

### `Stats`

`${OgreBotAPI.Comms.Stats}`

This session's comms counters as one line: received, queued, handled, dropped by for-who, sent, and errors by kind. It is a local read that sends nothing, and echo ${OgreBotAPI.Comms} prints the same line.

**Returns:** string: the counter line, e.g. recv=12 q=0 proc=12 disp=10 nosub=2 refired=12 cfwdrop=0 emit=5 err[b64=0 json=0 type=0 ver=0 name=0 refname=0] of=0 tid[recv=... pulse=...]

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Comms.Stats}
```

### `UplinkName`

`${OgreBotAPI.Comms.UplinkName}`

Inner Space's uplink name for this PC, read from ${InnerSpace.Uplink}. A local read; every session on the PC reads the same text.

**Returns:** string: the value of ${InnerSpace.Uplink}

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Comms.UplinkName}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `GetInfoOb.UplinkName`, `OgreBotAPI.UplinkName`

## Methods

### `AddAnnounce`

`OgreBotAPI.Comms:AddAnnounce[fw, ability, to, text]`

Adds a row to this character's Announce tab and saves it in the loaded profile like a panel edit; from then on, casting the ability sends text to the to place (group or raid chat, a tell to the target, a game command, or a console command). An unknown ability or place, empty text, a duplicate row or no loaded profile is refused with a console line, and nothing announces while the Announce tab is switched off.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `ability` | string |  | the ability's name (any rank) or id, from this character's ability export |
| `to` | string |  | where to announce: Group, Raid, Tell To Target, In-Game Command or Execute In Console (any case) |
| `text` | string |  | the announce text; everything after to is joined back with commas, so it need not be quoted |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Comms:AddAnnounce[${Me.Name},Rescue,Group,"Rescue on *Target*"]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:Announce_AddEntry`

### `Broadcast`

`OgreBotAPI.Comms:Broadcast[fw, text, -tab name..., -sound ding|alarm]`

Sends the text to every session in this PC's relay group, this one included; each shows "[Notify] &lt;sender>: &lt;text>" in its OgreConsole (and the -tab tab) and plays the -sound. fw picks which sessions send, not who receives; it never leaves the PC, and with no OgreConsoleHub in the uplink nobody shows it, not even this session.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `text` | string |  | the line to show; commas in it are kept |
| `-tab name...` | string |  | followed by an OgreConsole tab name - each receiver also puts the line in that tab; may be repeated |
| `-sound ding\|alarm` | string |  | followed by ding or alarm - each receiver plays that sound; a bare -sound is ding |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Comms:Broadcast[${Me.Name},"Named is up",-sound,alarm]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:Message_Relay`

### `ConversationBubble`

`OgreBotAPI.Comms:ConversationBubble[fw, num=1]`

Clicks reply number num in the NPC conversation window open on this session; needs a character in the world. When no conversation is open or it has no such reply nothing is clicked, and only the log file says so.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `num` | int | `1` | which reply to click, counting from 1 as SpewConversationBubbles numbers them |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Comms:ConversationBubble[igw:${Me.Name},2]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:ConversationBubble`, `OgreBotAPI:OptNum`, `call Obj_OgreUtilities.DoConversation`

### `Emit`

`OgreBotAPI.Comms:Emit[fw, name, cfw="", dest="", ev=1, dataJson=""]`

Sends a named event to every session in this session's relay group on this PC, this one included; each session whose for-who matches cfw runs its handlers and fires the script event OgreComms_&lt;name> with the event JSON. It never leaves the PC and needs OgreConsoleHub in the uplink - without it nothing arrives anywhere and, a few seconds on, a "comms egress is BLIND" warning prints; an empty name gets a refusal line and invalid dataJson is refused (log file only).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `name` | string |  | the event name (required); letters, digits and _ up to 64 characters, or no OgreComms_ script event fires |
| `cfw` | string | `""` | for-who checked by each receiving session; empty = every session. A session not in the world (login screen, character select, zoning) takes in only what needs no game - messages, tag changes, group and key-bind updates - and throws momentary requests (casts, script events) away; a changed MCP file is kept once and read when it reaches the world; the OgreComms_ script event fires only in the world |
| `dest` | string | `""` | the relay group to deliver to; empty = this session's relay group (Relay Groups tab) |
| `ev` | int | `1` | the data version number stamped on the event |
| `dataJson` | string | `""` | a JSON value carried as the event's data; must be valid JSON |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Comms:Emit[${Me.Name},MyEvent]
```

### `ExecuteEvent`

`OgreBotAPI.Comms:ExecuteEvent[fw, name, ...]`

Runs Event["name"]:Execute[...] on this session with the remaining arguments joined by commas, as written (not quoted). Local only - nothing is sent; needs a character in the world.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `name` | string |  | the LavishScript event to fire |
| `...` | string |  | arguments passed to the event, in order |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Comms:ExecuteEvent[${Me.Name},MyScript_Pull,${Target.ID}]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:ExecuteEvent_JSON`, `OgreBotAPI:ExecuteEvent`

### `GroupQuery`

`OgreBotAPI.Comms:GroupQuery[fw, question...]`

Starts a groupQuery: asks group or raid members a question and judges the answers; read the id from ${OgreBotAPI.Comms.GroupQuery.Last} and the result JSON from .Result[id], which also fires OgreEvent_GroupQueryDone. Answers come over this PC's relay group only, so members on other PCs show as missing, and a bad question prints a groupQuery error to the console.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `question...` | string |  | one JSON object, or -key,value pairs: -question (itemCount, abilityReady, slotResolve or LavishScript["${...}"]), -item, -ability or -slot, -compare with -value, -sendTo (default igw:&lt;me>), -limitMs (default 3000), -askAgainIfBlank |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Comms:GroupQuery[${Me.Name},-question,abilityReady,-ability,Rescue,-sendTo,igw:${Me.Name}]
```

### `Ingest`

`OgreBotAPI.Comms:Ingest[fw, wire]`

Hands a base64 event envelope to this session's comms receiver as if it had arrived from the relay group; it is handled on the next pulse. Nothing is sent anywhere, and unreadable input only adds to Errors.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `wire` | string |  | the base64-encoded event envelope JSON |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Comms:Ingest[${Me.Name},eyJ2IjoxLCJmcm9tIjoiaXMxIiwiZGVzdGluYXRpb24iOiJvZ3JlX2V2ZXJxdWVzdDIiLCJ0eXBlIjoiZXZlbnQiLCJhcmdzIjp7Im5hbWUiOiJNeUV2ZW50IiwiZXYiOjF9fQ==]
```

### `Pushover`

`OgreBotAPI.Comms:Pushover[fw, message..., -title t, -priority n]`

Sends a push notification through the Pushover service from this session; every word that is not a flag becomes the message. Not configured (no app token or user key), switched off in the profile, or no message = nothing sent and a warning, and -sound, -device, -retry and -expire are accepted but ignored.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |

| `-priority n` | int | `0` | followed by a Pushover priority, -2 to 2 |


### `Query`

`OgreBotAPI.Comms:Query[fw, kind, cfw="", timeoutMs=0, paramsJson=""]`

Asks every in-world session in this PC's relay group a typed question and tallies the replies; read the new id from Query_Last, then Query_Count, Query_TrueCount and Query_Json once Query_Done. Sessions on other PCs never answer (it does not use IRC), with no OgreConsoleHub in the uplink nobody answers, not even this session, and an unknown kind or one of the bot's own (lootBid, questSteps) is refused (log file only).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `kind` | string |  | the question: itemCount, abilityReady, slotResolve or eval (required) |
| `cfw` | string | `""` | for-who checked by each session before it answers; empty = every session |
| `timeoutMs` | int | `0` | how long to collect replies in milliseconds; 0 or less = 3000, capped at 60000 |
| `paramsJson` | string | `""` | the question's JSON: itemCount {"item":"name"}, abilityReady {"ability":"name or id"}, slotResolve {"slot":"slot name or number"}, eval {"expr":"a LavishScript expression"}; missing or wrong = nobody answers |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Comms:Query[${Me.Name},itemCount,all,5000,{"item":"Mechanized Platinum Repository of Reconstruction"}]
```

### `Query_Clear`

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |

| `id` | string | `""` | the query id to forget; empty = the last query (the word last itself is not recognised) |

```text

```

# OgreBotAPI.Comms.GroupQuery

## Members

### `Done`

`${OgreBotAPI.Comms.GroupQuery.Done[id]}`

Whether a group query has finished. With no id it reads the query this object was started as, else the last one; an id from another session matches nothing.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string |  | The query id from Last (like gq:is1:4); blank reads the bound or last query |

**Returns:** bool: TRUE once the query has finished; FALSE while it runs, for an id this session did not start, and again 60 seconds after it finished, when the result is dropped.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Comms.GroupQuery.Done[${OgreBotAPI.Comms.GroupQuery.Last}]}
```

### `Last`

`${OgreBotAPI.Comms.GroupQuery.Last}`

The id of the last group query this session started, from ${OgreBotAPI.Comms.GroupQuery[fw,...]} or OgreBotAPI.Comms:GroupQuery. Pass it to Done and Result to read that query.

**Returns:** string: the id, like gq:is1:4; "" when this session has not started one.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Comms.GroupQuery.Last}
```

### `Result`

`${OgreBotAPI.Comms.GroupQuery.Result[id]}`

The result of a finished group query, as JSON. With no id it reads the query this object was started as, else the last one; the result stays readable for 60 seconds after the query finishes.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string |  | The query id from Last (like gq:is1:4); blank reads the bound or last query |

**Returns:** string: the result JSON once finished; "" while it runs, for an id this session did not start, and after the 60 seconds are up.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Comms.GroupQuery.Result[${OgreBotAPI.Comms.GroupQuery.Last}]}
```

### `CheckMountTraining`

`OgreBotAPI.Consumables:CheckMountTraining[fw]`

Queues a check that opens Persona on the Mounts tab and starts training your current mount when the Start Training button is showing, answering the confirm popup (it declines when the popup says training will be carried over from another mount), then closes Persona. You must be on a mount that is not a flight transport or it stops with a console line, and a new call replaces an earlier one.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Consumables:CheckMountTraining[${Me.Name}]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:CheckMountTraining`

### `CoV`

`OgreBotAPI.Consumables:CoV[fw, travel=Teleport, toon, allowSameZone=FALSE]`

Uses Call of the Veteran to bring up the veteran reward porter (or uses one already within 15, or a selection window already open), then picks the travel option and the named group or raid member in its two popups. It is skipped with a console line when you are in combat, name yourself, the member is not in your group (raid when you are in one), the member is already in your zone without allowSameZone, or there is no porter, no open window and the item is not ready.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `travel` | string | `Teleport` | the option to pick in the first popup, matched by its label in any case; the default takes you to the member, Summon brings the member to you |
| `toon` | string |  | the group or raid member to pick in the second popup, by full name; blank echoes that no toon was named and does nothing |
| `allowSameZone` | bool | `FALSE` | TRUE goes ahead even when the member is already in your zone; FALSE skips that case |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Consumables:CoV[${Me.Name},Summon,${Group[1].Name}]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:CoV`

### `DrinkAlcohol`

`OgreBotAPI.Consumables:DrinkAlcohol[fw, item]`

Drinks the named item from your bags at once, using the game's drink_alcohol command on it. With no item named it says so on the console, and so does an item that is not in your bags.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `item` | string | `""` | the item's full name (case does not matter); it must be in your bags, not the bank; required |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Consumables:DrinkAlcohol[${Me.Name},"Flask of Ale"]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:Drink_Alcohol`

### `MountDown`

### `ReplenishFoodDrink`

`OgreBotAPI.Consumables:ReplenishFoodDrink[fw]`

Opens the nearest Food & Drink Depot (it must be within 11) and tops your equipped food and drink up to stacks of 100, equipping a bag copy into the slot before and after the pull, then closes the depot window. It uses the names in your Food and Drink slots, or the configured fallback names when a slot is empty, runs in the background over a few seconds, and only one depot run can be in flight at a time (a second call echoes that it is busy).

### `ReplenishStatPotions`

`OgreBotAPI.Consumables:ReplenishStatPotions[fw, potion=""]`

Opens the nearest Poison, Potion, & Totem Depot (it must be within 11) and pulls one potion until your bags hold 100 of it, then closes the depot window. Each step reports to the console (already stocked, depot out, depot low, no depot nearby), and only one depot run can be in flight at a time.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `potion` | string | `""` | the potion's name as the depot lists it; blank uses the statPotion name from replenish-names.json (your OgreSave/EQ2/Replenish/custom copy wins over the shipped one) |


*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:Get_StatPotions`, `OgreBotAPI:StatPotions_Replenish`, `OgreBotAPI:Get_Poisons`

### `ScrollOf`

`OgreBotAPI.Consumables:ScrollOf[fw, name=Prowess, cancelIfDurationLessThan=0, useBest=FALSE]`

Keeps one scroll buff up: if a buff of that family is already maintained it does nothing (or cancels and recasts it when it has fewer than cancelIfDurationLessThan minutes left), otherwise it casts the family's ability already in your spellbook, or scribes one from your bags first when none is, and checks that it landed. It is queued, reports each outcome to the console, and a new call replaces one still running.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `name` | string | `Prowess` | the scroll family, any case: Prowess, forcelink, Pain, painlink, Power or powerlink; anything else is refused with a console warning |
| `cancelIfDurationLessThan` | int | `0` | minutes; a maintained buff of the family with less time left than this is cancelled and recast, 0 leaves any maintained one alone |
| `useBest` | bool | `FALSE` | only used when none of the family is in your spellbook yet: TRUE scribes the first bag scroll found from the bottom of the family's scroll list, FALSE from the top |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Consumables:ScrollOf[igw:${Me.Name},Prowess,10,TRUE]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:ScrollOf`

### `SummonFamiliar`

`OgreBotAPI.Consumables:SummonFamiliar[fw]`

# OgreBotAPI.Craft

## Methods

### `AddLastScribedRecipe`

`OgreBotAPI.Craft:AddLastScribedRecipe[fw, qty=1]`

Adds the recipe you last scribed this session (by the bot or by hand) to the craft setup queue. With nothing scribed yet it prints a warning and adds nothing.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `qty` | int | `1` | How many to craft; 0 or less becomes 1. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Craft:AddLastScribedRecipe[${Me.Name},5]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreCraft:AddLastScribedRecipe`, `OgreCraftAPI:AddLastScribedRecipe`

### `AddRecipe`

`OgreBotAPI.Craft:AddRecipe[fw, nameOrID|lastknownrecipe, qty=1]`

Adds a recipe to the craft setup queue by full name, by part of a name that matches only one recipe (4 letters or more), by recipe ID, or lastknownrecipe for the recipe last scribed this session. A recipe not in your recipe book prints a warning and adds nothing; if the book has not been read yet the add waits and runs once it has.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `nameOrID\|lastknownrecipe` | string |  | The recipe name, its ID (plain digits), or lastknownrecipe. A name may also be passed as several arguments; they are joined with spaces. |
| `qty` | int | `1` | How many to craft. Read only when it is the last argument and a whole number; 0 or less becomes 1. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Craft:AddRecipe[${Me.Name},"Tempered Iron",2]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreCraft:AddRecipeNameForWho`, `OgreCraftAPI:AddRecipeNameForWho`

### `BuyAllTinkeringRecipes`

`OgreBotAPI.Craft:BuyAllTinkeringRecipes[fw]`

Buys every tinkering recipe book you do not already know or carry from Fizza Cogsworth. It is refused unless you carry at least 3 platinum, are in Steamfont Mountains and are within 10 meters of her, and also while a crafting flow or merchant errand is running.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Craft:BuyAllTinkeringRecipes[${Me.Name}]
```

### `CompleteNavigation`

`OgreBotAPI.Craft:CompleteNavigation[fw]`

Answers craft's OgreCraft_NavigationRequired event (sent only when the craft setting to use events for movement is on) to say your script has moved the character; craft then checks the distance again and carries on. If no request is waiting it prints a warning.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Craft:CompleteNavigation[${Me.Name}]
```

### `DeferNavigation`

`OgreBotAPI.Craft:DeferNavigation[fw]`

Answers craft's OgreCraft_NavigationRequired event to say your script will not move the character, so craft uses its own movement. If no request is waiting it prints a warning.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Craft:DeferNavigation[${Me.Name}]
```

### `ScribeRecipe`

`OgreBotAPI.Craft:ScribeRecipe[fw, name|all=all]`

Scribes recipe scrolls from your bags one at a time, then opens and closes the tradeskill book. A name scribes only scrolls whose full item name matches it in any case (a name with a comma arrives whole), nothing matching prints a line and does nothing, and a call while scribing adds the new scrolls to the run.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `name\|all` | string | `all` | The scroll's full item name in any case, or all for every scribeable scroll in your bags. Left empty it scribes all. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Craft:ScribeRecipe[${Me.Name},all]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreCraft:ScribeRecipe`, `OgreCraftAPI:ScribeRecipe`

### `Start`

`OgreBotAPI.Craft:Start[fw]`

Starts crafting the setup queue. It is refused with a console line when you are not in the world, a crafting flow is already running, or the setup queue is empty, and a refused start changes nothing.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |


### `StartLLL`

It stops at tradeskill level 9 or 19, and is refused when a crafting flow is already running or you are not in the world.


### `StartWrits`


Stops the running crafting run (queue, writs, quest, Low Level Leveling or Auto Tinkering) on the characters the for-who names, the same as ISXOgreEQ2.Craft:Stop. With nothing running it drops a pause and prints that nothing was running.

# OgreBotAPI.Cures

## Members

### `CurseCalled`

`${OgreBotAPI.Cures.CurseCalled[victim]}`

TRUE while a cure-curse call is open for that character, made by RequestCurse or by Request with kind curse. With no argument it asks about you, and any asks whether a call is open for anyone.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `victim` | character name |  | who to ask about; blank means you; any means anyone |

**Returns:** bool: TRUE while a cure-curse call is open (a call lasts at most 8 seconds); FALSE otherwise, and FALSE out of world when no name is given.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Cures.CurseCalled[${Group[1].Name}]}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `Obj_CureCurseCalled.CastCureCurse`

### `CursedID`

`${OgreBotAPI.Cures.CursedID[-archetype X...,-uncurable,-uncurableonly,-GroupOnly]}`

The actor ID of the first cursed member found, searching the raid when you are in one and otherwise the group with you first. By default only curable curses count; 0 when nobody matches.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-archetype X...` | flag + word |  | only members of this archetype: fighter, priest, mage or scout, any case. Repeat the switch to allow more than one archetype. |
| `-uncurable` | flag |  | also accept a member whose curse cannot be cured |
| `-uncurableonly` | flag |  | accept only a member whose curse cannot be cured |
| `-GroupOnly` | flag |  | search your group even when you are in a raid |

**Returns:** int64: the actor ID of the first matching member; 0 when nobody matches.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Cures.CursedID[-archetype,priest,-uncurable]}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `Obj_CureCurseCalled.GetID_CursedMember`, `Obj_CureCurseCalled.GetID_GroupCursedMember`, `Obj_CureCurseCalled.GetID_RaidCursedMember`

### `Detrimental`

`${OgreBotAPI.Cures.Detrimental[main,back,actorId,field]}`

One field of a detrimental, found by its main and backdrop icon IDs, on you or another actor, as a number. The default field, exists, reads 1 or 0; a detrimental that is not there reads 0.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `main` | int | `0` | the detrimental's main icon ID |
| `back` | int | `0` | the detrimental's backdrop icon ID |
| `actorId` | int64 | `0` | whose effects to look at: 0 or your own ID is you. Any other actor ID reads only that actor's first 10 effects, and there duration and maxduration always read 0. |
| `field` | text | `exists` | exists, iseffectinfoavailable, id, mainiconid, backdropiconid, currentincrements, duration or maxduration, any case. Any other word is read from the effect's examine info, and text such as Name reads 0 here - use DetrimentalText. cancel removes the detrimental from you and reads 0. |

**Returns:** float: the field's value; exists reads 1 or 0; 0 when the detrimental is not found or the field is text.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Cures.Detrimental[279,315,${Target.ID},exists]}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `GetInfoOb.CurrentIncrements`, `GetInfoOb.CurrentIncrements_ref`, `GetInfoOb.DetrimentalInfo`

### `DetrimentalText`

`${OgreBotAPI.Cures.DetrimentalText[main,back,actorId,field]}`

The same read as Detrimental, returned as text, so examine-info fields such as Name and Description can be read. Reads "" when the detrimental is not found.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `main` | int | `0` | the detrimental's main icon ID |
| `back` | int | `0` | the detrimental's backdrop icon ID |
| `actorId` | int64 | `0` | whose effects to look at: 0 or your own ID is you. Any other actor ID reads only that actor's first 10 effects, and there duration and maxduration always read 0. |
| `field` | text | `exists` | exists (1 or 0), iseffectinfoavailable, id, mainiconid, backdropiconid, currentincrements, duration, maxduration, or an examine-info field such as Name or Description. Examine-info text can be empty on the first read, so wait for iseffectinfoavailable to read 1. cancel removes the detrimental from you and reads "". |

**Returns:** string: the field's value; "" when the detrimental is not found.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Cures.DetrimentalText[279,315,0,exists]}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `GetInfoOb.DottedDescription_ref`, `GetInfoOb.DottedName_ref`, `OgreBotAPI.DetrimentalInfo_String`

### `GroupCurses`

`${OgreBotAPI.Cures.GroupCurses}`

How many living group members, you included, have a curse that can be cured. Uncurable curses are not counted here - GroupUncurable counts those.

**Returns:** int: the number of living group members with a curable curse; 0 when nobody has one.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Cures.GroupCurses}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `GetInfoOb.CursesInGroup`, `GroupCureOb.NumOfPCsCursed`, `Obj_CureCurseCalled.GroupCurseCount`

### `GroupUncurable`

`${OgreBotAPI.Cures.GroupUncurable}`

```text

```

The actor IDs of the group members, you included, who carry an uncurable curse, as a JSON array sorted lowest first. Reads [] when there are none.

**Returns:** string: a JSON array of actor IDs, for example [1234,5678]; [] when nobody has an uncurable curse.

### `Uncurable`

`${OgreBotAPI.Cures.Uncurable[type,-GroupOnly]}`

## Methods

### `CancelDetrimental`

`OgreBotAPI.Cures:CancelDetrimental[fw, mainId, backdropId]`

Cancels the detrimental with this main and backdrop icon ID on each matching character. Prints a console line when there is no such detrimental, and does nothing when both IDs are 0.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `mainId` | int |  | the detrimental's main icon ID |
| `backdropId` | int |  | the detrimental's backdrop icon ID |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Cures:CancelDetrimental[igw:${Me.Name},279,315]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:CancelDetrimental`, `GetInfoOb:CancelEffect`, `GetInfoOb:CancelEffect_ref`

### `CancelRequests`

`OgreBotAPI.Cures:CancelRequests[fw, victimOrTag]`

Cancels, on each character the for-who matches, every curse, cure and group-cure request whose victim or -tag is the given name (any letter case). Says how many went when any did.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `victimOrTag` | text |  | the toon the requests were for, or the -tag they were given; a blank one is refused with one console line |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Cures:CancelRequests[igw:${Me.Name},${Group[1].Name}]
```

### `ItemCure`

`OgreBotAPI.Cures:ItemCure[fw, type]`

Drinks a cure potion now on each matching character, if a ready one is in their bags. With a type it drinks that potion whether or not you are afflicted or the type is ticked; with no type, or any, it drinks the one PotionNeeded names.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `type` | text |  | arcane, elemental, noxious or trauma; blank or any drinks whatever the cure potion settings need. Any other word prints a console line and does nothing. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Cures:ItemCure[igw:${Me.Name},trauma]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:AutoItemCure`

### `ReplenishPotions`

`OgreBotAPI.Cures:ReplenishPotions[fw, all|arcane|elemental|noxious|trauma]`

Tops up cure potions, up to a full stack, from a Poison, Potion, & Totem Depot within 11 meters, on each matching character. A type is restocked only if one of its potions is already in your bags; a blank or unknown type prints a console line and does nothing.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `all\|arcane\|elemental\|noxious\|trauma` | word |  | all four cure types, or just one of them, any case |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Cures:ReplenishPotions[igw:${Me.Name},all]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:CurePotions_Replenish`, `OgreBotAPI:Get_CurePotions`

### `Request`

`OgreBotAPI.Cures:Request[fw, victim, kinds...]`

Records a cure request for the victim on each character the for-who matches, and their cure casting serves it. A request lasts 8 seconds unless -AutoRemove says otherwise, and is not sent anywhere else, so use oc !c to reach other characters.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `victim` | character name |  | who to cure; a blank one is refused with one console line |
| `kinds...` | words |  | which cures: arcane (a), noxious (n), elemental (e), trauma (t), curse, confrontfear or sickness, one per argument or comma-separated. None means the four basic kinds (arcane, noxious, elemental, trauma). Then the options -AutoRemove &lt;seconds> (how long the request lasts, 1 to 600, default 8) and -tag &lt;name> (a name Cures:CancelRequests can cancel it by). Any other word refuses the whole request with one console line naming it. confrontfear and sickness are kept only on a dirge. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Cures:Request[igw:${Me.Name},${Group[1].Name},noxious,trauma,-AutoRemove,20]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:AutoCure`, `Obj_CureCalled:AutoAdd`, `Obj_CurseCalled:AutoAdd`

### `RequestCurse`

`OgreBotAPI.Cures:RequestCurse[fw, victim, options...]`

Records a cure-curse request for the victim on each character the for-who matches, for their cure casting to serve. The request lasts 8 seconds unless -AutoRemove says otherwise, and is not sent anywhere else; a blank victim, or a word it does not know, refuses it with one console line.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `victim` | character name |  | who to cure of the curse; a blank one is refused with one console line |
| `options...` | words |  | -AutoRemove &lt;seconds> (how long the request lasts, 1 to 600, default 8) and -tag &lt;name> (a name Cures:CancelRequests can cancel it by). Any other word refuses the request with one console line naming it. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Cures:RequestCurse[igw:${Me.Name},${Group[1].Name},-AutoRemove,20]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:AutoCurse`, `OgreBotAPI:Cursed`, `Obj_CureCurseCalled:Add`

### `RequestGroup`

`OgreBotAPI.Cures:RequestGroup[fw]`

Asks each matching character to cast its class group cure within the next 2 seconds, when that ability is ready and someone in the group, you included, has an arcane, noxious, elemental or trauma detrimental. Curses are not group cured.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Cures:RequestGroup[igw:${Me.Name}]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:GroupCure`

### `RequestGroupWatch`

`OgreBotAPI.Cures:RequestGroupWatch[fw, words...]`

Watches for a group cure on each matching character: the class group cure goes out as soon as it is ready and enough of the group, you included, carry one of the named kinds, each counted on its own (curses are not group cured). The watch lasts 8 seconds unless -AutoRemove says otherwise, and several can run at once.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `words...` | words |  | kinds: arcane (a), noxious (n), elemental (e), trauma (t), one per argument or comma-separated; none means any of the four. Options: -count &lt;n> (at least n of you and the group carry the kind, 1 to 6, default 1), -AutoRemove &lt;seconds> (how long to watch, 1 to 600, default 8), -tag &lt;name> (a name Cures:CancelRequests can cancel it by). Any other word refuses the request with one console line naming it. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Cures:RequestGroupWatch[igw:${Me.Name},arcane,trauma,-count,3]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:AutoGroupCure`

### `RequestItem`

`OgreBotAPI.Cures:RequestItem[fw, type]`

Queues a potion cure on each matching character, drunk once the cast bar is free; a potion only ever cures the one who drinks it. The request waits up to 8 seconds for a ready potion.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `type` | text |  | arcane, elemental, noxious or trauma. Blank or any picks the needed type when the request is served. Any other word prints a console line and queues nothing. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Cures:RequestItem[igw:${Me.Name},arcane]
```

### `SetEnabled`

`OgreBotAPI.Cures:SetEnabled[fw, on=TRUE]`

Turns cures on or off on each matching character: the Disable CS_Cure setting and, for a Templar, Warden, Mystic or Monk, that class's cure ability in the Cast Stack. At character select it prints a line and changes nothing.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `on` | bool | `TRUE` | TRUE turns cures on, FALSE turns them off. Off also unticks Enable Auto Cure Potions and cancels the running class ability (Mana Cure, Tranquility, Ancestral Balm or Will of the Heavens). The 'Use these while stunned / stifled / rooted' option is left as you set it. A word that is not yes or no changes nothing. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Cures:SetEnabled[igw:${Me.Name},FALSE]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:Enable_Cures`, `OgreBotAPI:Disable_Cures`

# OgreBotAPI.Debug

## Members

### `CheckVersion`

`${OgreBotAPI.Debug.CheckVersion[fw,compareTo]}`

Compares this session's version with compareTo and returns a one-line verdict that names the character. It returns "" when the for-who does not match this character or the character is not in the world.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `compareTo` | string |  | the version to compare with, as ${ISXOgreEQ2.Version} gives it; blank just reports this session's version |

**Returns:** string: "SAME: &lt;name> (&lt;version>)" when they match; "DIFFERENT: &lt;name> - Mine: &lt;version> Requested: &lt;compareTo>" when they do not; "VERSION: &lt;name> (&lt;version>)" when compareTo is blank; "" when the for-who does not match or the character is not in the world

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Debug.CheckVersion[all,${ISXOgreEQ2.Version}]}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.CheckVersion`

### `DebugPrefix`

`${OgreBotAPI.Debug.DebugPrefix}`

A time-stamped prefix for your own debug lines: the current time followed by ": OgreBot:". The bot does not add it to anything for you, :DebugEcho included.

**Returns:** string: "&lt;time>: OgreBot:", for example "14:03:22: OgreBot:"

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Debug.DebugPrefix} checking loot
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.DebugMessage`, `OgreBotDebug.Prefix`

## Methods

### `BroadcastStat`

`OgreBotAPI.Debug:BroadcastStat[fw, type, value, where=oc]`

Reads one fact about this character, sends "&lt;name> --> &lt;label> &lt;value>" to where `where` says and fires the OgreEvent_SpewStats event with the same data. An unknown type or stat sends a "SpewStat:" error line instead, and faction, currency and recipe open a game window, so their answer comes a moment later.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `type` | string |  | what to report: stat, item, missingitem, abilityready, abilityidready, abilityidcd, marked, faction, currency, recipe or ascension (a leading - is allowed); quest and missingquest answer with a not-yet error |
| `value` | string |  | what to look up for that type: a stat key such as potency or haste, an item name, an ability id, a faction name or all, a currency name (eth and loyalty are short names), or a recipe name; leave blank for marked and ascension. An item you have none of sends nothing |
| `where` | string | `oc` | where the line goes: oc (the Ogre console on every session), irc, or event (no line, only the event); any other word goes to oc |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Debug:BroadcastStat[all,stat,potency,oc]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.SpewStat`, `OgreBotAPI:Get_Faction`

### `DebugEcho`

`OgreBotAPI.Debug:DebugEcho[fw, a, b]`

Echoes a and b, joined by a space, to this session's console, but only while debug mode is on (see :SetDebugMode). With debug mode off, which is the default, it prints nothing.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `a` | string |  | the first part of the line |
| `b` | string |  | the second part, printed after a space |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Debug:DebugEcho[${Me.Name},"Target:",${Target.Name}]
```

### `Echo`

`OgreBotAPI.Debug:Echo[fw, text, text2=""]`

Echoes text and text2, joined by a space, to this session's console. Only characters the for-who matches print it, and it works out of the world too.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `text` | string |  | the first part of the line |
| `text2` | string | `""` | the second part, printed after a space |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Debug:Echo[${Me.Name},"Pull ready","waiting on tank"]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:Echo`, `OgreBotDebug:Echo`

### `SetDebugMode`

`OgreBotAPI.Debug:SetDebugMode[fw, on=TRUE]`

Turns debug mode on or off; while it is on, :DebugEcho prints its lines. Debug mode starts off, and a word that is not a yes/no word leaves it as it is.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|

```text

```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:SetDebugMode`

# OgreBotAPI.Events

## Methods

### `AddChatEntry`

`OgreBotAPI.Events:AddChatEntry[fw, text, oc, ding, code]`

Adds a row to the Chat Events tab of the loaded profile: when a line in the chat window contains text (any case), it announces in OgreConsole (oc), plays the ding sound (ding) and runs code as a command, in that order, with no arguments passed to the code. The row is unsaved until Save, only fires while the tab is ticked on the Settings tab (it warns if not), a blank text or an identical enabled row is refused with a console line, and every session's console is told it was added.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `text` | string |  | Text to watch for - matched as a case-insensitive substring of each incoming chat-window line |
| `oc` | bool |  | TRUE to send `<name> -> <kind> event -> (<text>) found -> <match>` to OgreConsole when it fires |
| `ding` | bool |  | TRUE to play the ding sound when it fires |
| `code` | string |  | A command line to run when it fires (run on the next frame, may be empty); any extra arguments after it are joined back on with commas |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Events:AddChatEntry[igw:${Me.Name},"tells you",TRUE,TRUE,"echo got a tell"]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:ChatEvent_AddEntry`

### `AddDespawnEntry`

`OgreBotAPI.Events:AddDespawnEntry[fw, text, oc, ding, code]`

Adds a row to the Despawn Events tab of the loaded profile: when an actor despawns whose name contains text (case-sensitive), it announces in OgreConsole (oc), plays the ding sound (ding) and runs code as a command, in that order, with no arguments passed to the code. The row is unsaved until Save, only fires while the tab is ticked on the Settings tab (it warns if not), a blank text or an identical enabled row is refused with a console line, and every session's console is told it was added.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `text` | string |  | Text to watch for - matched as a case-sensitive substring of the despawning actor's name |
| `oc` | bool |  | TRUE to send `<name> -> <kind> event -> (<text>) found -> <match>` to OgreConsole when it fires |
| `ding` | bool |  | TRUE to play the ding sound when it fires |
| `code` | string |  | A command line to run when it fires (run on the next frame, may be empty); any extra arguments after it are joined back on with commas |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Events:AddDespawnEntry[${Me.Name},"a cursed spirit",TRUE,FALSE,"echo spirit is gone"]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:DespawnEvent_AddEntry`

### `AddSpawnEntry`
