# OgreBotAPI.ForWho

## Members

### `Alias`

`${OgreBotAPI.ForWho.Alias[name]}`

Returns the character name an alias points to right now, or "" when it names nobody present. It reads @me, @Tank, @Healer1 to @Healer3, @DPS1 to @DPS3, @Bard, @Enchanter, @Fighter / @Priest / @Mage / @Scout with an optional rank, @PCTarget, @NPCsTarget, *&lt;your alias> (only while the OgreBot enable-aliases setting is on and you are in the world) and *Team:&lt;group> (its first member present); a plain character name or class word returns "".

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | the alias to resolve, with its @ or * (any case) |

**Returns:** string: the character name the alias resolves to; "" when it resolves to nobody, is not an alias, or no argument is given.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.ForWho.Alias[@Healer1]}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.Get_Alias`, `GetInfoOb.Alias`

### `AliasesJSON`

`${OgreBotAPI.ForWho.AliasesJSON}`

Returns the loaded OgreBot profile's own alias list as JSON text, one object per row with its starred name, For (what it points to) and, when set, NR (no raid) and a disabled marker. Returns "[]" when no OgreBot profile is loaded or it has no aliases.

**Returns:** string: a JSON array of alias rows; "[]" when there are none or no profile is loaded.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.ForWho.AliasesJSON}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.Get_Aliases_JSON`

### `Me`

`${OgreBotAPI.ForWho.Me[expr]}`

Answers whether a call with this for-who would run on this character - the same test every OgreBotAPI method makes on its first argument. While zoning or at character select it answers from what it already knows: words that need a live read (id:, a bare actor id, eval_num_me:, @PCTarget, @NPCsTarget, *aliases) do not match, and group words use your last settled zone.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `expr` | string |  | a for-who expression, one word with no spaces or commas. \| separates alternatives (any one group matching is enough), + joins words that must all match, and a leading - or ! negates a word. Words, any case: all, auto, @all, @group, @raid (everyone); me, @me; a character name; your InnerSpace session name (is1); an archetype fighter, priest, mage, scout, or healer, melee, caster (plurals too), and not&lt;archetype> such as notfighter; a class or subclass (predator, ranger); an ascension class (geomancer); g1 to g4 (your raid group); groups:&lt;digits> (your raid group number appears in the digits); groupleader; igw:&lt;name> (that character is you or in your group), with irw: also counting the raid, igzw: / irzw: also needing them in your zone, and a bn ending (igwbn:, irzwbn:) leaving yourself out; not:&lt;name>; id:&lt;actor id> or a bare actor id; ToonFlagged:&lt;n>; eval_num_me:&lt;member>&lt;op>&lt;value> with op &lt; &lt;= > >= = or ==; @Tank, @Healer1 to @Healer3, @DPS1 to @DPS3, @Bard, @Enchanter; @Fighter, @Priest, @Mage, @Scout with an optional rank (@Scout2); @PCTarget, @NPCsTarget; *&lt;alias> (your own aliases) and *Team:&lt;group>. A word that is none of these simply does not match. |

**Returns:** int: 1 when the expression selects this character; 0 when it does not, including an empty expression (an empty for-who on a method means all); NULL with no argument.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.ForWho.Me[igw:${Me.Name}+healer]}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `GetInfoOb.CommandForMe`, `GetInfoOb.CommandForMe_Check`, `GetInfoOb.CommandForMe_Eval_Me`

### `Member`

`${OgreBotAPI.ForWho.Member[expr,name]}`

Answers whether a for-who expression selects a given member of your group or raid, using the same words as ForWho.Me with that member in your place. The member must be in your current group or raid; g1 to g4, groups:, groupleader, session names and ascension words never match a member, and eval_num_me: only reads Health, HealthPct, Power and PowerPct.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `expr` | string |  | a for-who expression, the same grammar and words as ForWho.Me |
| `name` | string |  | the group or raid member to test, by character name (any case) |

**Returns:** int: 1 when the expression selects that member; 0 when it does not, when the name is not in your group or raid, or when you are not in the world; NULL with fewer than two arguments.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.ForWho.Member[priest,${Group[1].Name}]}
```

## Methods

### `AddAlias`

`OgreBotAPI.ForWho:AddAlias[fw, alias, value, noRaid=FALSE]`

Adds a row to the loaded OgreBot profile's alias list, so *&lt;alias> names the first character present that value matches: you, a group member by name, a raid member by name, then whoever of you, the group and the raid first fits value as a class word. Several rows may share one name (the first that resolves wins) but an exact repeat is refused with a warning; with no OgreBot profile loaded nothing happens and one console line says so, and the change is kept in memory until the profile is saved.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `alias` | string |  | the alias name; a leading * is added when you leave it off |
| `value` | string |  | what the alias points to: a character name or a class word (archetype, class or subclass) |
| `noRaid` | bool | `FALSE` | TRUE = only you and your group count, raid members are not matched |

```text
OgreBotAPI.ForWho:AddAlias[${Me.Name},MainHealer,${Group[1].Name},TRUE]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:Alias_AddEntry`

### `ChangeAlias`

`OgreBotAPI.ForWho:ChangeAlias[fw, from, to, silent=FALSE]`

Points the first alias row named from at to instead (a blank to clears it, so the alias names nobody), and announces the change in the Ogre console unless silent is TRUE. When no alias of that name exists nothing changes and one console line says so (not when silent); with no OgreBot profile loaded nothing happens and one console line says so.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `from` | string |  | the alias to change (with or without its *) |
| `to` | string |  | the new character name or class word it points to |
| `silent` | bool | `FALSE` | TRUE = make the change without the Ogre console announce |

```text
OgreBotAPI.ForWho:ChangeAlias[${Me.Name},MainHealer,Templar]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:Alias_ChangeEntry`

### `ForceUpdate`

`OgreBotAPI.ForWho:ForceUpdate[fw]`

Drops the cached alias answers, so the next *alias is worked out against the group and raid as they are now. The cache lasts about a second and every alias edit already drops it, so this matters only straight after the group changes.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.ForWho:ForceUpdate[all]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:ForceAliasUpdate`

### `RemoveAlias`

`OgreBotAPI.ForWho:RemoveAlias[fw, name|all]`

Removes the first alias row with that name from the loaded OgreBot profile, or every alias row when the name is all or blank. With no OgreBot profile loaded nothing happens and one console line says so; the change is kept in memory until the profile is saved.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `name\|all` | string |  | the alias to remove (with or without its *), or all to clear the whole list |

```text
OgreBotAPI.ForWho:RemoveAlias[${Me.Name},MainHealer]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:Alias_RemoveEntry`

### `RenameAlias`

`OgreBotAPI.ForWho:RenameAlias[fw, from, to, silent=FALSE]`

Renames the first alias row named from to to (stars added when missing), keeping what it points to, and announces it in the Ogre console unless silent is TRUE. The row keeps its place and its no-raid and disabled settings; a blank name, no alias named from or a to name already taken gets one line and renames nothing, and with no OgreBot profile loaded nothing happens.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `from` | string |  | the alias to rename (with or without its *) |
| `to` | string |  | the new alias name (with or without its *) |
| `silent` | bool | `FALSE` | TRUE = rename without the Ogre console announce |

```text
OgreBotAPI.ForWho:RenameAlias[${Me.Name},MainHealer,BackupHealer]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:Alias_ChangeEntryAlias`

# OgreBotAPI.HOs

## Members

### `DoEnabled`

`${OgreBotAPI.HOs.DoEnabled}`

TRUE while this character is running OgreBot's solo HO (started with DoSetup or DoSetEnabled); session only, never saved, and FALSE after a reload. It turns FALSE when the HO count is reached, the timeout runs out, the target dies or goes away, DoSetEnabled[...,FALSE] is called, or another group member takes over the solo HO.

**Returns:** bool: TRUE when the solo HO is running on this character; FALSE otherwise.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.HOs.DoEnabled}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.DoHO_Get_Enabled`

### `DoHOerID`

`${OgreBotAPI.HOs.DoHOerID}`

The actor ID of the OTHER group member who is running the solo HO, as that character announced it. Session only; 0 when this character is the one running it, or nobody is.

**Returns:** int64: the other HO'er's actor ID; 0 when it is this character or nobody.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.HOs.DoHOerID}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.DoHO_Get_HOerID`

### `DoPrimed`

`${OgreBotAPI.HOs.DoPrimed}`

TRUE once the solo HO has made its first full setup pass on this character (the group's HO settings set, stale casts cancelled, the HO'er announced); a later enable while primed only turns this character's own HO settings back on. Session only, and cleared by DoReset, by a disable, and when another session takes over.

**Returns:** bool: TRUE when the solo HO setup has been applied; FALSE otherwise.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.HOs.DoPrimed}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.DoHO_Get_Primed`

### `DoTargetID`

`${OgreBotAPI.HOs.DoTargetID}`

The actor ID given to DoSetup with -TargetID, the mob the solo HO is aimed at; 0 when no target was given, or after DoReset or a new DoSetup without one. Session only - note the casing: DoTargetID.

**Returns:** int64: the solo HO's target actor ID; 0 when none is set.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.HOs.DoTargetID}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.DoHo_Get_TargetID`

### `MyArchetypeStart`

`${OgreBotAPI.HOs.MyArchetypeStart}`

TRUE when the starter window is up and the heroic opportunity's centre icon is this character's own archetype, so the starter in progress is ours. FALSE when no starter is showing or it belongs to another archetype.

**Returns:** bool: TRUE when the starter showing is this character's archetype; FALSE otherwise, including when no heroic opportunity is up.

### `MyWheelTimeRemaining`

Seconds left on the HO timer, but only while the wheel is up and it is this character's archetype's wheel. Returns 0 when no heroic opportunity is up, it is still in the starter phase, or the wheel belongs to another archetype.

## Methods

### `Advance`

`OgreBotAPI.HOs:Advance[fw]`

Takes one turn on an open wheel, casting each of this character's abilities once for the wheel steps its archetype can complete now; it follows "Offensive Only" and "HO - Change Target", works while the bot is paused, and suits scripts that keep "HO Wheel" off and drive the wheel themselves. It does nothing with no heroic opportunity or wheel up, no step for this archetype, "Last to Complete" on while other archetypes still have steps, "HO - allow unknown target" off with no known HO target, or within 1 second of the last advance.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.HOs:Advance[igw:${Me.Name}]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:HO_Advance`, `OgreBotAPI:HO_Wheel_Advance`

### `AllowIcon`

`OgreBotAPI.HOs:AllowIcon[fw, icon]`

Adds an HO icon ID to the allow list; while the list has any icon, cast stack abilities that carry a different HO icon are skipped (abilities with no HO icon are not affected, the disable list wins over it, and the bot's own HO starter and wheel casts are not steered). Session only - never saved to the profile, kept until cleared, LetsGo or the extension reloads.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `icon` | int |  | HO icon ID: fighter 0-5, priest 12-17, mage 24-29, scout 36-41. Required; an icon already in the list does nothing. A missing icon, or a word that is not a whole number, is refused with a console line and changes nothing. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.HOs:AllowIcon[${Me.Name},25]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:Set_Allow_HOICon`

### `CancelStarter`

`OgreBotAPI.HOs:CancelStarter[fw]`

Cancels the HO starter window right away by sending the game's cancel HO starter command. Does nothing when no heroic opportunity is up or the starter window is not showing (a running wheel is never cancelled).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.HOs:CancelStarter[${Me.Name}]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:HO_Cancel_Starter`

### `ClearAllowIcon`

`OgreBotAPI.HOs:ClearAllowIcon[fw, icon]`

Removes one HO icon ID from the allow list (session only). When the list becomes empty, no ability is skipped for its HO icon by this list.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `icon` | int |  | HO icon ID to remove from the allow list. Required; an icon not in the list does nothing. A missing icon, or a word that is not a whole number, is refused with a console line and changes nothing. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.HOs:ClearAllowIcon[${Me.Name},25]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:Clear_Allow_HOICon`

### `ClearAllowIcons`

`OgreBotAPI.HOs:ClearAllowIcons[fw]`

Empties the HO icon allow list (session only), so the cast stack no longer skips abilities for being outside it. The disable list is not touched.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:Clear_Allow_HOICons`

### `DoReset`

`OgreBotAPI.HOs:DoReset[fw]`

Clears this character's solo HO record (session only): target, HO count and completions, the leave-open and cast stack options, the other HO'er's ID and the primed flag. It does not turn the solo HO on or off, change the timeout, or change any settings.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.HOs:DoReset[${Me.Name}]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:DoHO_Reset`

### `DoSetEnabled`

`OgreBotAPI.HOs:DoSetEnabled[fw, on=TRUE, option...]`

Turns OgreBot's solo HO on or off on this character without clearing its record (use DoSetup to set the target and count); calling it with the state it already has does nothing unless -Force, and a value that is not a yes/no word does nothing. On/off is session only, and the settings it writes are profile options in memory, kept on disk only if the profile is saved before they are put back.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `on` | bool | `TRUE` | TRUE to run the solo HO here: makes this character the HO'er, tells the rest of the group to stand down, cancels another archetype's starter if one is up, writes the group's HO settings, cancels group casts with more than 0.5 seconds left, holds the first start for -DelayStart seconds (default 1) and extends the timeout to at least 25 seconds (or sets it to -TimeOut n). FALSE to stop it: puts back this character's HO settings and asks the group to put back theirs. |
| `option...` | flags |  | Any of -Force (run even if already in that state), -NoEnable / -PrimeOnly / -NoStart (set the group up but leave this character's HO settings off), -NoHoAbilities (on FALSE, keep HO abilities disabled on the rest of the group), -TimeOut n, -DelayStart n. Unknown words are ignored. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.HOs:DoSetEnabled[${Me.Name},FALSE]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:DoHO_Set_Enable`

### `DoSetup`

`OgreBotAPI.HOs:DoSetup[fw, option...]`

Starts OgreBot's solo HO with this character as the one who starts it (no HO needs to be up): it clears the previous record, starts a 25 second timeout and enables it as DoSetEnabled[fw,TRUE,...] with the same options, turning HO Start, Starter and Wheel off for the group and on for this character and setting the group's HO helper settings. It ends after -NumHOsToComplete completions (default 1), on timeout, or when the -TargetID mob dies or goes away, and every session then puts back the HO settings it had; the record is session only, and the changed HO settings are profile options in memory, written to disk only if the profile is saved while they are changed.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `option...` | flags |  | Any of -TargetID id, -NumHOsToComplete n, -TimeOut n (instead of 25 seconds), -LeaveStartOpen, -LeaveWheelOpen, -AllowCastStack (keep this character's cast stack on), -NoModifyOptions (change no settings), -Force (when the solo HO is already running, apply the settings again instead of only recording the new options), -NoEnable, -DelayStart n, -NoHoAbilities, in any order; the DoSetEnabled options work here too. Unknown words are ignored. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.HOs:DoSetup[${Me.Name},-TargetID,${Target.ID},-NumHOsToComplete,1,-TimeOut,30]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:DoHO_Setup`

### `RestoreSetUpFor`

`OgreBotAPI.HOs:RestoreSetUpFor[fw]`

Puts "Heroic Surge (ROC Adorn)" back to the value SetUpFor remembered, quietly, and forgets it. Does nothing if SetUpFor was not called since the last restore, or the extension was reloaded in between.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.HOs:RestoreSetUpFor[igw:${Me.Name}]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:Restore_SetUpFor_HOs`

### `SetUpFor`

`OgreBotAPI.HOs:SetUpFor[fw]`

Readies a fight that needs HOs controlled, with or without an HO up: remembers the current "Heroic Surge (ROC Adorn)" setting (only on the first call before a RestoreSetUpFor), then turns it off quietly so the adornment cannot start or advance HOs on its own. The remembered value is session only; the setting itself is a profile option changed in memory, so saving the profile before RestoreSetUpFor keeps it off on disk.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.HOs:SetUpFor[igw:${Me.Name}]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:SetUpFor_HOs`

### `Start`

`OgreBotAPI.HOs:Start[fw, -ActorID id, -SkipTimer]`

Casts this character's archetype HO starter ability (Fighting Chance, Lucky Break, Divine Providence or Arcane Augur) once, immediately, even while the bot is paused, and tells the group which actor the HO is on. Nothing happens within 1 second of the last start unless -SkipTimer is given, or when the ability is not ready, out of range or the cast bar is busy - call it again to retry.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `-ActorID id` | flag + number |  | Start the HO on this actor ID instead of the current target; -TargetID id is the same flag. Without it the cast goes at the current target and does nothing while any heroic opportunity is already up. With it, nothing happens if that actor is gone or a wheel is already running, and if another archetype's starter is up it is cancelled and the cast goes on the actor once the starter closes and the ability is ready (giving up after about 8 seconds). |
| `-SkipTimer` | flag |  | Ignore the 1 second wait after the last start. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.HOs:Start[${Me.Name},-ActorID,${Target.ID}]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:HO_Start`

### `Starter`

`OgreBotAPI.HOs:Starter[fw]`

Takes one turn on an open starter chain, casting this character's abilities for the starter icons its archetype is offered; it follows "HO - Change Target" and works while the bot is paused. It does nothing when no heroic opportunity or starter window is up, this archetype has no icon in the chain, "HO - allow unknown target" is off and no HO target is known, or within 1 second of the last starter cast.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|

# OgreBotAPI.IM

## Members

### `EndWhenFinished`

`${OgreBotAPI.IM.EndWhenFinished}`

Whether -end is armed, so the Inventory Manager window closes itself once the work has been idle for about 1.5 seconds. Only the console arms it (the -end flag of an `ogre im` line); there is no method for it, and closing the window clears it.

**Returns:** bool: TRUE while -end is armed; FALSE otherwise.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.IM.EndWhenFinished}
```

### `IsOpen`

`${OgreBotAPI.IM.IsOpen}`

Whether the Inventory Manager window is up on this session - the window is the session, so this is what a script waits on after starting it with -end. It reads FALSE when the UI host is not available, even while modes run from the console.

**Returns:** bool: TRUE while the Inventory Manager window really exists; FALSE when it is closed or could not open.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.IM.IsOpen}
```

### `IsRunning`

`${OgreBotAPI.IM.IsRunning}`

Whether the Inventory Manager is doing work right now - a mode (depot, sell, destroy, tse, restock, trade, quiver), a chain of them, or a depot withdraw started anywhere. It is FALSE while the window sits open and idle and can be FALSE just before a mode starts, so to wait for work to finish poll IsOpen with -end instead.

**Returns:** bool: TRUE while any Inventory Manager mode or chain is working; FALSE when idle.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.IM.IsRunning}
```

### `Mode`

`${OgreBotAPI.IM.Mode}`

The Inventory Manager mode working right now: depot, sell, destroy, tse, restock, trade, quiver or withdraw (a depot withdraw from anywhere). It reads chain when only a chain is busy between modes, and empty when idle.

**Returns:** string: the busy mode's name, "chain", or "" when nothing is running.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.IM.Mode}
```

### `Status`

`${OgreBotAPI.IM.Status}`

One line saying what the Inventory Manager is doing, the same line `echo ${OgreBotAPI.IM}` prints. It reads "closed", "open, idle", "open, running sell", "open, running withdraw" or "closed (running headless), running restock", with "; will close when finished (-end)" added while -end is armed.

**Returns:** string: the status line, such as "open, idle" or "closed".

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.IM.Status}
```

## Methods

### `Chain`

`OgreBotAPI.IM:Chain[fw, words...]`

Prints what each -&lt;mode> flag expands to. `reload` reads the chain defaults from disk again.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `words...` | string |  | reload. Optional. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.IM:Chain[all,reload]
```

### `Close`

`OgreBotAPI.IM:Close[fw]`

Closes the Inventory Manager window, clears a pending -end, and closes the merchant window unless a sell run is using it. It does not stop work that is running - use Stop for that.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.IM:Close[${Me.Name}]
```

### `Console`

`OgreBotAPI.IM:Console[fw, word]`

The window's activity log: always, running or never sets when the strip shows, and clear empties it. With no word it prints the setting and how many lines it holds.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `word` | string |  | always, running, never or clear. Optional. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.IM:Console[all,running]
```

### `Depot`

`OgreBotAPI.IM:Depot[fw, words...]`

Runs the depot mode, deposits into the nearest house or guild hall depots, and brings the window up; with no flags it runs the line saved on the Depot tab, or warns if nothing is saved. The words after it are read as one `ogre im` line, so `ogre im depot status` is `ogre im status`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `words...` | string |  | The depot flags, one argument each, such as -harvest all -nearestdepot. `ogre im help` lists them. Optional. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.IM:Depot[all,-harvest,all,-nearestdepot]
```

### `Destroy`

`OgreBotAPI.IM:Destroy[fw, words...]`

The destroy mode: with no words, or flags first, it brings the window up and destroys what is on the destroy list; a name or an item id destroys that one item. The other first words are in the param.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `words...` | string |  | stop, status, reload, preview (or plan), list [all], add &lt;name> or remove &lt;name>; or flags; or an item. One argument each. Optional. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.IM:Destroy[all,preview]
```

### `End`

`OgreBotAPI.IM:End[fw]`

Stops whatever the Inventory Manager is running and closes the window, the same as `ogre end im` and the window's X. It stops first, so a script polling IsOpen never reads FALSE while work is still going.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.IM:End[all]
```

### `Examine`

`OgreBotAPI.IM:Examine[fw, box]`

Fills the named box of the window with the item in the open item examine window; you still pick the quantity and add it. It warns when no item examine window is open.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `box` | string |  | restock or trade: the tab whose box it fills. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.IM:Examine[all,restock]
```

### `Flags`

`OgreBotAPI.IM:Flags[fw, words...]`

Takes the words no other method spells: a line wholly of mode flags is a chain, run in that order, with -end to close the window when it finishes. Any other line goes to the depot parser, which says what it cannot read.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `words...` | string |  | The line, one argument each. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.IM:Flags[all,-destroy,-tse,-end]
```

### `Help`

`OgreBotAPI.IM:Help[fw]`

Prints the `ogre im` usage to the console: the depot flags, every other mode, chains, the queue and the settings.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.IM:Help[all]
```

### `Open`

`OgreBotAPI.IM:Open[fw]`

Opens the Inventory Manager window on the characters named; calling it while the window is up just refreshes it. If the UI host is not available it prints a warning and IsOpen stays FALSE.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.IM:Open[${Me.Name}]
```

### `Pane`

`OgreBotAPI.IM:Pane[fw, words...]`

Builds the editor list for a tab and prints how many rows it holds: sell or destroy, destroy when no name is given. `sell reopen` opens the merchant again first if its window is shut, as the Sell list tab's Refresh button does.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `words...` | string |  | The tab name, then reopen for sell. Optional. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.IM:Pane[all,destroy]
```

### `Probe`

`OgreBotAPI.IM:Probe[fw]`

Prints what the open depot's tier dropdown holds, for checking a depot window against the depot tables. It changes nothing.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.IM:Probe[all]
```

### `Queue`

`OgreBotAPI.IM:Queue[fw, mode]`

Adds a mode to the run queue and brings the window up: it runs when the current work finishes. With no mode it prints what is waiting, and a word that is not a mode is refused.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `mode` | string |  | depot, sell, destroy, tse, restock, trade or quiver. Optional. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.IM:Queue[all,sell]
```

### `Reload`

`OgreBotAPI.IM:Reload[fw]`

Reloads the depot tables from disk: the depot kinds, the ammo rows and the shared resource table.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.IM:Reload[all]
```

### `Restock`

`OgreBotAPI.IM:Restock[fw, words...]`

The restock mode: with no words, or a profile name, it brings the window up and tops up from the depots, and -forwho &lt;expr> runs it only on the characters named. A word short of its arguments is read as a profile name.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `words...` | string |  | A profile, or one of stop, status, reload, list (or profiles), show &lt;profile>, preview (or plan) [profile], set &lt;profile> &lt;qty> &lt;item>, forwho &lt;profile> &lt;who> &lt;item>, drop &lt;profile> &lt;item>. Optional. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.IM:Restock[all,"Raid night",-forwho,${Me.Name}]
```

### `Sell`

`OgreBotAPI.IM:Sell[fw, words...]`

The sell mode: with no words it brings the window up and sells what is on the sell list, opening a nearby merchant if none is open. The other first words are in the param; any other words go to the run.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `words...` | string |  | stop, status, reload, preview (or plan), list [all], add &lt;name> or remove &lt;name>, then its arguments. Optional. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.IM:Sell[all,preview]
```

### `Settings`

`OgreBotAPI.IM:Settings[fw, words...]`

With no words, prints the saved settings; too few words prints the usage and changes nothing. Otherwise it changes one setting, as the param says.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `words...` | string |  | One of: bag &lt;tse\|destroy> &lt;1-6\|overseer\|harvest\|sharedtradeskill> &lt;on\|off>; tse &lt;option> &lt;on\|off\|number>; quiver &lt;arrow\|bolt\|throwing> &lt;name\|clear\|examine>; depot &lt;flags>; reload. One argument each. Optional. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.IM:Settings[all,tse,minlevel,120]
```

### `Status`

`OgreBotAPI.IM:Status[fw]`

Prints the session line to the console, then the chain if one runs and one summary line each for depot, sell, destroy, restock and trade. For one line a script can read, use ${OgreBotAPI.IM.Status}.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |


### `Stop`

`OgreBotAPI.IM:Stop[fw]`

Stops whatever the Inventory Manager is running (the chain, every busy mode, or a depot withdraw still in flight) and leaves the window open. When nothing is running it prints "im: nothing is running." to the console.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

### `Trade`

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |

### `Transmute`

### `Tse`

`OgreBotAPI.IM:Tse[fw, words...]`

The transmute, salvage and extract mode: `stop` stops it, and anything else brings the window up and runs. It starts from the options saved on the TSE tab, and flags such as -salvage or -stopafter 5 change that run.


# OgreBotAPI.Inventory

## Members

### `AdornmentColour`

`${OgreBotAPI.Inventory.AdornmentColour[iconId]}`

Looks up the colour of an adornment from its icon id, using the bot's built-in table of known adornment icons.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `iconId` | number |  | the adornment's icon id |

**Returns:** string - White, Red, Blue, Cyan, Green, Purple or Black. Empty when the icon id is not in the table.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Inventory.AdornmentColour[3877]}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.AdornmentIconIDColour`, `OgreBotAPI.Get_AdornmentColour`

### `AdornToRemoveSlot`

`${OgreBotAPI.Inventory.AdornToRemoveSlot[adorn]}`

The reverse of AdornToSlot: takes the slot number out of an adornment entry name, so _ADORN_&lt;slot>_&lt;name> becomes _ADORN_&lt;name>. Text that is not in that form comes back unchanged.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `adorn` | text |  | the adornment entry name, _ADORN_&lt;slot>_&lt;name> |

**Returns:** string - the entry name without the slot, or the input unchanged when it is not in the _ADORN_&lt;slot>_&lt;name> form.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Inventory.AdornToRemoveSlot["_ADORN_21_Raid Rune: Void Flow III"]}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.ConvertAdornToRemoveSlot`

### `AdornToSlot`

`${OgreBotAPI.Inventory.AdornToSlot[adorn, slot=21]}`

Puts a slot number into an adornment entry name: _ADORN_&lt;name> becomes _ADORN_&lt;slot>_&lt;name>. Text that is not in the _ADORN_&lt;name> form (with no other underscores) comes back unchanged.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `adorn` | text |  | the adornment entry name, _ADORN_&lt;name> |
| `slot` | number | `21` | the slot number to insert |

**Returns:** string - the entry name with the slot inserted, or the input unchanged when it is not in the _ADORN_&lt;name> form.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Inventory.AdornToSlot["_ADORN_Raid Rune: Void Flow III",21]}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.ConvertAdornToSlot`

### `Count`

`${OgreBotAPI.Inventory.Count[itemName, exact|contains]}`

Counts how many of an item you are carrying, adding up every stack in your bags and your Harvest Bag. The name match ignores case; it is exact unless you pass contains.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `itemName` | item name |  | the item to count |
| `exact\|contains` | text | `exact` | exact = the whole name must match, contains = any item whose name contains the text |

**Returns:** int - the total quantity on hand. 0 when nothing matches, the name is empty, you are not in the world, or the match word is not exact or contains (that last case also prints a line).

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Inventory.Count[Ingot,contains]}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `Obj_OgreUtilities.ItemCount`, `OgreBotAPI.ItemCount`

### `CurrentImmunityRune`

`${OgreBotAPI.Inventory.CurrentImmunityRune}`

Names the immunity rune on the belt you are wearing; it only reads your own character. It needs the belt's item details: an empty answer means they are still loading (the read asks the game for them), so ask again shortly - never treat empty as no rune.

**Returns:** string - Stun, Stifle, Mez, Fear or Medic for the rune worn. Unknown when the details are loaded and no known rune is on the belt. Empty when the details are not loaded yet or you are not in the world.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Inventory.CurrentImmunityRune}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.Get_CurrentImmunityRune`

### `IsAdornmentColour`

`${OgreBotAPI.Inventory.IsAdornmentColour[iconId, colour]}`

TRUE when an adornment icon id is a known icon of the given colour. The colour match ignores case, and a blank colour means White.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `iconId` | number |  | the adornment's icon id |
| `colour` | text | `White` | White, Red, Blue, Cyan, Green, Purple or Black |

**Returns:** bool - TRUE when the icon is in the table with that colour. FALSE when the colour differs or the icon id is not in the table.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Inventory.IsAdornmentColour[3877,White]}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.IsAdornmentColour`

### `PackPonyRunning`

### `SlotAvailable`

`${OgreBotAPI.Inventory.SlotAvailable[slot name]}`

TRUE when the item worn in the named equipment slot can be used (activated) right now - for example, a clicky cloak on cooldown reads FALSE. It does not tell you whether the slot is empty or can hold an item.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `slot name` | text |  | one of: primary, secondary, head, cloak, chest, shoulders, forearms, hands, legs, feet, left_ring, right_ring, ears, ears2, neck, left_wrist, right_wrist, ranged, ammo, waist, activate1, activate2, event_slot, food, drink (any case) |

**Returns:** bool - TRUE when the item in that slot is usable now. FALSE when it is not, when the name is not one of the slot names (a warning is printed), or when the slot could not be read.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Inventory.SlotAvailable[cloak]}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.EquipmentSlotAvailable`

### `SlotModifier`

`${OgreBotAPI.Inventory.SlotModifier[slot, modifier]}`

Reads one stat modifier from the item equipped in a slot, matching the modifier name without regard to case. It reads the item's detail record, which the game may have to fetch first, so it can return empty until that has loaded.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `slot` | slot name or number |  | the equipment slot, as the game's equipment list accepts it |
| `modifier` | text |  | the modifier name, e.g. Potency |

**Returns:** string - the modifier's value. Empty when the item has no such modifier, its details are not loaded yet, or you are not in the world.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Inventory.SlotModifier[primary,Potency]}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.Get_EquipmentModifierValue`

### `SlotNumAvailable`

`${OgreBotAPI.Inventory.SlotNumAvailable[slot number 1-22]}`

The same check as SlotAvailable, with the slot given as a number from 1 to 22 in the bot's own numbering (not the game's equipment index): 1 primary, 2 secondary, 3 head, 4 chest, 5 shoulders, 6 forearms, 7 hands, 8 legs, 9 feet, 10 left_ring, 11 right_ring, 12 ears, 13 ears2, 14 neck, 15 left_wrist, 16 right_wrist, 17 ranged, 18 ammo, 19 waist, 20 cloak, 21 activate1, 22 activate2.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `slot number 1-22` | number |  | the slot, in the bot's numbering (whole digits only) |

**Returns:** bool - TRUE when the item in that slot is usable now. FALSE when it is not, when the number is not 1 to 22 (a warning is printed), or when the slot could not be read. event_slot, food and drink have no number; use SlotAvailable for them.

```text

```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.EquipmentSlotNumAvailable`

### `SlotUIName`

## Methods

### `AddEmbargo`

`OgreBotAPI.Inventory:AddEmbargo[fw, linkId, durationSec]`

Stops the bot's casting from using an item, given by its LinkID, for a number of seconds (while item embargo is enabled in the bot's settings). Both arguments are required; a new embargo on the same item only ever extends it, and the signed and unsigned forms of a LinkID both work.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `linkId` | number |  | the item's LinkID, a whole number from -2147483648 to 4294967295 |
| `durationSec` | number |  | how long, in seconds; 0 expires at once |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Inventory:AddEmbargo["all",-1112810742,30]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:ItemEmbargo_AddRotateTimer`

### `AutoConsumeFamiliarXP`

`OgreBotAPI.Inventory:AutoConsumeFamiliarXP[fw]`

Uses "(Temporary 4 hour) Familiar Experience" from your bags up to 10 times, waiting while you are in combat or moving. Only one temporary auto-consume run (this, mount training or research) runs at a time; a new call replaces the one before.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Inventory:AutoConsumeFamiliarXP[${Me.Name}]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:AutoConsumeTemporaryFamiliarExperience`

### `AutoConsumeFoodDrink`

`OgreBotAPI.Inventory:AutoConsumeFoodDrink[fw, value=TRUE]`

Turns auto-consume on or off for the food and drink in your equipped provision slots, flipping only a slot whose setting differs from what you asked. It is queued, with a 1-second pause after.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `value` | true/false or word | `TRUE` | TRUE = on, FALSE = off, toggle = flip, report = change nothing; any other word means TRUE |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Inventory:AutoConsumeFoodDrink[igw:${Me.Name},TRUE]
```

### `Unpack`

Unpacks an item in your bags (exact name), with flags after the item in any order: -qty N unpacks N (1 to 1000), -all keeps going until none is left (up to 1000), and -pick &lt;number \| name \| lowest> chooses the reward when the window offers a choice (lowest = the choice you hold the fewest of). It is queued and waits out an open reward window; a bad flag is refused with one line before anything is queued.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |

### `Use`

`OgreBotAPI.Inventory:Use[fw, item, ...]`

Uses an item by name: equipped items (gear, food and drink) are checked first, then your carried bags (exact name, any case). The use is queued and fires when the cast bar is free; an item that is not found prints a line, and an empty name or Nothing does nothing.

### `UseOnPlayer`

`OgreBotAPI.Inventory:UseOnPlayer[fw, item, player=me, ...]`

Uses an item on another player: it targets that player, uses the item (equipped first, then bags) and puts your old target back. It does nothing if the item is on cooldown, if an effect the item is known to give is already maintained by you, or if the cast bar is busy; an item or player that is not found prints a line.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|

| `item` | item name |  | the item to use |

| `...` | any |  | extra arguments are ignored |

```text

```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:UseItemOnPlayer`

# OgreBotAPI.Loot

## Members

### `ItemCount`

`${OgreBotAPI.Loot.ItemCount}`

How many distinct item names have a SmartLoot cap in the loaded loot files. It is 0 until the loot files have been loaded.

**Returns:** int: the number of capped item names; 0 when nothing is loaded.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Loot.ItemCount}
```

### `Loaded`

`${OgreBotAPI.Loot.Loaded}`

TRUE once the SmartLoot item caps file has been read, which happens on every profile load and on :Load or :Reload. Answers about this session only.

**Returns:** bool: TRUE when the item caps file (ItemLootData) was read; FALSE before a load or when that file is missing or unreadable.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Loot.Loaded}
```

### `WindowExists`

`${OgreBotAPI.Loot.WindowExists}`

Whether a loot window is open on this session. With two loot windows open it answers about the topmost one.

**Returns:** bool: TRUE when a loot window is open; FALSE when none is.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Loot.WindowExists}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.LootWindowExists`

### `WindowID`

`${OgreBotAPI.Loot.WindowID}`

The id of the open loot window, or 0 when there is none. With two loot windows open it is the topmost one.

**Returns:** int64: the loot window id; 0 when no loot window is open.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Loot.WindowID}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.Get_LootWindowID`

## Methods

### `BuildToonItemsToBeZeroed`

`OgreBotAPI.Loot:BuildToonItemsToBeZeroed[fw, toon, item, ...]`

Adds character and item pairs to a list of SmartLoot counts to reset to 0, ready for :ProcessToonItemsToBeZeroed. It can be called several times to build a long list, and a character left without an item is dropped with a warning.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `toon` | string |  | the character whose count for the item is reset |
| `item` | string |  | the item name for that character; colour codes are removed |
| `...` | string |  | more character and item pairs, in the same order |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Loot:BuildToonItemsToBeZeroed[${Me.Name},${Me.Name},"Gleaming Crown",${Group[1].Name},"Gleaming Crown"]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:SmartLoot_BuildToonItemsToBeZeroed`

### `Config`

`OgreBotAPI.Loot:Config[fw, mode=open]`

Opens the SmartLoot config panel, or closes it when mode is close. Opening a panel that is already open does nothing, so unsaved edits in it are kept.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `mode` | string | `open` | close closes the panel; any other value opens it |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Loot:Config[${Me.Name},close]
```

### `Decide`

`OgreBotAPI.Loot:Decide[fw, execute=FALSE]`

Works out what SmartLoot would do with every open loot window in turn and prints the plan for each item of a Leader Only one; by default it is a dry run that clicks nothing. With execute it records the counts and assigns or loots for real on the next pulse, and it does nothing but print a line when OgreBot has no profile, is paused or has no loot window open, or for each window that is not Leader Only.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `execute` | bool | `FALSE` | execute, force or a true word (TRUE, 1, yes, on) performs the plan; anything else, or nothing, is a dry run |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Loot:Decide[${Me.Name},execute]
```

### `LootAll`

`OgreBotAPI.Loot:LootAll[fw]`

Clicks Loot All on the open loot window. Does nothing when no loot window is open.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Loot:LootAll[${Me.Name}]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:LootWindowLootAll`

### `Migrate`

`OgreBotAPI.Loot:Migrate[fw, overwrite=FALSE]`

Converts the older XML loot files into the JSON loot store and prints how many files were written, blocked or missing. JSON files that already exist are left alone unless overwrite is given, and the loot data is reloaded when anything was written.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `overwrite` | bool | `FALSE` | overwrite, force or a true word (TRUE, 1, yes, on) replaces JSON files that already exist; anything else leaves them alone |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Loot:Migrate[${Me.Name},overwrite]
```

### `ProcessToonItemsToBeZeroed`

`OgreBotAPI.Loot:ProcessToonItemsToBeZeroed[fw]`

Sets every collected character and item count to 0, which makes those characters eligible for the item again, saves the loot counts file and empties the list. It prints how many were reset, and with nothing collected or an unreadable counts file it saves nothing and says so.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Loot:ProcessToonItemsToBeZeroed[${Me.Name}]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:SmartLoot_ProcessToonItemsToBeZeroed`

### `Reload`

|---|---|---|---|

### `SetAutoLootMode`

`OgreBotAPI.Loot:SetAutoLootMode[fw, mode]`

Sets this character's own auto-loot mode in the game, 0 none, 1 auto-greed or 2 auto-decline; out of the world nothing is sent. A missing mode prints a console line and sends nothing, and any other value sets 0 with a line saying so.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |

### `SetOptions`

`OgreBotAPI.Loot:SetOptions[fw, token, ...]`

Sets the group loot method, rarity and auto-loot mode from short loot words, one per argument and in any order; a kind you do not name is left as it is. The group leader opens the group options window and applies them through the action queue, while anyone else only sets their own auto-loot mode; out of the world nothing is sent.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `token` | string |  | one loot word: method LO, FFA, Lotto, NBG or RR (the long names such as Leader Only or Round Robin work too); rarity All, T, L or F (with or without +); auto-loot AN, AG or AD. An unknown word is ignored with a console warning |
| `...` | string |  | more loot words of the same kinds |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Loot:SetOptions[${Me.Name},LO,T+,AN]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:ChangeLootOptions`

# OgreBotAPI.Merchant

## Methods

### `Buy`

`OgreBotAPI.Merchant:Buy[fw, item, qty=1]`

With a merchant window already open, buys qty of the named item from the merchant's list, right away, and accepts the purchase prompt if one comes up. No item, no merchant window, or an item the merchant does not carry each get one line.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `item` | string |  | Name of the item on the merchant's list |
| `qty` | int | `1` | How many to buy |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Merchant:Buy[${Me.Name},"Fishing Bait",20]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:BuyFromMerchant`, `Obj_OgreIH:BuyFromMerchant`

### `OpenAndBuy`

`OgreBotAPI.Merchant:OpenAndBuy[fw, merchant, item, qty=1]`

Queued: opens the merchant window by double-clicking the nearest actor whose name contains merchant (unless a merchant window is already open), waits up to 3 seconds for it, buys qty of item and accepts the purchase confirmation. A missing name prints a console line, a window that never opens or an item the merchant does not carry prints a line and buys nothing, and no matching actor stops it silently.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `merchant` | string |  | Name (or part of the name) of the merchant to open |
| `item` | string |  | Name of the item on the merchant's list |
| `qty` | int | `1` | How many to buy |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Merchant:OpenAndBuy[${Me.Name},"Provisioner","Fishing Bait",20]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:OpenAndBuyFromMerchant`

### `OpenAndBuyXTimes`

`OgreBotAPI.Merchant:OpenAndBuyXTimes[fw, merchant, item, qty, times]`

Queued: does OpenAndBuy times times in a row - each round opens the merchant if needed, buys qty of item and accepts the confirmation. A missing merchant or item name, or times of 0 or less, prints a console line and nothing runs.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `merchant` | string |  | Name (or part of the name) of the merchant to open |
| `item` | string |  | Name of the item on the merchant's list |
| `qty` | int |  | How many to buy each round (1 when blank) |
| `times` | int |  | How many rounds to buy (1 when blank) |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Merchant:OpenAndBuyXTimes[${Me.Name},"Provisioner","Fishing Bait",100,3]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:OpenAndBuyFromMerchantXTimes`

### `Repair`

`OgreBotAPI.Merchant:Repair[fw, force=FALSE]`

Queued: unless force is TRUE, checks your primary and chest items and stops with "no repair needed" when both are at 100% condition. Otherwise finds a known mender within 10m (prints "no mender within 10m" if none), stops auto-attack, opens it, repairs everything and closes the window.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `force` | bool | `FALSE` | TRUE to repair even when primary and chest are already at 100% |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Merchant:Repair[igw:${Me.Name},FALSE]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:RepairGear`

### `Sell`

`OgreBotAPI.Merchant:Sell[fw, item, qty=1]`

With a merchant window already open, sells qty of the named item from your bags, right away. No item, no merchant window, or an item not in the sell list each get one line.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `item` | string |  | Name of the item in your bags |
| `qty` | int | `1` | How many to sell |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Merchant:Sell[${Me.Name},"Rough Ruby",5]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:SellToMerchant`, `Obj_OgreIH:SellToMerchant`

# OgreBotAPI.Movement

## Members

### `Active`

`${OgreBotAPI.Movement.Active}`

TRUE while the bot's mover is driving your character anywhere. That includes Movement:ToLoc, Come2Me and Move2Area, but also follow, the camp spot and nav trips.

**Returns:** bool: TRUE while a move is in progress; FALSE when the mover is idle.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Movement.Active}
```

### `AllowMovement`

`${OgreBotAPI.Movement.AllowMovement}`

TRUE when no movement block is held, the exact opposite of Blocked with no reason. It does not count the camp spot holds left by Come2Me, Move2Area or JoustIn.

**Returns:** bool: TRUE when no block is held; FALSE when at least one is.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Movement.AllowMovement}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `Obj_CampSpot.AllowCampSpot`, `Obj_Movement.AllowCampSpot`, `Ogre_CampSpot.AllowCampSpot`

### `AlreadyFacing`

`${OgreBotAPI.Movement.AlreadyFacing[id]}`

TRUE when your heading is within 45 degrees of the heading to the actor with this ID. FALSE when you are not in the world or the actor is not known.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | int64 |  | The actor ID to measure against (a number, such as ${Target.ID}). A name is not looked up. |

**Returns:** bool: TRUE when you are roughly facing the actor; FALSE when you are not, are not in the world, or the actor is not known.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Movement.AlreadyFacing[${Target.ID}]}
```

### `BehindLoc`

`${OgreBotAPI.Movement.BehindLoc[id,dist]}`

A point the given distance directly behind the actor, based on the way the actor is facing, at the actor's height. Returns an empty string when the actor is not found.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | int64 |  | The actor ID to measure against (a number, such as ${Target.ID}). A name is not looked up. |
| `dist` | float | `5` | How far from the actor the point is, in meters. |

**Returns:** string: "x,y,z" behind the actor; "" when the actor is not found.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Movement.BehindLoc[${Target.ID},5]}
```

### `BlockCount`

`${OgreBotAPI.Movement.BlockCount}`

How many different movement blocks are held right now. Adding the same reason twice counts once.

**Returns:** int: the number of distinct block reasons held; 0 when movement is free.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Movement.BlockCount}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `Obj_CampSpot.uAllowMovement`, `Obj_Movement.uAllowMovement`, `Ogre_CampSpot.uAllowMovement`

### `Blocked`

`${OgreBotAPI.Movement.Blocked[reason]}`

With a reason, TRUE when that named movement block is held; with the reason left blank, TRUE when any block is held. Reason names are case-sensitive, and the bot's own movers add blocks too while they run.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `reason` | string |  | The block name to check, as given to Movement:Block. Leave it blank to ask whether any block is held. |

**Returns:** bool: TRUE when the named block (or, with no reason, any block) is held; FALSE otherwise.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Movement.Blocked[MyScript]}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `Obj_CampSpot.Disabled`, `Obj_Movement.Disabled`, `Ogre_CampSpot.Disabled`

### `BlockReasons`

`${OgreBotAPI.Movement.BlockReasons}`

The names of every movement block held right now, so you can see what is stopping a character. This includes blocks the bot's own movers hold while they run.

**Returns:** string: the block reasons separated by commas; "" when no block is held.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Movement.BlockReasons}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `Obj_CampSpot.sc_ItemsAffectingMovement`, `Obj_Movement.sc_ItemsAffectingMovement`, `Ogre_CampSpot.sc_ItemsAffectingMovement`

### `Distance2DTo`

`${OgreBotAPI.Movement.Distance2DTo[id]}`

The flat distance from you to the actor with this ID, ignoring height (X and Z only). Returns -1 when the ID is 0, is not a number, or no such actor is nearby.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | int64 |  | The actor ID to measure against (a number, such as ${Target.ID}). A name is not looked up. |

**Returns:** float: the ground distance in meters; -1 when the actor is not found.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Movement.Distance2DTo[${Target.ID}]}
```

### `DistanceTo`

`${OgreBotAPI.Movement.DistanceTo[id]}`

The straight-line (3D) distance from you to the actor with this ID. Returns -1 when the ID is 0, is not a number, or no such actor is nearby.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | int64 |  | The actor ID to measure against (a number, such as ${Target.ID}). A name is not looked up. |

**Returns:** float: the distance in meters; -1 when the actor is not found.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Movement.DistanceTo[${Target.ID}]}
```

### `FaceLockActor`

`${OgreBotAPI.Movement.FaceLockActor}`

The ID of the actor the face lock is holding you toward.

**Returns:** int64: the locked actor's ID; 0 when the lock is on a location, or when no lock is held.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Movement.FaceLockActor}
```

### `FaceLocked`

`${OgreBotAPI.Movement.FaceLocked}`

TRUE while a face lock from Movement:FaceLock or :FaceLockLoc is held on this session. While it is held, nothing else can turn you and movement waits.

**Returns:** bool: TRUE while a face lock is held; FALSE when there is none.

```text

```

### `FaceLockRemaining`

How long the current face lock has left before it lets go on its own, in milliseconds.

**Returns:** int: milliseconds left on the lock; 0 when no lock is held.

```text

```

### `FrontLoc`

A point the given distance directly in front of the actor, based on the way the actor is facing, at the actor's height. Returns an empty string when the actor is not found.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |

### `GettingToGH`

`${OgreBotAPI.Movement.GettingToGH}`

TRUE while a trip started by Movement:GetToGH is waiting in the action queue or running. It goes FALSE on its own once that trip finishes, fails or is removed.

**Returns:** bool: TRUE while a guild hall trip is in progress; FALSE otherwise.

```text

```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI.GettingToGH`

### `GoalDistance`

`${OgreBotAPI.Movement.GoalDistance}`

How far you still are from the goal of the move in progress. A Movement:ToLoc move measures this flat, ignoring height.

**Returns:** float: the distance in meters to the current goal; -1 when no move is in progress, or during a straight climb or descent.

```text

```

### `HeadingTo`

`${OgreBotAPI.Movement.HeadingTo[id]}`

The heading, in degrees, you would face to look at the actor with this ID. An unknown ID reads -1.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |

### `LeftLoc`

`${OgreBotAPI.Movement.LeftLoc[id,dist]}`

A point the given distance to the actor's left side, based on the way the actor is facing, at the actor's height. Returns an empty string when the actor is not found.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|


### `MyLoc`

`${OgreBotAPI.Movement.MyLoc}`

Your current location as text, three numbers with two decimals each.

**Returns:** string: "x,y,z" - where your character is now.

```text

```

### `RightLoc`

`${OgreBotAPI.Movement.RightLoc[id,dist]}`

A point the given distance to the actor's right side, based on the way the actor is facing, at the actor's height. Returns an empty string when the actor is not found.

### `UseWithoutOgreBot`

`${OgreBotAPI.Movement.UseWithoutOgreBot}`

Whether movement is allowed while OgreBot is not open, as set by Movement:UseWithoutOgreBot. It starts FALSE in every session.

**Returns:** bool: TRUE when movement runs without OgreBot open; FALSE when movement needs OgreBot open.

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Movement.UseWithoutOgreBot}
```

## Methods

### `AutoRun`

`OgreBotAPI.Movement:AutoRun[fw]`

Presses your autorun key once (Num Lock unless you have bound another), which toggles autorun in the game.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text

```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:AutoRun`

### `Block`

`OgreBotAPI.Movement:Block[fw, reason]`

Adds a named movement block and stops the move in progress. While any block is held the camp spot, follow, new nav trips and queued moves all stay still, but a direct Movement:ToLoc, Come2Me or Move2Area still moves; a blank reason prints a line and adds nothing.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `reason` | string |  | A name for this block, so Movement:Unblock can release exactly this one. Case-sensitive. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Movement:Block[${Me.Name},MyScript]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `Obj_CampSpot:Disable`, `Obj_Movement:Disable`, `Ogre_CampSpot:Disable`

### `CallGH`

`OgreBotAPI.Movement:CallGH[fw]`

Queues a cast of Call to Guild Hall after a short random wait (0.5 to 3.4 seconds). A Brigand in Safehouse has it cancelled first; does nothing when you are already in the guild hall.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Movement:CallGH[${Me.Name}]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:CallGH`, `call Obj_OgreUtilities.CallToGH`

### `ClearBlocks`

`OgreBotAPI.Movement:ClearBlocks[fw]`

Releases every movement block at once, including blocks the bot's own movers hold, which ends a nav trip under way. It does not release the camp spot holds from Come2Me, Move2Area or JoustIn.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Movement:ClearBlocks[${Me.Name}]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `Obj_CampSpot:Clear`, `Obj_Movement:Clear`, `Ogre_CampSpot:Clear`

### `Come2Me`

`OgreBotAPI.Movement:Come2Me[fw, toWho=me, precision=3]`

Runs to where the named character is standing at the moment of the call, stopping within the precision; it needs OgreBot open (or Movement:UseWithoutOgreBot) and prints a line when it is not, and a character with Allow Camp Spot off stays put and prints a line. On arrival the character stays there instead of going back to its camp spot until JoustOut or LetsGo, a name that matches nobody here prints a line and does nothing, and after 10 seconds stuck the move stops with one line.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `toWho` | string | `me` | Who to run to: a name (part of a name works), an actor ID or an @ alias. Blank means yourself. |
| `precision` | float | `3` | How close counts as arrived, in meters. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Movement:Come2Me[${Me.Name},${Group[1].Name},3]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:Come2Me`

### `Crouch`

`OgreBotAPI.Movement:Crouch[fw]`

Presses your crouch key once (Z unless you have bound another).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |

### `Evac`

Queues your class evacuation spell when you have one and it is ready (Escape for scouts, Shadowy Elusion for Shadowknights, Depart for Wizards, Verdurous Journey for Wardens). With mode totem, a character without a ready class evac uses a Totem of Escape from its bags instead, and prints a line when it has none or it is on cooldown; without totem it prints one line saying why it did not evacuate.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `mode` | string | `""` | Blank for the class evac only; totem to fall back to a Totem of Escape. |

```text

```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:Evac`, `call Obj_OgreUtilities.CastEvac`

### `FaceActor`

### `FaceLoc`

`OgreBotAPI.Movement:FaceLoc[fw, x, y, z]`

Turns you to face the location using X and Z; the height is not used. A missing x or z prints an error, and nothing turns while a face lock is held.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `x` | float or name |  | X of the location, or the whole location as one word: the name of a point of interest in this zone, or x,y,z. An unknown name prints one line and does nothing. |
| `y` | float |  | Y (height). Ignored - a heading is flat - and kept so a location pastes in as x,y,z (${Me.Loc} as is). |
| `z` | float |  | Z of the location. Not read when x holds the whole location. |

```text

```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:FaceLoc`, `Obj_OgreIH:FaceLoc`

### `FaceLock`

`OgreBotAPI.Movement:FaceLock[fw, nameOrId, ttlSeconds=0]`

Turns you to the actor and holds that heading, turning again when you drift more than 45 degrees (at most once a second); while held, nothing else can turn you, movement waits and the game's /follow is stopped. The lock ends after ttlSeconds, on Movement:FaceUnlock, LetsGo, zoning, death or camping, or when the actor is gone, and an actor that is not found takes no lock.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `nameOrId` | string |  | The actor's exact name, its actor ID, or an @ alias. |
| `ttlSeconds` | int | `0` | How long the lock lasts, in seconds. 0 or blank means 15; the most is 120. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Movement:FaceLock[${Me.Name},${Target.ID},10]
```

### `FaceLockLoc`

`OgreBotAPI.Movement:FaceLockLoc[fw, x, z, ttlSeconds=0]`

Turns you toward the location and holds that heading, the same way Movement:FaceLock does for an actor. A missing x or z prints an error, and the lock ends after ttlSeconds, on Movement:FaceUnlock, LetsGo, zoning, death or camping.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `x` | float or name |  | X of the location to face, or the whole location as one word: the name of a point of interest in this zone, or x,y,z. An unknown name prints one line and does nothing. |
| `z` | float |  | Z of the location to face. Not read when x holds the whole location. |
| `ttlSeconds` | int | `0` | How long the lock lasts, in seconds. 0 or blank means 15; the most is 120. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Movement:FaceLockLoc[${Me.Name},100,-250,10]
```

### `Follow`

`OgreBotAPI.Movement:Follow[fw, leader=off, minDistance=8, maxDistance=200, breakWithNoTarget=FALSE, backOffDistance=0]`

Follows the leader with the bot's own follow, moving up when farther than minDistance and stopping when the leader is beyond maxDistance; it stops the game's /follow and needs OgreBot open (or Movement:UseWithoutOgreBot) to start. A leader of off, blank or your own name turns follow off, as does off given as the for-who; an unknown leader or bad distances print a line.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `leader` | string | `off` | Who to follow: a character name, an actor ID, or off to stop following. |
| `minDistance` | float | `8` | Follow moves up when the leader is farther than this, in meters. Must be above 0. |
| `maxDistance` | float | `200` | Follow stops chasing when the leader is this far or farther. Must be above minDistance. |
| `breakWithNoTarget` | bool | `FALSE` | TRUE to turn follow off the first time it needs to move up while you have no target. |
| `backOffDistance` | float | `0` | Back away from a leader closer than this, in meters. 0 is off; otherwise at least 1 less than minDistance. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Movement:Follow[${Me.Name},${Group[1].Name},8,200,FALSE,0]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:OFollow`

### `FollowDistanceDown`

`OgreBotAPI.Movement:FollowDistanceDown[fw]`

Takes 2 meters off the follow distances: minDistance never goes below 1, and maxDistance is left alone when minDistance hits that floor. A back-off distance shrinks with them and turns off when there is no room left.

|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

### `JumpRoute`

`OgreBotAPI.Movement:JumpRoute[fw, start, jump, end, completed="", flag...]`

Walks to start, then on to end, pressing jump once when passing within 2 meters of the jump point, and on arrival sets the camp spot to completed (or to end). It runs in the background and gives up after 10 seconds by default; a bad point or flag, or a route already running, prints why.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `start` | string |  | The first point to walk to, as "x,y,z". |
| `jump` | string |  | Where to jump on the way to end, as "x,y,z". |
| `end` | string |  | Where the route ends, as "x,y,z". |
| `completed` | string | `""` | The camp spot to set on arrival, as "x,y,z". Blank, or an X of 0, uses end. |
| `flag...` | string |  | Optional flags, one per argument, each followed by its value: -JumpDistance meters (default 2), -MaxTimer seconds per try (default 10), -Attempts 1 to 10, -RetryDelay seconds, -AboveY height that counts as success, -RunMode walk or run. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Movement:JumpRoute[${Me.Name},"100,20,-250","104,20,-246","110,25,-240","",-JumpDistance,1,-MaxTimer,12]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:Set_CampSpotJump_Handle`, `Obj_CampSpotJump:Handle`, `Obj_CampSpotJump:HandleAdvanced`

### `Move2Area`

`OgreBotAPI.Movement:Move2Area[fw, x, y, z, precision=3]`

Runs to the location (X and Z, height ignored) and then stays there instead of going back to its camp spot until JoustOut or LetsGo. Only a character that has a target moves; it needs OgreBot open (or Movement:UseWithoutOgreBot) and prints a line when it is not, a character with Allow Camp Spot off stays put and prints a line, a missing x or z prints an error, and after 10 seconds stuck the move stops with one line.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `x` | float or name |  | X of the location, or the whole location as one word: the name of a point of interest in this zone, or x,y,z. An unknown name prints one line and does nothing. |
| `y` | float |  | Y (height). Not used: this is a ground move, so you can paste ${Me.Loc} as is. |
| `z` | float |  | Z of the location. Not read when x holds the whole location. |
| `precision` | float | `3` | How close counts as arrived, in meters. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Movement:Move2Area[${Me.Name},100,20,-250,3]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:Move2Area`

| `precision` | float | `3` | How close counts as arrived, in meters. |


*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:Move2AreaNoTarget`

### `NavTo`

`OgreBotAPI.Movement:NavTo[fw, x, y, z, mode=walk]`

Starts a nav trip over the navmesh to the location, replacing any trip under way; it waits while OgreBot is paused and stops when OgreBot closes. It leaves an encounter's trip alone and prints a line saying so, a missing x, y or z or one that is not a number prints an error, and a trip that cannot start prints why.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |

| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `x` | float or name |  | X of the location, or the whole location as one word: the name of a point of interest in this zone, or x,y,z. An unknown name prints one line and does nothing. |
| `y` | float |  | Y (height) of the location. Not read when x holds the whole location. |
| `z` | float |  | Z of the location. Not read when x holds the whole location. |
| `mode` | string | `walk` | fly to fly there; any other word walks. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Movement:NavTo[${Me.Name},100,20,-250,walk]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `call Obj_OgreUtilities.NavTo`, `call Obj_OgreUtilities.NavToLoc`

### `ToLoc`

Runs straight to the location and stops once within the precision, measured flat (X and Z); it returns at once and the move carries on in the background, with OgreBot closed too (Movement:Stop ends it). A missing x, y or z, or one that is not a number, prints an error and does nothing, and the move does not hold the camp spot, so a character with a camp spot can walk back afterwards.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |

| `y` | float |  | Y (height) of the location. Not read when x holds the whole location. |
| `z` | float |  | Z of the location. Not read when x holds the whole location. |
| `precision` | float | `0` | How close counts as arrived, in meters. 0 or blank uses 2. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Movement:ToLoc[${Me.Name},100,20,-250,3]
```

# OgreBotAPI.Options

## Members

### `Value`

`${OgreBotAPI.Options.Value[id]}`

Reads a stored OgreBot option for this character by its control id, matching the id in any case. Needs no for-who; an id the profile does not hold reads the same as an empty value.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string |  | The option's control id, as saved in the profile |

**Returns:** string: the option's current value (a checkbox reads TRUE or FALSE); "" when the id is absent, empty, or no id is given

```text
echo ${OgreBotAPI.Options.Value[checkbox_settings_enable_chatevents]}
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreOSA.Enabled`, `OgreOSA.ScanRadius`, `OgreOSA.TargetsOnly`

## Methods

### `LoadProfile`

`OgreBotAPI.Options:LoadProfile[fw, name]`

Loads the named OgreBot profile for this character, opening OgreBot first if it is not open; Use_UI reloads the current profile. A missing name gets one line and loads nothing.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `name` | string |  | Profile name, or Use_UI for the current profile. Required. |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Options:LoadProfile[${Me.Name},Raid]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `ProfileConfig:LoadProfileForWho`, `OgreBotAPI:LoadProfile`, `ProfileConfig:LoadProfile`

### `Revert`

`OgreBotAPI.Options:Revert[fw, source]`

Puts back every option that scripts, commands or encounters changed since the last revert, then forgets those changes; changes you made yourself in the OgreBot window are never reverted. Prints "options: reverted N" with the source in the console.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `source` | string |  | Which writer's changes to put back: an encounter's key, command for typed and script changes, or all / empty for every source |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Options:Revert[${Me.Name},all]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:RevertOptions`, `Obj_LICH:HODefaultSettings`

### `Set`

`OgreBotAPI.Options:Set[fw, silent|loud|verbose="", (id,value)..., silent=FALSE]`

Writes one or more OgreBot options by control id in the loaded profile, prints each real change in OgreConsole unless silenced, and remembers the old value so Revert can put it back. The write is unsaved until Save, and does nothing when no profile is loaded.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |
| `silent\|loud\|verbose` | string | `""` | Optional, before an id: silent turns the change lines off, loud or verbose turns them on |
| `(id,value)...` | string |  | Pairs of control id and new value; a TRUE or FALSE after a value, with more pairs after it, sets silent too |
| `silent` | bool | `FALSE` | A TRUE or FALSE at the very end: TRUE makes the whole call silent |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Options:Set[all,checkbox_settings_enable_chatevents,TRUE]
```

*Was (OldBot):* `OgreBotAPI:ChangeOgreBotUIOption`, `OgreBotAPI:UplinkOptionChange`, `Obj_OgreUtilities:Set_EQ2_onQuestOffered`

### `WarnBeforeSave`

`OgreBotAPI.Options:WarnBeforeSave[fw]`

Shows a warning beside Save in this character's OgreBot window saying the Instance Controller has run and settings may have changed, until a profile is loaded. Save still works while it is up; the Instance Controller sends this to its group itself.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw` | for-who |  | [for-who](ForWho.md): this runs only when this character is one it names |

```text
OgreBotAPI.Options:WarnBeforeSave[igw:${Me.Name}]
```
